"""Paired static-bias interventions on the locked RB validation cohort."""

import argparse
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import json
import math
import os
from pathlib import Path
from time import perf_counter

import torch

from eval_v2 import ROOT, VALID, dataset_at, search, sync, write_run
from mis_static_prior import bias_stats, oracle_bias, random_bias
from mis_v1 import adjacency
from mis_v3_search import SearchGraph, node_mask, nodes, platform_search
from mis_v3_value import load_pave_v3
from static_prior_protocol import ORACLE_NAMES, P0_ARMS
from v7_runs import backbone, digest, pave, preflight_policy, provenance
from v7_structure import V7Topology


STEPS = (25, 50, 100, 200, 400, 800)
BUDGETS = (.5, 1.)
RANDOM_RMS = .0107


def search_seeds(index, count):
    return [1017 + index + 100_003 * replica for replica in range(count)]


def cohort(args):
    dtype = torch.float32 if args.backend == "fp32-graph" else torch.float16
    dataset = dataset_at(VALID, dtype)
    dataset.files = dataset.files[args.offset:args.offset + args.samples]
    if len(dataset) != args.samples:
        raise ValueError("The requested validation cohort is incomplete")
    return dataset, [Path(path).stem for path in dataset.files]


def add_common(parser):
    parser.add_argument("--ref", type=int, choices=(0, 1, 2), default=0)
    parser.add_argument("--offset", type=int, default=0)
    parser.add_argument("--samples", type=int, default=100)
    parser.add_argument("--seeds-per-graph", type=int, default=3)
    parser.add_argument("--backend", choices=("fp32-graph", "fp16-eager"), default="fp32-graph")
    parser.add_argument("--checkpoint", type=Path, help="Training directory or checkpoints directory")
    parser.add_argument("--oracle-kamis-path", "--static_oracle_path", dest="oracle_kamis_path", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--oracle-b-path", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--oracle-amplitude", type=float, default=1., help="Amplitude for oracle arms without @A")
    parser.add_argument("--static-bias-seed", "--static_bias_seed", type=int, default=7311)
    parser.add_argument("--arms", nargs="+", help="b0, null-rand, amp@A, rand@A, oracle-kamis@A, oracle-b@A, anti-oracle@A, "
                        "centered, v1-node-only, masked, matched-rand, or a label supplied by --compare")
    parser.add_argument("--compare", nargs=2, action="append", metavar=("LABEL", "RUN"), default=[])
    parser.add_argument("--feature-drop", choices=("log_degree", "neighbor_log_degree_mean",
                        "neighbor_log_degree_std", "core", "hub_distance", "two_hop_fraction", "density", "size"))


def checkpoint_paths(path, ref):
    if path is None:
        path = ROOT / f"outputs/static_prior_v1/train_centered_ref{ref}"
    folder = path if (path / "best.pt").is_file() else path / "checkpoints"
    return folder, folder.parent / "run.json"


def load_arm_policy(args, path):
    folder, record_path = checkpoint_paths(path, args.ref)
    record = json.loads(record_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) if record_path.is_file() else {}
    config = record.get("config", {})
    mode = config.get("context_mode", "static_centered")
    if mode not in ("static_centered", "static_constants"):
        raise ValueError(f"{folder} must contain a centered or constants checkpoint")
    options = []
    for name in ("static_constant_limit", "static_node_limit", "static_features", "static_encoder",
                 "v7_delta_limit", "v7_order_seed", "v7_order_views"):
        if config.get(name) is not None and not (name == "v7_delta_limit" and record.get("version") == "static_prior_v1"):
            options.extend((f"--{name}", str(config[name])))
    if config.get("static_peak_normalize"):
        options.append("--static_peak_normalize")
    policy = preflight_policy(mode, "no" if args.backend == "fp32-graph" else "fp16", ref=args.ref,
                             width=config.get("v7_width", 32), d_state=config.get("v7_d_state", 16),
                             checkpoint=folder, cuda_graph=args.backend == "fp32-graph", options=options)
    return policy, folder / "best.pt", record


def baseline(args):
    return preflight_policy("none", "no" if args.backend == "fp32-graph" else "fp16", ref=args.ref,
                            cuda_graph=args.backend == "fp32-graph")


class Experiment:
    def __init__(self, args, graph_ids):
        self.args = args
        self.arms = args.arms or P0_ARMS
        self.base = baseline(args)
        self.device = self.base.accelerator.device
        self.policies = {"b0": self.base}
        self.records = {}
        self.paths = {"b0": backbone(args.ref)}
        self.targets = {}
        self.target_hashes = {}
        self.norm_hashes = {}
        self.alpha = {}
        self.compares = dict(args.compare)
        self.doses = {}
        target_files = {}
        if len(self.arms) != len(set(self.arms)) or "b0" not in self.arms:
            raise ValueError("Use distinct arms including b0")
        if any(arm != "b0" and arm not in self.compares for arm in self.arms):
            self.adapter, self.adapter_path, self.adapter_record = load_arm_policy(args, args.checkpoint)
        for arm in self.arms:
            if arm == "b0":
                continue
            name, separator, dose = arm.partition("@")
            if arm in self.compares:
                checkpoint, _ = checkpoint_paths(Path(self.compares[arm]), args.ref)
                if hasattr(self, "adapter") and checkpoint.resolve() == self.adapter_path.parent.resolve():
                    policy, path, record = self.adapter, self.adapter_path, self.adapter_record
                else:
                    policy, path, record = load_arm_policy(args, Path(self.compares[arm]))
            else:
                policy, path, record = self.adapter, self.adapter_path, self.adapter_record
            self.policies[arm], self.paths[arm], self.records[arm] = policy, path, record
            self.norm_hashes[arm] = record.get("feature_norm_sha256")
            alpha = getattr(policy.accelerator.unwrap_model(policy.model).adapter, "alpha", None)
            if alpha is not None:
                self.alpha[arm] = float(alpha)
            if name in ORACLE_NAMES:
                path = args.oracle_b_path if name == "oracle-b" else args.oracle_kamis_path
                if path is None:
                    raise ValueError(f"{arm} needs a target JSON from prepare_oracles.sh")
                if path not in target_files:
                    data = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
                    missing = set(graph_ids) - data.keys()
                    if missing:
                        raise ValueError(f"{path} lacks target for {min(missing)}")
                    target_files[path] = data, digest(path)
                self.targets[arm], self.target_hashes[arm] = target_files[path]
                self.doses[arm] = float(dose) if separator else args.oracle_amplitude
            elif name in ("amp", "rand") and separator:
                self.doses[arm] = float(dose)
            elif arm not in self.compares and arm not in ("null-rand", "centered", "v1-node-only", "masked", "matched-rand"):
                raise ValueError(f"Unknown arm {arm}")
            if arm in self.doses and not (0 <= self.doses[arm] < math.inf):
                raise ValueError(f"Invalid amplitude in {arm}")
        original = self.base.accelerator.unwrap_model(self.base.model).state_dict()
        for policy in set(self.policies.values()) - {self.base}:
            weights = policy.accelerator.unwrap_model(policy.model).state_dict()
            if any(not torch.equal(value, weights[key]) for key, value in original.items()):
                raise ValueError("All paired adapters must use the frozen backbone for --ref")

    def policy(self, arm, graph_id, graph_index, legal, steps):
        solver = self.policies[arm]
        solver.num_t = steps
        if arm == "b0":
            return solver
        model = solver.accelerator.unwrap_model(solver.model)
        adapter = model.adapter
        name = arm.partition("@")[0]
        target = self.targets[arm][graph_id] if arm in self.targets else None
        if arm in self.targets:
            if not isinstance(target, list) or not all(isinstance(i, int) and 0 <= i < legal.num_nodes for i in target):
                raise ValueError(f"Invalid target nodes for {graph_id} in {arm}")
            if not legal.feasible(node_mask(target)):
                raise ValueError(f"Conflicting {name} target on {graph_id}; regenerate the oracle targets")
        amplitude = self.doses.get(arm)
        drop = self.args.feature_drop if solver is getattr(self, "adapter", None) else None
        adapter.feature_drop = adapter.feature_schema.index(drop) if drop else None
        adapter.centered = adapter.mode == "static_centered" and (
            arm in ("centered", "v1-node-only", "matched-rand") or arm in self.compares
            or (name in ("amp", "rand") and amplitude > 0))

        def bias(adapter, topology, graph):
            device = graph.edge_index.device
            seed = self.args.static_bias_seed + graph_index
            if target is not None:
                direction = oracle_bias(graph.num_nodes, target, amplitude, device)
                return -direction if name == "anti-oracle" else direction
            if arm == "null-rand":
                return random_bias(graph.num_nodes, seed, RANDOM_RMS, device)
            if name in ("amp", "rand"):
                if amplitude == 0:
                    return torch.zeros((1, 2), device=device)
                direction = adapter.direction(topology, normalize=True)
                sign = torch.where(adapter.alpha < 0, -1., 1.)
                scaled = (amplitude * sign) * direction
                if name == "rand":
                    return random_bias(graph.num_nodes, seed, scaled.square().mean().sqrt(), device)
                return scaled
            if arm == "v1-node-only":
                return adapter.action_bias(topology, (0., model.delta_limit[1]))
            if arm == "matched-rand":
                constants = adapter.constant_limit * adapter.constants.tanh()[None, :]
                learned = adapter.action_bias(topology, model.delta_limit) - constants
                rms = learned.square().mean().sqrt()
                return constants + random_bias(graph.num_nodes, seed, rms, device)
            return adapter.action_bias(topology, model.delta_limit)

        solver.static_intervention = bias
        return solver


def initial_state(graph, solver, seed):
    rng = torch.Generator(device=graph.b.device).manual_seed(seed)
    x = torch.randint(0, 2, (graph.num_nodes, solver.num_k), dtype=solver.dtype,
                      device=graph.b.device, generator=rng)
    return x, rng


def probability_metrics(p, base, noise):
    flip = noise < p
    base_flip = noise < base
    return dict(delta_prob_mae=float((p - base).float().abs().mean()),
                boundary_fraction=float(((p > .01) & (p < .99)).float().mean()),
                flip_rate=float(p.float().sum(0).mean()),
                base_flip_rate=float(base.float().sum(0).mean()),
                flip_disagreement=float((flip != base_flip).float().mean()))


def measure_initial(experiment, graph, seed, prepared):
    adj = adjacency(graph)
    x, rng = initial_state(graph, experiment.base, seed)
    base_topology = experiment.base.policy_topology(graph, adj)
    base = experiment.base.flip_logits(x, graph, adj, base_topology).sigmoid()
    noise = torch.rand(x.shape, device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype, generator=rng)
    stats = {}
    for key, bias in prepared.items():
        arm, _ = key
        if bias is None:
            bias, p = x.new_zeros((1, 2)), base
        else:
            bias = bias.to(x.device)
            topology = V7Topology(base_topology, None, (), (), 1, bias)
            p = experiment.policies[arm].flip_logits(x, graph, adj, topology).sigmoid()
        stats[key] = dict(**bias_stats(bias), **probability_metrics(p, base, noise))
    return stats


def solve_rows(solver, graph, edges, seed, ranker, steps, budget):
    device = graph.b.device
    solver.num_t = max(steps) if budget is None else 10000
    sync(device)
    resident = torch.cuda.memory_allocated(device) if device.type == "cuda" else 0
    if device.type == "cuda":
        torch.cuda.reset_peak_memory_stats(device)
    start = perf_counter()
    deadline = start + budget if budget else None
    legal = SearchGraph(graph.num_nodes, edges, seed=seed)
    timings, snapshots, curve = {}, {}, []
    bias = None

    def remember(topology):
        nonlocal bias
        bias = topology.cached_action_bias

    def collect(step, selected, incumbent, periodic):
        if periodic:
            curve.append((step, incumbent.bit_count()))
        if step in steps:
            snapshots[step] = selected, incumbent, perf_counter() - start

    selected, used = search(solver, graph, legal, seed, deadline=deadline-.05 if budget else None,
                            decode_every=10, timings=timings, checkpoints=steps if budget is None else (),
                            on_decode=collect if budget is None else None,
                            on_prepare=remember if solver.v7_context else None, archive_final=budget is not None)
    sync(device)
    search_time = perf_counter() - start
    peak = torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated(device) if device.type == "cuda" else 0

    def finish(mask, used, time, protocol, decoder, reached):
        tick = perf_counter()
        fallback = mask == 0 and graph.num_nodes > 0
        if fallback:
            mask = 1 << legal.greedy_order[0]
        final = platform_search(legal, mask, choose=ranker.choose, horizon=1,
                                deadline=deadline if budget else float("inf")).best
        end = perf_counter()
        if not legal.feasible(mask) or not legal.feasible(final):
            raise ValueError("Search returned an infeasible independent set")
        return dict(protocol=protocol, decoder=decoder, base_size=mask.bit_count(), final_size=final.bit_count(),
                    search_steps=used, search_s=time, pave_s=end-tick, solve_s=end-start if budget else time+end-tick,
                    prepare_budget_fraction=timings["policy_prepare_s"]/budget if budget else None,
                    **timings, feasible=1, fallback=int(fallback), overrun=int(budget is not None and end > deadline),
                    peak_memory_mib=peak/2**20, solve_peak_mib=(peak-resident)/2**20, steps_to_target=reached,
                    base_nodes=" ".join(map(str, nodes(mask))), selected_nodes=" ".join(map(str, nodes(final))))

    if budget:
        rows = [finish(selected, used, search_time, f"budget{int(budget * 10):02d}", "periodic", None)]
    else:
        target = snapshots[max(steps)][0].bit_count()
        samples = curve + [(step, row[0].bit_count()) for step, row in snapshots.items()]
        reached = min(step for step, size in samples if size >= target)
        rows = [finish(mask, step, time, f"t{step}", decoder, reached)
                for step, (endpoint, incumbent, time) in snapshots.items()
                for decoder, mask in (("endpoint", endpoint), ("periodic", incumbent))]
    return rows, bias.cpu() if bias is not None else None


@torch.no_grad()
def evaluate(args):
    from eval_static_prior import write_rows

    data, graph_ids = cohort(args)
    run = Experiment(args, graph_ids)
    ranker = load_pave_v3(pave(args.ref))
    args.output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    started = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    warm = data[0]
    legal = SearchGraph(warm.num_nodes, warm.edge_index, seed=1017)
    warm = warm.to(run.device)
    for arm in run.arms:
        solver = run.policy(arm, graph_ids[0], args.offset, legal, 25)
        search(solver, warm, legal, 1017)
    sync(run.device)
    records = []
    for repeat in range(args.repeats):
        current = []
        for index, graph in enumerate(data, start=args.offset):
            gid = graph_ids[index-args.offset]
            edges = graph.edge_index
            graph = graph.to(run.device)
            rotation = index % len(run.arms)
            order = run.arms[rotation:] + run.arms[:rotation]
            if repeat % 2:
                order = order[::-1]
            for seed in search_seeds(index, args.seeds_per_graph):
                legal = SearchGraph(graph.num_nodes, edges, seed=seed)
                paired = []
                prepared = {}
                for budget in (args.budgets if args.protocol == "budget" else (None,)):
                    for position, arm in enumerate(order):
                        solver = run.policy(arm, gid, index, legal, max(args.steps))
                        rows, bias = solve_rows(solver, graph, edges, seed, ranker, args.steps, budget)
                        prepared[arm, rows[0]["protocol"] if budget else None] = bias
                        for row in rows:
                            paired.append(dict(graph_id=gid, search_seed=seed, repeat=repeat, order=position,
                                               arm=arm, **row))
                stats = measure_initial(run, graph, seed, prepared)
                baseline_sets = {(row["protocol"], row["decoder"]): set(row["selected_nodes"].split())
                                 for row in paired if row["arm"] == "b0"}
                for row in paired:
                    other = baseline_sets[row["protocol"], row["decoder"]]
                    selected = set(row["selected_nodes"].split())
                    row.update(**stats[row["arm"], row["protocol"] if args.protocol == "budget" else None],
                               final_jaccard=len(selected & other)/max(1, len(selected | other)))
                current.extend(paired)
            if (index-args.offset+1) % 10 == 0 or index-args.offset+1 == len(data):
                print(f"{args.protocol} repeat {repeat} {index-args.offset+1}/{len(data)}", flush=True)
        write_rows(args.output / f"repeat_{repeat}.csv", current)
        records.extend(current)
    source = provenance(args.ref)
    source.update(version="static_prior_v2", status="completed", backend=args.backend,
                  regime_note="curve time includes offline diagnostic decodes" if args.protocol == "curve"
                  else "deadline includes prepare and PAVE; mechanism replay is outside timing",
                  precision="fp32" if args.backend == "fp32-graph" else "fp16",
                  cuda_graph=args.backend == "fp32-graph", num_k=20, reserve_s=.05, decode_every=10,
                  graph_ids=graph_ids, search_seeds={gid: search_seeds(i, args.seeds_per_graph)
                                                   for i, gid in enumerate(graph_ids, args.offset)},
                  config=vars(args), feature_norm_sha256=run.norm_hashes,
                  oracle_sha256=run.target_hashes,
                  doses=run.doses,
                  random_rms=RANDOM_RMS, rng_protocol="same generator seed per graph and arm, separate fixed bias seed",
                  checkpoint_sha256={arm: digest(path) for arm, path in run.paths.items()},
                  alpha=run.alpha,
                  limits={arm: run.policies[arm].accelerator.unwrap_model(run.policies[arm].model).delta_limit
                          for arm in run.paths if arm != "b0"},
                  params={arm: sum(p.numel() for p in solver.model.parameters()) for arm, solver in run.policies.items()},
                  pave_params=sum(p.numel() for p in ranker.parameters()),
                  gpu=os.environ.get("CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES"), device=str(run.device), started_at=started,
                  finished_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat())
    write_rows(args.output / "per_graph.csv", records)
    write_run(args.output, source)


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    add_common(parser)
    parser.add_argument("--protocol", choices=("curve", "budget"), required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--steps", nargs="+", type=int, default=STEPS)
    parser.add_argument("--budgets", nargs="+", type=float, choices=BUDGETS, default=BUDGETS)
    parser.add_argument("--repeats", type=int, default=2)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.offset < 0 or min(args.samples, args.repeats, args.seeds_per_graph, *args.steps) < 1:
        parser.error("Use a nonnegative offset and positive graph/seed/repeat/step counts")
    if len(set(args.budgets)) != len(args.budgets):
        parser.error("Use distinct budgets")
    if not math.isfinite(args.oracle_amplitude) or args.oracle_amplitude < 0:
        parser.error("Use a finite nonnegative oracle amplitude")
    evaluate(args)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

FILE: models/closed/eval_structure.py

"""Fixed-work and deadline evaluation of the structural compensation.

Reuses ``eval_v3.evaluate`` so the search, A.3 decoding, PAVE post-processing and
the two budget protocols stay identical to the frozen-B records.
"""
import json
from pathlib import Path
from statistics import mean, median, quantiles, stdev

import torch

import eval_v3
from eval_v2 import ROOT, load_policy, write_run
from v7_runs import digest, pave, provenance


def main():
    parser = eval_v3.build_parser()
    parser.set_defaults(split="validation", post=["none", "pave"], horizon=1, mixed_precision="no")
    parser.add_argument("--reference_seed", type=int, choices=(0, 1, 2), required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--cuda-graph", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.structure_mode != "none" and (args.frequency != "none" or args.context_mode != "none"):
        parser.error("The structure evaluation cannot mix in another encoder")
    if set(args.post) - {"none", "pave"} or args.anchored or args.extra_value_checkpoint:
        parser.error("Use the original B or a structure checkpoint with frozen PAVE")
    expected = dict(num_k=20, num_d=5, beta=1.02, horizon=1, candidate_cap=32,
                    exchange_rounds=3, outer_rounds=8, improving_cap=48, repair_rounds=4,
                    post_reserve_s=0.05)
    for key, value in expected.items():
        if getattr(args, key) != value:
            parser.error(f"structure evaluation fixes {key}={value}")
    if args.num_t not in (100, 1000):
        parser.error("structure evaluation runs at T100 or T1000")
    if args.time_budget_s is not None:
        if args.time_budget_s not in (0.5, 1.0) or args.post != ["pave"]:
            parser.error("Use one PAVE policy and a 0.5 or 1.0 second budget")
        args.extended_search = True
    if args.split == "test":
        path = ROOT / "outputs/structure_v1/analysis/decision.json"
        if not path.is_file() or json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["status"] not in ("go", "advance"):
            parser.error("The author test requires a passing validation decision")
    args.backbone_seed = args.reference_seed
    args.head_seed = args.reference_seed
    args.value_checkpoint = pave(args.reference_seed) if "pave" in args.post else None
    args.result_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    model_metadata = {}

    def prepare(options):
        solver = load_policy(options)
        solver.cuda_graph_search = options.cuda_graph
        model = solver.accelerator.unwrap_model(solver.model)
        compensation = getattr(model, "compensation", None)
        if compensation is None:
            model_metadata["trainable_params"] = 0
            return solver
        model_metadata["trainable_params"] = sum(parameter.numel() for parameter in compensation.parameters())
        if compensation.use_gate:
            model_metadata["gate_tanh"] = [float(value) for value in compensation.gate.tanh().tolist()]
        if compensation.use_gain:
            model_metadata["gain_gate_tanh"] = float(compensation.gain_gate.tanh())
        if compensation.use_degree:
            model_metadata["degree_bias_norm"] = [float(layer.weight.square().sum().sqrt())
                                                  for layer in compensation.degree_proj]
        return solver

    source = provenance(args.reference_seed)
    rows = eval_v3.evaluate(args, policy_loader=prepare)
    for policy, records in rows.items():
        path = args.result_dir / policy
        data = json.loads((path / "run.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        sizes = [row["independent_set_size"] for row in records]
        times = [row["solve_time_s"] for row in records]
        data.update(**source, **model_metadata, version="structure_v1", arm=args.structure_mode,
                    ref=args.reference_seed, model_seed=args.train_seed,
                    checkpoint_sha256=digest(Path(args.save_dir) / "best.pt"), cuda_graph=args.cuda_graph,
                    graph_ids=[row["graph_id"] for row in records],
                    graph_size_sd=stdev(sizes) if len(sizes) > 1 else 0.,
                    p50_solve_s=median(times),
                    p95_solve_s=quantiles(times, n=100, method="inclusive")[94] if len(times) > 1 else times[0],
                    mean_search_steps=mean(row["search_steps"] for row in records),
                    fallback_count=sum(row["incumbent_fallback"] for row in records))
        write_run(path, data)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Fixed-work and deadline evaluation with identical frozen-B/PAVE pairing."""

import json
from pathlib import Path
from statistics import mean, median, quantiles, stdev

import torch

import eval_v3
from eval_v2 import ROOT, load_policy, write_run
from mis_static_prior import STATIC_FEATURES, STATIC_MODES
from v7_structure import FEATURES
from v7_runs import digest, pave, provenance


def main():
    parser = eval_v3.build_parser()
    parser.set_defaults(split="validation", post=["none", "pave"], horizon=1, mixed_precision="no")
    parser.add_argument("--reference_seed", type=int, choices=(0, 1, 2), required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--cuda-graph", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.frequency != "none" or set(args.post) - {"none", "pave"} or args.anchored or args.extra_value_checkpoint:
        parser.error("Use original B or a static context with frozen PAVE")
    expected = dict(num_k=20, num_t=100, num_d=5, beta=1.02, horizon=1, candidate_cap=32,
                    exchange_rounds=3, outer_rounds=8, improving_cap=48, repair_rounds=4, post_reserve_s=0.05)
    for key, value in expected.items():
        if getattr(args, key) != value:
            parser.error(f"v7 evaluation fixes {key}={value}")
    if args.time_budget_s is not None:
        if args.time_budget_s not in (0.5, 1.0) or args.post != ["pave"]:
            parser.error("Use one PAVE policy and a 0.5 or 1.0 second budget")
        args.extended_search = True
    if args.split == "test":
        path = ROOT / "outputs/v7_context/analysis/decision.json"
        if not path.is_file() or json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["status"] != "go_a":
            parser.error("The author test requires a passing validation decision")
    args.backbone_seed = args.reference_seed
    args.head_seed = args.reference_seed
    args.value_checkpoint = pave(args.reference_seed) if "pave" in args.post else None
    args.result_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    model_metadata = {}

    def prepare(options):
        solver = load_policy(options)
        solver.cuda_graph_search = options.cuda_graph
        model = solver.accelerator.unwrap_model(solver.model)
        if solver.v7_context:
            norm = model.adapter
            from hashlib import sha256
            if hasattr(norm, "feature_mean"):
                model_metadata["feature_norm_sha256"] = sha256(norm.feature_mean.cpu().numpy().tobytes()
                                                                + norm.feature_std.cpu().numpy().tobytes()).hexdigest()
            model_metadata["adapter_params"] = sum(p.numel() for p in norm.parameters())
        else:
            model_metadata["adapter_params"] = 0
        return solver

    source = provenance(args.reference_seed)
    if args.context_mode in STATIC_MODES:
        source["static_feature_schema"] = ((STATIC_FEATURES if args.static_features == 5 else FEATURES)
                                           if args.context_mode == "static_centered" else ())
    rows = eval_v3.evaluate(args, policy_loader=prepare)
    for policy, records in rows.items():
        path = args.result_dir / policy
        data = json.loads((path / "run.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        sizes = [row["final_size"] for row in records]
        times = [row["solve_time_s"] for row in records]
        data.update(**source, **model_metadata, version="v7_context", arm=args.context_mode,
                    ref=args.reference_seed, model_seed=args.train_seed, order_seed=args.v7_order_seed,
                    checkpoint_sha256=digest(Path(args.save_dir) / "best.pt"), cuda_graph=args.cuda_graph,
                    graph_ids=[row["graph_id"] for row in records], peak_memory_mib=data["peak_memory_mib"],
                    graph_size_sd=stdev(sizes) if len(sizes) > 1 else 0.,
                    p50_solve_s=median(times), p95_solve_s=quantiles(times, n=100, method="inclusive")[94] if len(times) > 1 else times[0],
                    mean_search_steps=mean(row["search_steps"] for row in records),
                    fallback_count=sum(row["incumbent_fallback"] for row in records))
        write_run(path, data)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

FILE: models/closed/eval_v7_tccr.py

"""Fixed-work pipeline evaluation: does trajectory recombination survive frozen PAVE?

The census showed that the K=20 A.3 solutions of the frozen search can be
recombined into a strictly larger legal set on most graphs.  The deployment
question is different: the frozen baseline is ``B + PAVE``, so recombination only
matters if it adds something *on top of* the frozen post-processing, and if the
cost fits the protocol.

For every graph and search seed this script records four legal sets:

    a3          A.3 argmax over the K=20 particles      (the frozen "none" arm)
    recombine   exhaustive exact recombination of all K*(K-1)/2 pairs
    pave        frozen PAVE-Stats H1 started from a3
    recombine+pave  the same frozen PAVE started from the recombined set

Nothing is trained.  PAVE, its parameters and its step budget are untouched; the
only new work is the recombination pass.

    python -u models/eval_v7_tccr.py --reference_seed 0 --save_dir outputs/v2/none_seed0/checkpoints \
        --result_dir outputs/v7_tccr/pipeline --split validation --test_samples 100 --seeds 1017 1019 1021
"""
import json
from math import inf
from pathlib import Path
from statistics import mean
from time import perf_counter

import torch

import mis_v7_recombine as recombine
from diagnose_v7_census import build_parser, captured_best_states, solution_masks, validate, write_csv
from eval_v2 import dataset_at, load_policy, sync, write_run
from mis_v1 import adjacency
from mis_v3_search import SearchGraph, platform_search
from mis_v3_value import PAVEV3
from v7_runs import digest, pave, provenance


def main():
    import argparse

    parser = build_parser()
    parser.set_defaults(pair_budget=0)  # 0 evaluates every pair; a positive value keeps the Hamming prefix
    args = parser.parse_args()
    validate(parser, args)
    if args.phase != "recombine":
        parser.error("the pipeline evaluation reuses the census parser with --phase recombine")
    args.result_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    output = args.result_dir / "pipeline"
    output.mkdir(exist_ok=True)

    solver = load_policy(args)
    solver.cuda_graph_search = args.cuda_graph
    solver.model.requires_grad_(False)
    checkpoint = torch.load(pave(args.reference_seed), map_location="cpu", weights_only=False)
    ranker = PAVEV3(checkpoint["mode"], checkpoint.get("stats_dim", 24))
    ranker.load_state_dict(checkpoint["model_state"])
    ranker = ranker.cpu().eval()
    device = solver.accelerator.device
    dataset = dataset_at(args.test_path, solver.dtype, args.test_samples, official=args.split == "test")

    warm = dataset[0].to(device)
    warm_adj = adjacency(warm)
    captured_best_states(solver, warm, warm_adj, args.seeds[0])
    sync(device)

    def run_pave(topology, selected):
        result = platform_search(topology, selected, choose=ranker.choose,
                                 outer_rounds=args.outer_rounds,
                                 initial_rounds=args.exchange_rounds, horizon=args.horizon,
                                 candidate_cap=args.candidate_cap,
                                 improving_cap=args.improving_cap,
                                 repair_rounds=args.repair_rounds, anchored=False, deadline=inf)
        return result.best

    rows = []
    started = perf_counter()
    for index, graph in enumerate(dataset):
        graph_id = f"idx_{index}" if args.split == "test" else Path(dataset.files[index]).stem
        edges = graph.edge_index
        graph = graph.to(device)
        adj = adjacency(graph)
        for seed in args.seeds:
            topology = SearchGraph(graph.num_nodes, edges, seed=seed)
            neighbours = topology.neighbors
            search_started = perf_counter()
            best_states, _ = captured_best_states(solver, graph, adj, seed)
            sync(device)
            decode_started = perf_counter()
            masks = solution_masks(solver.problem, best_states, adj, graph.b)
            decode_seconds = perf_counter() - decode_started
            a3 = max(masks, key=int.bit_count)
            search_seconds = perf_counter() - search_started
            recombine_started = perf_counter()
            if args.pair_budget:
                order = recombine.select_pairs(masks, "hamming")[:args.pair_budget]
                merged = a3
                for i, j in order:
                    candidate = recombine.recombine(masks[i], masks[j], neighbours).candidate
                    if candidate.bit_count() > merged.bit_count():
                        merged = candidate
                merged_gain = merged.bit_count() - a3.bit_count()
            else:
                merged, merged_gain, _, _ = recombine.best_recombination(masks, neighbours)
            recombine_seconds = perf_counter() - recombine_started
            for mask in (a3, merged):
                if not recombine.is_independent(mask, neighbours):
                    raise ValueError(f"{graph_id}: illegal set before PAVE")
            pave_started = perf_counter()
            paved_a3 = run_pave(topology, a3)
            pave_a3_seconds = perf_counter() - pave_started
            pave_started = perf_counter()
            paved_merged = run_pave(topology, merged)
            pave_merged_seconds = perf_counter() - pave_started
            for mask in (paved_a3, paved_merged):
                if not recombine.is_independent(mask, neighbours):
                    raise ValueError(f"{graph_id}: PAVE returned an illegal set")
            rows.append(dict(graph_id=graph_id, search_seed=seed, num_k=len(masks),
                             a3_size=a3.bit_count(), recombine_size=merged.bit_count(),
                             recombine_gain=merged_gain,
                             pave_size=paved_a3.bit_count(),
                             recombine_pave_size=paved_merged.bit_count(),
                             recombine_pave_gain=paved_merged.bit_count() - paved_a3.bit_count(),
                             pave_gain=paved_a3.bit_count() - a3.bit_count(),
                             search_ms=round(1e3 * search_seconds, 2),
                             decode_ms=round(1e3 * decode_seconds, 2),
                             recombine_ms=round(1e3 * recombine_seconds, 2),
                             pave_ms=round(1e3 * pave_a3_seconds, 2),
                             recombine_pave_ms=round(1e3 * pave_merged_seconds, 2),
                             pairs=(len(masks) * (len(masks) - 1) // 2) if not args.pair_budget else args.pair_budget))
            sync(device)
        if (index + 1) % 20 == 0 or index + 1 == len(dataset):
            print(f"{index + 1}/{len(dataset)} graphs, "
                  f"a3={mean(row['a3_size'] for row in rows):.4f}, "
                  f"recombine={mean(row['recombine_size'] for row in rows):.4f}, "
                  f"pave={mean(row['pave_size'] for row in rows):.4f}, "
                  f"recombine+pave={mean(row['recombine_pave_size'] for row in rows):.4f}", flush=True)
    finished = perf_counter()
    write_csv(output / f"pipeline_ref{args.reference_seed}.csv", rows)
    metadata = dict(version="v7_tccr", status="completed", mode="pipeline",
                           ref=args.reference_seed, seeds=args.seeds, split=args.split,
                           samples=len(dataset), graphs=len(dataset),
                           wall_time_s=round(finished - started, 2),
                           pair_budget=args.pair_budget,
                           checkpoint_sha256=digest(Path(args.save_dir) / "best.pt"),
                           mean_a3=mean(row["a3_size"] for row in rows),
                           mean_recombine=mean(row["recombine_size"] for row in rows),
                           mean_pave=mean(row["pave_size"] for row in rows),
                           mean_recombine_pave=mean(row["recombine_pave_size"] for row in rows),
                    config=vars(args), **provenance(args.reference_seed))
    (output / f"run_ref{args.reference_seed}.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(metadata, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False, default=str) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"wrote {output} in {finished - started:.1f}s", flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()


========================================================================
FILE: models/closed/probe_direction_agreement.py

"""Measure how much of an oracle direction a trained static prior recovered.

Sweeps ``bias = peak * rescale((1 - lam) * learned + lam * oracle)`` on the
locked validation cohort with identical search seeds, so the lambda curve reads
as "fraction of the oracle effect recovered by the learned direction".
``lam=0`` reproduces ``amp@<peak>`` and ``lam=1`` reproduces ``oracle-kamis@<peak>``.
"""
import argparse
import csv
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import torch

from eval_static_prior_v2 import add_common, cohort, load_arm_policy, search_seeds
from eval_v2 import search, sync, write_run
from mis_static_prior import bias_stats, oracle_bias
from mis_v1 import adjacency
from mis_v3_search import SearchGraph, node_mask, nodes, platform_search
from mis_v3_value import load_pave_v3
from v7_runs import digest, pave, provenance


def rescale(values):
    """Divide by the largest absolute entry so the peak equals one."""
    return values / values.abs().amax().clamp_min(1e-12)


def centred(values):
    return values - values.mean(0, keepdim=True)


def ranks(values):
    return torch.argsort(torch.argsort(values)).float()


def agreement(learned, oracle):
    """Cosine and rank statistics between the learned and oracle node orders."""
    left, right = centred(learned), centred(oracle)
    cosine = float((left.flatten() @ right.flatten())
                   / (left.norm() * right.norm()).clamp_min(1e-12))
    first, second = ranks(learned[:, 0]), ranks(oracle[:, 0])
    spread = (first - first.mean()).norm() * (second - second.mean()).norm()
    spearman = float(((first - first.mean()) @ (second - second.mean())) / spread.clamp_min(1e-12))
    k = max(1, int((oracle[:, 0] > 0).sum()))
    overlap = len(set(learned[:, 0].topk(k).indices.tolist())
                  & set(oracle[:, 0].topk(k).indices.tolist())) / k
    return dict(cosine=cosine, spearman_rank=spearman, top_overlap=overlap, target_size=k)


@torch.no_grad()
def direction_of(args, tag):
    policy, checkpoint, record = load_arm_policy(args, Path(args.checkpoint if tag == "primary" else args.reference_checkpoint))
    adapter = policy.accelerator.unwrap_model(policy.model).adapter
    if not getattr(adapter, "centered", False):
        raise ValueError(f"{tag} checkpoint has no node direction to compare")
    return policy, adapter, checkpoint, record


@torch.no_grad()
def run(args):
    dataset, graph_ids = cohort(args)
    policy, adapter, checkpoint, record = direction_of(args, "primary")
    reference_policy = reference_adapter = reference_path = None
    if args.reference_checkpoint is not None:
        reference_policy, reference_adapter, reference_path, _ = direction_of(args, "reference")
    device = policy.accelerator.device
    targets = json.loads(args.oracle_kamis_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    missing = [gid for gid in graph_ids if gid not in targets]
    if missing:
        raise ValueError(f"{args.oracle_kamis_path} lacks {missing[0]}")
    ranker = load_pave_v3(pave(args.ref))
    rows = []
    agreement_rows = []
    for index, graph in enumerate(dataset, start=args.offset):
        gid = graph_ids[index - args.offset]
        first_seed = search_seeds(index, 1)[0]
        checker = SearchGraph(graph.num_nodes, graph.edge_index, seed=first_seed)
        target = targets[gid]
        if not checker.feasible(node_mask(target)):
            raise ValueError(f"Conflicting oracle target on {gid}")
        graph = graph.to(device)
        adj = adjacency(graph)
        policy.static_intervention = None
        topology = policy.policy_topology(graph, adj)
        learned = centred(adapter.direction(topology))
        oracle = oracle_bias(graph.num_nodes, target, 1., device)
        stats = agreement(learned, oracle)
        if reference_policy is not None:
            reference_policy.static_intervention = None
            reference = centred(reference_adapter.direction(reference_policy.policy_topology(graph, adj)))
            stats.update(reference_cosine=agreement(learned, reference)["cosine"])
        agreement_rows.append(stats)
        biases = {}
        for lam in args.lambdas:
            biases[lam] = args.peak * rescale((1 - lam) * rescale(learned) + lam * oracle)
        if abs(args.lambdas[0]) < 1e-9:
            assert torch.allclose(biases[args.lambdas[0]].abs().amax(),
                                  torch.tensor(args.peak, device=device), atol=1e-5)
        if abs(args.lambdas[-1] - 1) < 1e-9:
            assert torch.allclose(biases[args.lambdas[-1]],
                                  oracle_bias(graph.num_nodes, target, args.peak, device), atol=1e-6)
        for lam in args.lambdas:
            mixed = biases[lam]

            def intervention(_adapter, _topology, _graph, mixed=mixed):
                return mixed

            policy.static_intervention = intervention
            policy.num_t = args.steps
            for seed in search_seeds(index, args.seeds_per_graph):
                legal = SearchGraph(graph.num_nodes, graph.edge_index, seed=seed)
                selected, used = search(policy, graph, legal, seed)
                if not legal.feasible(selected):
                    raise ValueError(f"Infeasible search result on {gid}")
                improved = platform_search(legal, selected, choose=ranker.choose, horizon=1).best
                if not legal.feasible(improved):
                    raise ValueError(f"Infeasible PAVE result on {gid}")
                rows.append(dict(graph_id=gid, search_seed=seed, lam=lam, steps=used,
                                 bias_rms=bias_stats(mixed)["bias_rms"],
                                 node_bias_rms=bias_stats(mixed)["node_bias_rms"],
                                 base_size=selected.bit_count(), final_size=improved.bit_count(),
                                 selected_nodes=" ".join(map(str, nodes(improved))), **stats))
        sync(device)
        if (index - args.offset + 1) % 10 == 0 or index - args.offset + 1 == len(dataset):
            print(f"lambda probe {index - args.offset + 1}/{len(dataset)}", flush=True)
    args.output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    with (args.output / "per_graph.csv").open("w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
        writer = csv.DictWriter(stream, fieldnames=list(rows[0]))
        writer.writeheader()
        writer.writerows(rows)
    summary = {}
    for lam in args.lambdas:
        sizes = np.array([row["final_size"] for row in rows if row["lam"] == lam], dtype=float)
        summary[str(lam)] = dict(mean_size=float(sizes.mean()), size_sd=float(sizes.std(ddof=1)))
    summary["agreement"] = {key: float(np.mean([row[key] for row in agreement_rows]))
                            for key in ("cosine", "spearman_rank", "top_overlap", "target_size")}
    if reference_policy is not None:
        summary["agreement"]["reference_cosine"] = float(np.mean([row["reference_cosine"]
                                                                  for row in agreement_rows]))
    write_run(args.output, dict(**provenance(args.ref), version="direction_probe", status="completed",
                                backend=args.backend, checkpoint=digest(checkpoint), peak=args.peak,
                                steps=args.steps, seeds_per_graph=args.seeds_per_graph,
                                lambdas=args.lambdas, graph_ids=graph_ids,
                                oracle_sha256=digest(args.oracle_kamis_path), summary=summary,
                                reference_checkpoint=(digest(reference_path)
                                                      if reference_path else None),
                                train_arm=record.get("arm"), train_version=record.get("version")))
    print(json.dumps(summary, indent=2))


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    add_common(parser)
    parser.add_argument("--steps", type=int, default=100)
    parser.add_argument("--peak", type=float, default=.5)
    parser.add_argument("--lambdas", nargs="+", type=float, default=[0., .25, .5, .75, 1.])
    parser.add_argument("--reference-checkpoint", type=Path,
                        help="Second adapter; reports cosine(learned, reference) to detect drift")
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.oracle_kamis_path is None:
        parser.error("--oracle-kamis-path is required")
    if args.checkpoint is None:
        parser.error("--checkpoint is required")
    if not args.lambdas or min(args.lambdas) < 0 or max(args.lambdas) > 1:
        parser.error("Use lambdas within [0, 1]")
    if not (math.isfinite(args.peak) and args.peak > 0) or args.steps < 1 or args.seeds_per_graph < 1:
        parser.error("Use a positive finite peak, step count and seed count")
    run(args)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Isolated paired P0 timing, with graph preparation inside the clock."""

import argparse
import csv
from pathlib import Path
from statistics import mean, median, quantiles
from time import perf_counter

import torch

from eval_v2 import TRAIN, dataset_at, search, sync, write_run
from mis_v3_search import SearchGraph, platform_search
from mis_v3_value import load_pave_v3
from v7_runs import pave, preflight_policy, provenance


def budget_probe(args, policies, ranker, dataset, device):
    rows = []
    for i, graph in enumerate(dataset):
        gid = Path(dataset.files[i]).stem
        seed = 1017 + i
        edges = graph.edge_index
        graph = graph.to(device)
        for budget in (.5, 1.):
            names = list(policies) if i % 2 == 0 else list(reversed(policies))
            for name in names:
                policy = policies[name]
                policy.num_t = 10000
                sync(device)
                tick = perf_counter()
                deadline = tick + budget
                legal = SearchGraph(graph.num_nodes, edges, seed=seed)
                selected, steps = search(policy, graph, legal, seed, deadline=deadline-.05)
                fallback = not selected
                if fallback:
                    selected = 1 << legal.greedy_order[0]
                result = platform_search(legal, selected, choose=ranker.choose, horizon=1, deadline=deadline)
                elapsed = perf_counter()-tick
                assert legal.feasible(result.best)
                rows.append(dict(graph_id=gid, arm=name, budget=budget, search_steps=steps,
                                 solve_s=elapsed, overrun=int(elapsed > budget), fallback=int(fallback)))
    return rows


@torch.no_grad()
def profile(args):
    device = torch.device("cuda")
    options = dict(ref=args.ref, width=args.width, d_state=args.d_state, cuda_graph=True)
    policies = {"baseline": preflight_policy("none", args.precision, **options),
                "mamba": preflight_policy("v7_mamba", args.precision, checkpoint=args.checkpoint, **options)}
    ranker = load_pave_v3(pave(args.ref))
    dataset = dataset_at(TRAIN, policies["baseline"].dtype, args.samples)
    for policy in policies.values():
        graph = dataset[0]
        legal = SearchGraph(graph.num_nodes, graph.edge_index, seed=1017)
        search(policy, graph.to(device), legal, 1017)
    if args.budget_probe:
        rows = budget_probe(args, policies, ranker, dataset, device)
        args.output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
        with (args.output / "per_graph.csv").open("w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
            writer = csv.DictWriter(stream, fieldnames=list(rows[0]))
            writer.writeheader()
            writer.writerows(rows)
        results = {}
        for budget in (.5, 1.):
            results[str(budget)] = {}
            for name in policies:
                subset = [r for r in rows if r["arm"] == name and r["budget"] == budget]
                results[str(budget)][name] = {key: mean(r[key] for r in subset)
                                               for key in ("search_steps", "solve_s", "overrun", "fallback")}
        write_run(args.output, dict(**provenance(args.ref), status="completed", split="train",
                                   width=args.width, precision=args.precision, results=results))
        return
    rows = []
    for i, graph in enumerate(dataset):
        gid = Path(dataset.files[i]).stem
        seed = 1017 + i
        edges = graph.edge_index
        graph = graph.to(device)
        for rep in range(args.repeats):
            names = list(policies) if (i + rep) % 2 == 0 else list(reversed(policies))
            for name in names:
                policy = policies[name]
                times = {}
                policy.context_timings = dict(static_features_s=0., ordering_s=0., context_s=0.)

                def observe(step, *_):
                    if step in (0, 100):
                        sync(device)
                        times[step] = perf_counter()

                sync(device)
                tick = perf_counter()
                legal = SearchGraph(graph.num_nodes, edges, seed=seed)
                selected, steps = search(policy, graph, legal, seed, observe=observe)
                sync(device)
                decoded = perf_counter()
                events = policy.context_timings.pop("_context_events", None)
                if events is not None:
                    policy.context_timings["context_s"] = events[0].elapsed_time(events[1]) / 1000
                improved = platform_search(legal, selected, choose=ranker.choose, horizon=1).best
                final = perf_counter()
                if not legal.feasible(selected) or not legal.feasible(improved):
                    raise ValueError(f"Infeasible solution for {gid}")
                rows.append(dict(graph_id=gid, arm=name, repeat=rep, search_steps=steps,
                                 base_size=selected.bit_count(), pave_size=improved.bit_count(),
                                 prepare_capture_s=times[0]-tick, rollout_s=times[100]-times[0],
                                 a3_s=decoded-times[100], pave_s=final-decoded,
                                 bare_s=decoded-tick, full_s=final-tick, **policy.context_timings))
    args.output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    with (args.output / "per_graph.csv").open("w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
        writer = csv.DictWriter(stream, fieldnames=list(rows[0]))
        writer.writeheader()
        writer.writerows(rows)
    paired = {}
    for name in policies:
        subset = [row for row in rows if row["arm"] == name]
        keys = ("bare_s", "full_s", "static_features_s", "ordering_s", "context_s",
                "prepare_capture_s", "rollout_s", "a3_s", "pave_s", "search_steps")
        paired[name] = {key: mean(row[key] for row in subset) for key in keys}
        times = [row["bare_s"] for row in subset]
        paired[name].update(p50_s=median(times), p95_s=quantiles(times, n=100, method="inclusive")[94])
    ratio = paired["mamba"]["bare_s"] / paired["baseline"]["bare_s"]
    record = dict(**provenance(args.ref), status="completed", split="train", precision=args.precision,
                  ref=args.ref, width=args.width, d_state=args.d_state, samples=len(dataset), repeats=args.repeats,
                  checkpoint=args.checkpoint, cuda_graph=True, device=torch.cuda.get_device_name(device),
                  ratio=ratio, pass_speed=ratio <= 1.08, timings=paired)
    write_run(args.output, record)
    print(f"{args.precision} width={args.width}: {ratio:.4f}x", flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--precision", choices=("no", "fp16"), required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--width", type=int, default=32)
    parser.add_argument("--d-state", type=int, default=16)
    parser.add_argument("--samples", type=int, default=20)
    parser.add_argument("--repeats", type=int, default=5)
    parser.add_argument("--ref", type=int, default=0)
    parser.add_argument("--checkpoint", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--budget-probe", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    profile(parser.parse_args())

# models/closed — 已关闭方法线的代码

这些文件不属于现行流程，也没有被 `models/` 下的活跃模块或 `train_scripts/` 引用。留在这里是为了让归档文档（`docs/已归档的想法和文件/`）里的路径仍然可读。

**它们不能原样运行**：同目录移动后，`from eval_v2 import ...` 这类平铺 import 会失效。要复跑某条线，先 `git show <commit>:models/<file>.py` 拿回根目录。

| 文件 | 属于 |
| --- | --- |
| `eval_structure.py`, `train_structure.py`, `mis_structure.py`（仍在根目录，`solvers.py` 引用） | 结构补偿线（v1/v2，No-go） |
| `eval_static_prior*.py`, `static_prior_protocol.py`, `diagnose_static_leverage.py`, `train_static_direction.py` | static prior 线（No-go） |
| `eval_v7_context.py`, `diagnose_v7_context.py`, `profile_v7_context.py`, `train_v7_context.py`, `check_v7.py`, `eval_v7_tccr.py` | v7 context / TCCR 线（budget_fail，已归档） |
| `train_exchange_value*.py`, `train_flip_value.py`, `probe_direction_agreement.py` | v2/v3 价值头与方向一致性探针 |
| `eval_author_rb.py` | 早期作者集单点评测（被 `eval_v8_capture_budget.py` 取代） |

"""Arm names for the static-prior dose and direction controls."""

DOSES = ("0.02", "0.125", "0.25", "0.5", "1", "2")
ORACLE_DOSES = ("0.5", "1", "2")
ORACLE_NAMES = ("oracle-kamis", "oracle-b", "anti-oracle")
AMPLITUDES = tuple(f"amp@{dose}" for dose in DOSES)
RANDOM_CONTROLS = tuple(f"rand@{dose}" for dose in DOSES)
ORACLES = tuple(f"{name}@{dose}" for name in ORACLE_NAMES for dose in ORACLE_DOSES)
P0_ARMS = ("b0", "amp@0", "null-rand", "centered", "v1-node-only") + AMPLITUDES + RANDOM_CONTROLS + ORACLES

"""Learn to rank feasible exchanges by their paired continuation quality."""
import csv
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from statistics import mean
from time import perf_counter

import torch
from scipy.stats import rankdata
from torch.nn import functional as F

from eval_v2 import TRAIN, dataset_at, load_policy, policy_parser, search, write_run
from mis_v2_exchange import ExchangeGraph, action_values
from mis_v2_value import PAVE


@torch.no_grad()
def examples(args, solver, path, count, split):
    data = dataset_at(path, solver.dtype, count)
    states = []
    for index, graph in enumerate(data):
        topology = ExchangeGraph(graph.num_nodes, graph.edge_index)
        selected, _ = search(solver, graph.to(solver.accelerator.device), topology, args.seed + index)
        actions = topology.actions(selected, cap=args.candidate_cap, larger=args.larger)
        if actions:
            quality = action_values(topology, selected, actions, cap=args.candidate_cap,
                                    rounds=args.exchange_rounds, larger=args.larger)
            features = [topology.features(selected, action) for action in actions]
            heuristic = min(range(len(actions)), key=lambda i: topology.heuristic(selected, actions[i]))
            states.append((torch.tensor(features), torch.tensor(quality), heuristic))
        if (index + 1) % 50 == 0:
            print(f"{split} {index + 1}/{len(data)} graphs, {len(states)} with actions", flush=True)
    return states


def pairs(states):
    better, worse = [], []
    for features, quality, _ in states:
        first, second = torch.where(quality.unsqueeze(1) > quality.unsqueeze(0))
        better.append(features[first])
        worse.append(features[second])
    return torch.cat(better), torch.cat(worse)


@torch.no_grad()
def validate(model, states):
    rows = []
    for features, quality, heuristic in states:
        upper = quality.max()
        if quality.min() == upper:
            continue
        score = model(features)
        first, second = torch.where(quality.unsqueeze(1) > quality.unsqueeze(0))
        order = score[first] - score[second]
        concordance = (order.gt(0).float() + 0.5 * order.eq(0)).mean()
        rank_score = torch.as_tensor(rankdata(score))
        rank_quality = torch.as_tensor(rankdata(quality))
        correlation = torch.corrcoef(torch.stack((rank_score, rank_quality)))[0, 1].nan_to_num()
        predicted = quality[int(score.argmax())]
        rows.append(dict(
            top1=float(predicted == upper), heuristic_top1=float(quality[heuristic] == upper),
            rule_top1=float(quality[0] == upper), random_top1=float((quality == upper).float().mean()),
            pair_accuracy=float(concordance), spearman=float(correlation),
            predicted_size=float(predicted), heuristic_size=float(quality[heuristic]),
        ))
    return {key: mean(row[key] for row in rows) for key in rows[0]}


def main():
    parser = policy_parser()
    parser.set_defaults(split="validation", train_path=str(TRAIN), train_samples=500, test_samples=100, epochs=30, lr=0.001)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    result = args.result_dir
    checkpoints = result / "checkpoints"
    checkpoints.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    started_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    started = perf_counter()
    solver = load_policy(args)
    train = examples(args, solver, args.train_path, args.train_samples, "train")
    valid = examples(args, solver, args.test_path, args.test_samples, "validation")
    generation_time = perf_counter() - started
    train_informative = sum(quality.min() < quality.max() for _, quality, _ in train)
    val_informative = sum(quality.min() < quality.max() for _, quality, _ in valid)
    train_informative, val_informative = int(train_informative), int(val_informative)
    metadata = dict(version="v2", mode="value_train", run=result.name, config=vars(args),
                    train_seed=args.train_seed, train_states=len(train), val_states=len(valid),
                    train_informative=train_informative, val_informative=val_informative,
                    generation_time_s=generation_time, started_at=started_at)
    if not train_informative or not val_informative:
        write_run(result, dict(metadata, status="skipped", reason="no non-tied pairs in a split"))
        print("No non-tied comparisons in a split", flush=True)
        return
    better, worse = pairs(train)
    model = PAVE()
    optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=args.lr)
    rng = torch.Generator().manual_seed(args.train_seed)
    history = []
    best = None
    for epoch in range(1, args.epochs + 1):
        model.train()
        losses = []
        for batch in torch.randperm(len(better), generator=rng).split(256):
            loss = F.softplus(model(worse[batch]) - model(better[batch])).mean()
            optimizer.zero_grad()
            loss.backward()
            optimizer.step()
            losses.append(loss.item())
        model.eval()
        metrics = dict(epoch=epoch, loss=mean(losses), **validate(model, valid))
        history.append(metrics)
        key = metrics["top1"], metrics["pair_accuracy"]
        if best is None or key > (best["top1"], best["pair_accuracy"]):
            best = metrics
            torch.save(model.state_dict(), checkpoints / "best.pt")
        print(f"Epoch {epoch}: loss {metrics['loss']:.4f}, top1 {metrics['top1']:.3f}, pair {metrics['pair_accuracy']:.3f}", flush=True)
    with (result / "metrics.csv").open("w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
        writer = csv.DictWriter(stream, fieldnames=list(history[0]))
        writer.writeheader()
        writer.writerows(history)
    write_run(result, dict(metadata, status="completed", best=best, train_pairs=len(better),
                           finished_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), wall_time_s=perf_counter() - started))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()


========================================================================
FILE: models/closed/train_exchange_value_v3.py

"""Train state-balanced action rankings on fixed MIS continuation labels."""
import argparse
import csv
import json
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from statistics import mean
from time import perf_counter

import torch
from torch.nn import functional as F

from mis_v3_value import MODES, STATS_DIM, PAVEV3, collate_states, move_state, pack_groups


def non_tied_pairs(values):
    first, second = torch.triu_indices(len(values), len(values), offset=1)
    distinct = values[first] != values[second]
    first, second = first[distinct], second[distinct]
    first_better = values[first] > values[second]
    return torch.stack((torch.where(first_better, first, second),
                        torch.where(first_better, second, first)))


def load_states(path, split):
    states = torch.load(path, map_location="cpu", weights_only=False)
    if not isinstance(states, list):
        raise ValueError("Label files must contain a list of state dictionaries")
    for state in states:
        if state["split"] != split:
            raise ValueError(f"{path} contains split {state['split']}, expected {split}")
        state["stats"] = torch.as_tensor(state["stats"], dtype=torch.float32).reshape(-1, STATS_DIM)
        state["values"] = torch.as_tensor(state["values"], dtype=torch.float32).reshape(-1)
        if len(state["stats"]) != len(state["values"]):
            raise ValueError(f"Candidate features and values differ for {state['graph_id']}")
        state["_pairs"] = non_tied_pairs(state["values"])
    return states


def rule_value(state, rule):
    if len(state["values"]) == 0:
        return 0.0
    return float(state["values"][state["rule_indices"][rule]])


def strongest_rule(states):
    names = ("coverage", "degree", "random")
    gains = {name: mean(rule_value(state, name) for state in states) for name in names}
    return max(names, key=gains.get), gains


def average_ranks(values):
    return 1 + (values[:, None] > values).sum(1).float() + 0.5 * ((values[:, None] == values).sum(1) - 1)


def state_pair_loss(scores, pairs, max_pairs, generator):
    if pairs.shape[1] > max_pairs:
        chosen = torch.randperm(pairs.shape[1], generator=generator)[:max_pairs].to(pairs.device)
        pairs = pairs[:, chosen]
    better, worse = pairs
    return F.softplus(scores[worse] - scores[better]).mean()


@torch.no_grad()
def validate(model, states, rule, *, batches=None, batch_size=32):
    model.eval()
    rows = []
    if model.mode == "stats":
        sizes = [len(state["values"]) for state in states]
        all_scores = model({"stats": torch.cat([state["stats"] for state in states])}).cpu()
        predictions = all_scores.split(sizes)
    else:
        if batches is None:
            batches = (collate_states(states[start:start + batch_size], model.mode)
                       for start in range(0, len(states), batch_size))
        predictions = (scores for batch in batches
                       for scores in model(batch).cpu().split(batch["candidate_sizes"]))
    for state, scores in zip(states, predictions):
        values = state["values"].cpu()
        pairs = state["_pairs"].cpu()
        row = dict(graph_id=state["graph_id"], origin=state.get("origin", "initial"),
                   deploy_stop=bool(state.get("deploy_stop", False)),
                   candidates=len(values), informative=bool(pairs.shape[1]),
                   selected_gain=0.0, rule_gain=rule_value(state, rule), oracle_gain=0.0,
                   selected_index=-1, pair_accuracy=None, top1=None, spearman=None)
        if len(values):
            selected = int(scores.argmax())
            upper = float(values.max())
            row.update(selected_gain=float(values[selected]), oracle_gain=upper, selected_index=selected)
            if pairs.shape[1]:
                order = scores[pairs[0]] - scores[pairs[1]]
                row["pair_accuracy"] = float((order.gt(0).float() + 0.5 * order.eq(0)).mean())
                row["top1"] = float(values[selected] == upper)
                rank_score, rank_value = average_ranks(scores), average_ranks(values)
                rank_score -= rank_score.mean()
                rank_value -= rank_value.mean()
                norm = rank_score.norm() * rank_value.norm()
                if float(norm) > 0:
                    row["spearman"] = float((rank_score * rank_value).sum() / norm)
        row["delta_vs_rule"] = row["selected_gain"] - row["rule_gain"]
        row["regret"] = row["oracle_gain"] - row["selected_gain"]
        rows.append(row)

    def summarize(subset):
        result = dict(states=len(subset), candidate_states=sum(row["candidates"] > 0 for row in subset),
                      informative_states=sum(row["informative"] for row in subset),
                      informative_graphs=len({row["graph_id"] for row in subset if row["informative"]}))
        for key in ("selected_gain", "rule_gain", "oracle_gain", "delta_vs_rule", "regret"):
            result[key] = mean(row[key] for row in subset)
        result["informative_coverage"] = result["informative_states"] / len(subset)
        positive = [row for row in subset if row["oracle_gain"] > 0]
        result["positive_oracle_coverage"] = len(positive) / len(subset)
        result["positive_hit_rate"] = mean(row["selected_gain"] > 0 for row in positive) if positive else None
        for key in ("pair_accuracy", "top1", "spearman"):
            measured = [row[key] for row in subset if row[key] is not None]
            result[f"informative_{key}"] = mean(measured) if measured else None
        return result

    metrics = summarize(rows)
    by_origin = {origin: summarize([row for row in rows if row["origin"] == origin])
                 for origin in sorted({row["origin"] for row in rows})}
    return metrics, by_origin, rows


def write_json(path, data):
    path.write_text(json.dumps(data, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False, default=str) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")


def write_csv(path, rows):
    if rows:
        with path.open("w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
            writer = csv.DictWriter(stream, fieldnames=list(rows[0]))
            writer.writeheader()
            writer.writerows(rows)


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--train-data", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--valid-data", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--result-dir", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--mode", choices=MODES, default="stats")
    parser.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=0)
    parser.add_argument("--device", default="cuda:0" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
    parser.add_argument("--epochs", type=int, default=30)
    parser.add_argument("--batch-size", type=int, default=32)
    parser.add_argument("--max-pairs", type=int, default=64)
    parser.add_argument("--lr", type=float)
    parser.add_argument("--cpu-threads", type=int, default=1)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    torch.set_num_threads(args.cpu_threads)
    torch.manual_seed(args.seed)
    generator = torch.Generator().manual_seed(args.seed)
    started = perf_counter()
    started_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    result = args.result_dir
    result.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    train, valid = load_states(args.train_data, "train"), load_states(args.valid_data, "validation")
    if not train or not valid:
        raise ValueError("Training and validation label files must both contain deployment states")
    overlap = {state["graph_id"] for state in train} & {state["graph_id"] for state in valid}
    if overlap:
        raise ValueError(f"Training and validation share {len(overlap)} graph identifiers")
    rule, rule_gains = strongest_rule(valid)
    informative = [state for state in train if state["_pairs"].shape[1]]
    metadata = dict(version="v3", mode="value_train", model=args.mode, train_seed=args.seed,
                    config=vars(args), started_at=started_at, train_states=len(train), val_states=len(valid),
                    train_informative=len(informative),
                    train_informative_graphs=len({state["graph_id"] for state in informative}),
                    val_informative=sum(bool(state["_pairs"].shape[1]) for state in valid),
                    strongest_rule=rule, validation_rule_gains=rule_gains)
    if not informative or not metadata["val_informative"]:
        write_json(result / "run.json", dict(metadata, status="skipped", reason="no informative ranking states"))
        return
    model = PAVEV3(args.mode).to(args.device)
    learning_rate = args.lr if args.lr is not None else (1e-3 if args.mode == "stats" else 3e-4)
    optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=learning_rate)
    # Statistics fit on one device; node encoders transfer one packed graph batch.
    validation_batches = None
    if args.mode == "stats":
        informative = [move_state(state, args.device) for state in informative]
        valid = [move_state(state, args.device) for state in valid]
    else:
        for state in informative + valid:
            if len(state["stats"]):
                for name in ("removed", "added", "affected"):
                    state[name] = pack_groups(state[name])
        validation_batches = [collate_states(valid[start:start + args.batch_size], args.mode)
                              for start in range(0, len(valid), args.batch_size)]
    checkpoints = result / "checkpoints"
    checkpoints.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    history, best, best_key = [], None, None
    for epoch in range(1, args.epochs + 1):
        model.train()
        epoch_losses = []
        order = torch.randperm(len(informative), generator=generator)
        for batch in order.split(args.batch_size):
            losses = []
            batch_states = [informative[index] for index in batch.tolist()]
            packed = collate_states(batch_states, args.mode)
            all_scores = model(packed)
            predictions = all_scores.split(packed["candidate_sizes"])
            for state, scores in zip(batch_states, predictions):
                pairs = state["_pairs"].to(scores.device)
                losses.append(state_pair_loss(scores, pairs, args.max_pairs, generator))
            loss = torch.stack(losses).mean()
            optimizer.zero_grad()
            loss.backward()
            optimizer.step()
            epoch_losses.extend(float(value.detach()) for value in losses)
        metrics, by_origin, rows = validate(model, valid, rule, batches=validation_batches,
                                          batch_size=args.batch_size)
        row = dict(epoch=epoch, loss=mean(epoch_losses), elapsed_s=perf_counter() - started, **metrics)
        history.append(row)
        key = metrics["delta_vs_rule"], -metrics["regret"]
        if best_key is None or key > best_key:
            best_key, best = key, row
            torch.save(dict(mode=args.mode, stats_dim=STATS_DIM, model_state=model.state_dict(),
                            strongest_rule=rule, seed=args.seed, epoch=epoch, metrics=metrics),
                       checkpoints / "best.pt")
            write_json(result / "best_validation.json", dict(metrics=metrics, by_origin=by_origin))
            write_csv(result / "best_validation_per_state.csv", rows)
        write_csv(result / "metrics.csv", history)
        print(f"Epoch {epoch}: loss {row['loss']:.4f}, gain-vs-{rule} {metrics['delta_vs_rule']:+.5f}, "
              f"regret {metrics['regret']:.5f}, informative {metrics['informative_states']}/{metrics['states']}",
              flush=True)
    write_json(result / "run.json", dict(metadata, status="completed", best=best,
               params=sum(parameter.numel() for parameter in model.parameters()), learning_rate=learning_rate,
               finished_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), wall_time_s=perf_counter() - started))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

FILE: models/closed/train_flip_value.py

"""Fit a flip-value head on paired continuations of a frozen RLNN policy."""
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import json
from pathlib import Path
from time import perf_counter

import torch
from torch.nn import functional as F
from torch.utils.data import DataLoader

from eval_v1 import ROOT
from main import build_parser, set_seed
from mis_v1 import FlipValue, adjacency
from models import edge2adj
from problems.mis import Dataset
from solvers import RLNN


def uniforms_like(tensor, generator):
    return torch.rand(tensor.shape, dtype=tensor.dtype, device=tensor.device, generator=generator)


@torch.no_grad()
def paired_examples(solver, graph, horizon, pairs, generator):
    adj = adjacency(graph)
    normalized = edge2adj(graph.edge_index, graph.num_nodes)
    features = []
    targets = []
    probes = {solver.num_t * i // 5 for i in range(1, 5)}
    for step, x in enumerate(solver.sample_states(graph, adj, generator=generator, normalized=normalized)):
        if step not in probes:
            continue
        states = x[:, :pairs]
        logits = solver.flip_logits(states, graph, adj, normalized)
        columns = torch.arange(pairs, device=x.device)
        nodes = torch.randint(graph.num_nodes, (pairs,), device=x.device, generator=generator)
        features.append(FlipValue.features(states, logits, adj, solver.problem.beta)[nodes, columns])
        shared = uniforms_like(states, generator)
        proposed = torch.where(shared < logits.sigmoid(), 1 - states, states)
        on, off = proposed.clone(), proposed.clone()
        on[nodes, columns] = 1 - states[nodes, columns]
        off[nodes, columns] = states[nodes, columns]
        branch = torch.cat((on, off), dim=1)
        for _ in range(horizon):
            prob = solver.flip_logits(branch, graph, adj, normalized).sigmoid()
            shared = uniforms_like(states, generator).repeat(1, 2)
            branch = torch.where(shared < prob, 1 - branch, branch)
        size = -solver.problem.decode_gradient_flip(branch, adj, graph.b).float()
        targets.append(size[:pairs] - size[pairs:])
        if step == max(probes):
            break
    return torch.cat(features), torch.cat(targets)


def collect(solver, folder, count, args, seed):
    data = Dataset(folder, solver.dtype, count)
    device = solver.accelerator.device
    features = []
    targets = []
    for index, graph in enumerate(DataLoader(data, batch_size=None, num_workers=args.num_workers, pin_memory=True)):
        generator = torch.Generator(device=device).manual_seed(seed + 2 * index)
        x, y = paired_examples(solver, graph.to(device), args.horizon, args.pairs, generator)
        features.append(x.cpu())
        targets.append(y.cpu())
        if (index + 1) % 100 == 0:
            print(f"{folder}: {index + 1}/{len(data)} graphs", flush=True)
    return torch.cat(features).to(device), torch.cat(targets).to(device)


def main():
    parser = build_parser()
    parser.set_defaults(method="RLNN", problem="mis", num_t=100, num_k=20, num_h=128,
                        num_l=5, mixed_precision="fp16", num_workers=4,
                        train_path=str(ROOT / "models/data/MIS_tensors/RB_small_train"),
                        valid_path=str(ROOT / "models/data/MIS_tensors/RB_small_val"),
                        test_path=str(ROOT / "models/data/author_rld4co/MIS/RB_small_test"),
                        train_samples=1000, valid_samples=100, lr=0.001, epochs=20)
    parser.add_argument("--horizon", type=int, default=4)
    parser.add_argument("--pairs", type=int, default=16)
    parser.add_argument("--result_dir", type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if not 1 <= args.pairs <= args.num_k or args.num_t < 5:
        parser.error("require 1 <= pairs <= num_k and at least five sampling steps")
    if args.do_train:
        parser.error("the RLNN policy is loaded frozen from --save_dir")
    set_seed(args.seed)
    solver = RLNN(args)
    solver.prepare()
    solver.model.eval()
    device = solver.accelerator.device
    result = args.result_dir
    result.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    checkpoint = result / "checkpoints"
    checkpoint.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    started = perf_counter()
    started_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    train_x, train_y = collect(solver, args.train_path, args.train_samples, args, args.seed)
    val_x, val_y = collect(solver, args.valid_path, args.valid_samples, args, args.seed + 1)
    generation_seconds = perf_counter() - started

    head = FlipValue().to(device)
    optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(head.parameters(), lr=args.lr)
    best = float("inf")
    history = []
    for epoch in range(1, args.epochs + 1):
        head.train()
        for selection in torch.randperm(len(train_y), device=device).split(1024):
            loss = F.smooth_l1_loss(head(train_x[selection]).squeeze(-1), train_y[selection])
            optimizer.zero_grad()
            loss.backward()
            optimizer.step()
        head.eval()
        with torch.no_grad():
            pred = head(val_x).squeeze(-1)
            mae = (pred - val_y).abs().mean().item()
        history.append({"epoch": epoch, "val_mae": mae})
        if mae < best:
            best = mae
            torch.save(head.state_dict(), checkpoint / "best.pt")
        print(f"Epoch {epoch}: validation MAE {mae:.4f}", flush=True)

    metadata = dict(version="v1", mode="value_train", status="completed", run=result.name,
                    config=vars(args), started_at=started_at, finished_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
                    wall_time_s=perf_counter() - started, generation_time_s=generation_seconds,
                    train_pairs=len(train_y), val_pairs=len(val_y), val_mae=best,
                    val_zero_mae=val_y.abs().mean().item(), val_delta=val_y.mean().item(),
                    val_positive_rate=(val_y > 0).float().mean().item(), history=history)
    (result / "run.json").write_text(json.dumps(metadata, indent=2, default=str) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
