#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
source "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/common.sh"
while [[ ! -f "$OUT/queue/validation_gpu0.done.txt" || ! -f "$OUT/queue/validation_gpu1.done.txt" ]]; do sleep 20; done

logged() {
  local name="$1" rc=0
  shift
  "$@" > "$OUT/queue/$name.log" 2>&1 || rc=$?
  printf '%s\n' "$rc" > "$OUT/queue/$name.exit_code.txt"
  return "$rc"
}

pids=()
index=0
for arm in none v4a_mlp v4a_message v4a; do
  for seed in 0 1 2; do
    gpu=$((index % 2))
    name="diagnostic_${arm}_seed${seed}"
    CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="$gpu" SEED="$seed" SAMPLES=20 SPECTRAL_GRAPHS=20 RUN_NAME="$name" \
      logged "$name" bash train_scripts/legacy/v4_frequency/diagnose.sh "$arm" &
    pids+=("$!")
    index=$((index + 1))
  done
done
failed=0
for pid in "${pids[@]}"; do wait "$pid" || failed=1; done
if ((failed)); then exit 1; fi
pids=()
for seed in 0 1 2; do
  name="utility_seed${seed}"
  CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="$((seed % 2))" SEED="$seed" MODEL_SEED="$seed" \
    TEACHER_CHECKPOINT="$(base_checkpoint "$seed")/best.pt" RUN_NAME="$name" \
    logged "$name" bash train_scripts/legacy/v4_frequency/probe_utility.sh \
      --model tuned none "$OUT/none_seed${seed}/checkpoints/best.pt" &
  pids+=("$!")
done
for pid in "${pids[@]}"; do wait "$pid" || failed=1; done
if ((failed)); then exit 1; fi
date -Is > "$OUT/queue/mechanism.done.txt"

interventions() {
  local gpu="$1" index=0 name seed intervention
  for intervention in low high gate; do
    for seed in 0 1 2; do
      if ((index % 2 == gpu)); then
        name="ablation_disable_${intervention}_seed${seed}"
        CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="$gpu" SEED="$seed" LABEL=v4a RUN_NAME="$name" SPLIT=validation \
          logged "$name" bash train_scripts/legacy/v4_frequency/eval.sh v4a "--disable-$intervention"
      fi
      index=$((index + 1))
    done
  done
}
interventions 0 &
first=$!
interventions 1 &
second=$!
wait "$first"
wait "$second"
date -Is > "$OUT/queue/interventions.done.txt"

FILE: train_scripts/legacy/v4_frequency/README.md

# v4 频域状态适配器

当前实验只改变 RLNN 搜索状态编码。PAVE 使用 `outputs/v3/stats_h1_seed{0,1,2}/checkpoints/best.pt`，24 维统计、H1、32 个中性候选、48 个严格改善候选、三轮初始规则交换、四轮修复与八轮平台搜索均沿用 v3。

## 模型与对照

动态信号为 `Z=[x,log1p(c)]`，`c=Ax`；图算子为二值无向图上的 `P=(I+D^-1 A)/2`。孤立节点的 P 为恒等。静态拓扑在一次求解中复用，状态描述每步重算。频带为 `L2=P²Z`、`B0=Z-PZ`、`B1=PZ-P²Z`，满足重构 `Z=L2+B0+B1`。

| arm | 两路输入 | 用途 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `none` | 原 RLNN | 同预算继续微调 |
| `v4a_mlp` | Z；x、logc、logdegree、logr | 状态统计与容量对照 |
| `v4a_message` | P²Z；Z、PZ | 同信息、同参数普通消息对照 |
| `v4a` | L2；B0、B1 | 双尺度频域候选 |
| `v4a_fixed` | 同 v4a，门控固定 0.5 | 门控消融 |

三种适配器使用相同的 2→16→128 与 4→16→128 分支、LayerNorm、六维门控输入与独立 sigmoid，两项可学习残差系数初值 0.01。共同门控含状态、度数、选中邻居数、释放数、裁剪能量差、尺度差强度。MLP 是容量对照；其门控仍能访问共同图统计。Message 输入保留 Z、PZ、P²Z，和频域三项线性等价。

## A1 训练协议

从同种子 v2 `none` 的已微调 RLNN 权重启动。种子为 0、1、2；每组 3 epoch、1000 张训练图、100 张验证图、每批 8 图 × 64 状态、6000 次优化更新、FP32、原 erdoes 主目标、Adam。适配器第 1 epoch 冻结骨干、学习率 1e-4，第 2–3 epoch 解冻并使用 2e-5；`none` 对照第一轮训练整个骨干，其他学习率和更新预算一致。

短期筛选使用冻结的同种子起始 RLNN 生成训练状态。教师每图 20 条轨迹、50 步，三组适配器共享图顺序和采样随机流。模型初始化完成后，将训练随机流重设为 `20261+seed`，消除各结构初始化所消耗随机数的差异。教师不参与梯度；学生仍学习原独立 Bernoulli 的一步期望能量和距离正则。训练状态只来自训练集。`STATE_SOURCE=on_policy` 提供原策略生成状态的训练入口，不能与共享教师状态结果混算。

每轮按验证随机流 1017+图序号、K=20/T=100 和 A.3 选择最优权重。正式筛选再次用同一批验证图记录 FP32 与 FP16 结果，以及加冻结 PAVE 前后的 Size；限时结果统一 FP16。所有权重与数据保存在服务器。

## 阶段决策

先运行 4 arm × 3 seed。主筛选口径为 FP32、固定搜索量、不加 PAVE：F4 相对 Message 和 MLP 都需要平均验证 Size 为正，且各至少两个种子严格改善。效率口径为 FP16、0.5 秒、冻结 PAVE：F4 的平均 Size 需超过固定旧骨干、Message 和 MLP。如果质量优势被额外时间抵消，就停止当前结构。`decide.py` 记录各项逐种子差值与阶段决策。未通过筛选时仍记录低/高/门控置零的机制诊断，但不利用测试集挑选结构。

通过后，F4 与相应 MLP/Message 对照统一进行 50 epoch 三种子训练，再展开 low/high、固定门控、释放统计和能量先验消融。动态任务图 v4-B 仅在静态版本显示独立价值后推进。每个阶段均保留不加 PAVE 与加同一个冻结 PAVE 的两张结果表。

## 执行

```bash
export PYTHON=/home/hzeng/envs/rlnn/bin/python
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 "$PYTHON" train_scripts/legacy/v4_frequency/check_adapter.py
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 SEED=0 bash train_scripts/legacy/v4_frequency/train.sh v4a
```

`RUN_NAME`、`EPOCHS`、`SEED`、`CHECKPOINT`、`BATCH_SIZE`、`GRAPH_BATCH_SIZE` 可指定实验；改变 batch 后必须在全部主对照统一使用，并报告实际更新数。默认保留 64×8，优先用独立训练进程填充两张 GPU。正式计时阶段每张卡只允许一个评测进程，计时包含构图、滤波、GCN、采样、A.3 与 PAVE。

训练输出为 `outputs/v4_frequency/<arm>_seed<seed>/run.json`、`training.csv` 和服务器上的 `checkpoints/`。逐图评测及诊断也写入 `outputs/v4_frequency/`。汇总使用三个种子均值的样本标准差，逐图配对保留图 ID 与种子，不把同一张图的三次采样当作三张独立图。

`screen.sh` 在两卡各启动六个独立训练；`validate.sh 0/1` 等待训练结束后，各自串行执行固定量和限时验证。强规则基线使用 20 ms 后处理预留，PAVE 使用既定 50 ms。`mechanism.sh` 等两卡计时任务均结束后运行三种子各 20 图频谱/门控诊断、真实翻转收益探针，再用独占卡完成 low/high/gate 的推理干预。分支干预复用已训练权重，不等同于从头训练的结构消融。

`strong_pave.sh` 在干预评测结束后，补充三种子原骨干＋冻结 PAVE 的持续搜索预算对照。仅放开骨干的步数上限，仍在0.5秒总预算内为同一个PAVE保留50 ms，其余PAVE配置保持一致。

## 本轮结果

12组训练、102份方法评测、12组频域诊断和3组收益探针已完成。F4在FP32固定量下为19.53000，普通消息为19.54667；0.5秒下F4＋PAVE为19.48000，原骨干持续搜索＋PAVE为19.65000。当前适配器未通过A1，保留v3 PAVE主线。完整均值、标准差、逐图差值和机制解释见[结果分析](../../../docs/已归档的想法和文件/RLNN_v4_Frequency_Results_Analysis.md)。

复算顺序为 `python tools/summarize_v4_mechanism.py`、`python train_scripts/legacy/v4_frequency/decide.py`、`python tools/analyze_v4_frequency.py`；工作簿使用提供 `@oai/artifact-tool` 的Node运行时执行 `tools/update_v4_workbook.mjs`。

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
source "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/common.sh"
mkdir -p "$OUT/queue"
arms=(none v4a_mlp v4a_message v4a)
pids=()
index=0
for arm in "${arms[@]}"; do
  for seed in 0 1 2; do
    gpu=$((index % 2))
    slot=$((index / 2))
    cpu_first=$((gpu * 24 + slot * 4))
    cpu_last=$((cpu_first + 3))
    run="${arm}_seed${seed}"
    (
      rc=0
      CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="$gpu" SEED="$seed" taskset -c "$cpu_first-$cpu_last" \
        bash "$ROOT/train_scripts/legacy/v4_frequency/train.sh" "$arm" > "$OUT/queue/$run.log" 2>&1 || rc=$?
      printf '%s\n' "$rc" > "$OUT/queue/$run.exit_code.txt"
      exit "$rc"
    ) &
    pids+=("$!")
    printf '%s GPU%s pid=%s\n' "$run" "$gpu" "$!" >> "$OUT/queue/screen.pids.txt"
    index=$((index + 1))
  done
done
failed=0
for pid in "${pids[@]}"; do wait "$pid" || failed=1; done
date -Is > "$OUT/queue/screen.finished.txt"
exit "$failed"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
source "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/common.sh"
while [[ ! -f "$OUT/queue/interventions.done.txt" ]]; do sleep 20; done

run_card() {
  local gpu="$1" seed name rc
  for seed in 0 1 2; do
    if ((seed % 2 != gpu)); then continue; fi
    name="budget_baseline_pave_extended_seed${seed}"
    rc=0
    CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="$gpu" SEED="$seed" LABEL=baseline \
      CHECKPOINT="$(base_checkpoint "$seed")" RUN_NAME="$name" \
      PRECISION=fp16 SPLIT=validation POST=pave \
      bash train_scripts/legacy/v4_frequency/eval_budget.sh none --extended-search \
      > "$OUT/queue/$name.log" 2>&1 || rc=$?
    printf '%s\n' "$rc" > "$OUT/queue/$name.exit_code.txt"
    if ((rc)); then return "$rc"; fi
  done
}
run_card 0 &
first=$!
run_card 1 &
second=$!
wait "$first"
wait "$second"
date -Is > "$OUT/queue/strong_pave.done.txt"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
source "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/common.sh"
export PYTORCH_ALLOC_CONF=backend:cudaMallocAsync
arm="${1:?pass none, v4a_mlp, v4a_message, or v4a}"
shift
seed="${SEED:-0}"
schedule=()
if [[ "$arm" != none ]]; then schedule+=(--freeze_backbone_epochs 1); fi
export PYTHONPATH="$ROOT/models${PYTHONPATH:+:$PYTHONPATH}"
exec "$PYTHON" -u "$ROOT/models/archived_frequency/train_v4_frequency.py" \
  --result_dir "$OUT/${RUN_NAME:-${arm}_seed${seed}}" \
  --frequency "$arm" --seed "$seed" --epochs "${EPOCHS:-3}" \
  --warm_start "${CHECKPOINT:-$(base_checkpoint "$seed")}/best.pt" \
  --state_source "${STATE_SOURCE:-teacher}" --finetune_lr 0.00002 "${schedule[@]}" \
  --graph_batch_size "${GRAPH_BATCH_SIZE:-8}" --batch_size "${BATCH_SIZE:-64}" \
  --lr 0.0001 --validation_seed 1017 --method RLNN --loss erdoes --problem mis \
  --train_path "$DATA/MIS_tensors/RB_small_train" --train_samples 1000 \
  --valid_path "$DATA/MIS_tensors/RB_small_val" --valid_samples 100 \
  --test_path "$DATA/MIS_tensors/RB_small_author_test" --num_workers 2 \
  --num_k 20 --num_t 100 --num_tp 50 --num_d 5 --num_l 5 --num_h 128 \
  --mixed_precision no --beta 1.02 --lambd 0.5 "$@"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
source "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/common.sh"
gpu="${1:?pass GPU 0 or 1}"
export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="$gpu"
while [[ ! -f "$OUT/queue/screen.finished.txt" ]]; do sleep 20; done
"$PYTHON" - "$OUT" <<'PY'
import json, sys
from pathlib import Path
out=Path(sys.argv[1])
for arm in ('none','v4a_mlp','v4a_message','v4a'):
    for seed in range(3):
        p=out/f'{arm}_seed{seed}'/'run.json'
        d=json.loads(p.read_text())
        if d['status'] != 'completed': raise SystemExit(f'Training incomplete: {p}')
PY

logged() {
  local name="$1" rc=0
  shift
  "$@" > "$OUT/queue/$name.log" 2>&1 || rc=$?
  printf '%s\n' "$rc" > "$OUT/queue/$name.exit_code.txt"
  return "$rc"
}

index=0
for precision in no fp16; do
  for label in baseline tuned v4a_mlp v4a_message v4a; do
    for seed in 0 1 2; do
      if ((index % 2 == gpu)); then
        arm="$label"
        train_run="${label}_seed${seed}"
        checkpoint="$OUT/$train_run/checkpoints"
        if [[ "$label" == baseline ]]; then arm=none; checkpoint="$(base_checkpoint "$seed")"; fi
        if [[ "$label" == tuned ]]; then arm=none; train_run="none_seed${seed}"; checkpoint="$OUT/$train_run/checkpoints"; fi
        name="val_${label}_${precision}_seed${seed}"
        SEED="$seed" LABEL="$label" CHECKPOINT="$checkpoint" TRAIN_RUN="$train_run" \
          RUN_NAME="$name" PRECISION="$precision" SPLIT=validation \
          logged "$name" bash train_scripts/legacy/v4_frequency/eval.sh "$arm"
      fi
      index=$((index + 1))
    done
  done
done
date -Is > "$OUT/queue/validation_fixed_gpu${gpu}.done.txt"

for label in baseline tuned v4a_mlp v4a_message v4a; do
  for seed in 0 1 2; do
    if ((index % 2 == gpu)); then
      arm="$label"
      checkpoint="$OUT/${label}_seed${seed}/checkpoints"
      if [[ "$label" == baseline ]]; then arm=none; checkpoint="$(base_checkpoint "$seed")"; fi
      if [[ "$label" == tuned ]]; then arm=none; checkpoint="$OUT/none_seed${seed}/checkpoints"; fi
      name="budget_${label}_pave_seed${seed}"

        PRECISION=fp16 SPLIT=validation POST=pave \
        logged "$name" bash train_scripts/legacy/v4_frequency/eval_budget.sh "$arm"
    fi
    index=$((index + 1))
  done
done
for post in none rule23; do
  for seed in 0 1 2; do
    if ((index % 2 == gpu)); then
      name="budget_baseline_${post}_extended_seed${seed}"
      SEED="$seed" LABEL=baseline CHECKPOINT="$(base_checkpoint "$seed")" RUN_NAME="$name" \
        PRECISION=fp16 SPLIT=validation POST="$post" \
        logged "$name" bash train_scripts/legacy/v4_frequency/eval_budget.sh none --extended-search --post-reserve-s 0.02
    fi

FILE: train_scripts/legacy/v5_frequency/check_adapter.py

"""Check scalar filters, backbone compatibility, graph batching and AMP."""
import argparse
import copy
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys

import torch

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3] / "models"))
from models import GCN
from archived_frequency.mis_v4_frequency import lazy_walk
from archived_frequency.mis_v5_frequency import V5DAFRGCN, V5_MODES, local_energy, v5_topology


def graph(nodes, pairs, device):
    edges = torch.tensor(pairs + [(j, i) for i, j in pairs], device=device, dtype=torch.long).reshape(-1, 2).T.contiguous()
    adj = torch.sparse_coo_tensor(edges, torch.full((edges.shape[1],), .5, device=device), (nodes, nodes)).to_sparse_csr()
    return edges, adj, v5_topology(edges, adj, nodes)


def run(device):
    torch.manual_seed(17)
    torch.set_num_threads(1)
    close = torch.testing.assert_close
    pairs = [(0, 1), (0, 2), (1, 2), (3, 4)]
    edges, adj, topo = graph(7, pairs, device)
    x = torch.randint(2, (7, 3), device=device).float()
    dense = topo.binary.to_dense()
    close(topo.binary @ x, 2 * (adj @ x), atol=0, rtol=0)
    delta = local_energy(x, dense @ x, 1.02)

    def energy(state):
        return (state * (1.02 * (dense @ state) / 2 - 1)).sum(0)

    for i in range(7):
        y = x.clone()
        y[i] = 1 - y[i]
        close(energy(y) - energy(x), delta[i])
    u = torch.randn(7, 3, 2, device=device)
    low = lazy_walk(u, topo)
    high = u - low
    close(low + high, u)
    close(high[5:], torch.zeros_like(high[5:]), atol=0, rtol=0)
    for component in (slice(0, 3), slice(3, 5)):
        close((topo.degree[component, :, None] * high[component]).sum(0),
              torch.zeros_like(high[0]), atol=2e-6, rtol=0)
    constant = torch.full_like(u, 3)
    close(lazy_walk(constant, topo), constant, atol=0, rtol=0)
    close(lazy_walk(u, graph(7, [], device)[2]), u, atol=0, rtol=0)
    base = GCN(1, 128, 5, 1).to(device)
    model = V5DAFRGCN(128, 5).to(device)
    missing, extra = model.load_state_dict(base.state_dict(), strict=False)
    assert set(missing) == {"adapter." + name for name in model.adapter.state_dict()} and not extra
    reference = base(x.unsqueeze(-1), edges, topo.normalized).squeeze(-1)
    close(model(x, edges, adj, topo), reference, atol=1e-6, rtol=1e-6)
    for step in range(2):
        model.zero_grad()
        correction = model.adapter(x, topo)
        (correction * torch.arange(7, device=device)[:, None]).sum().backward()
        grads = [p.grad.abs().sum().item() for p in model.adapter.parameters()]
        if step == 0:
            assert all(g > 0 for g in grads[:2]) and all(g == 0 for g in grads[2:])
            with torch.no_grad():
                for p in (model.adapter.theta_low, model.adapter.theta_high):
                    p.add_(p.grad, alpha=-.1)
        else:
            assert all(g > 0 for g in grads[2:])
    params = {}
    for mode in V5_MODES:
        arm = V5DAFRGCN(128, 5, mode=mode).to(device)
        params[mode] = sum(p.numel() for p in arm.parameters())
        assert torch.isfinite(arm(x, edges, adj, topo)).all()
    assert set(params.values()) == {165617}
    order = torch.tensor([3, 6, 0, 2, 4, 5, 1], device=device)
    inverse = order.argsort()
    moved = graph(7, [(int(inverse[i]), int(inverse[j])) for i, j in pairs], device)
    output = model(x, edges, adj, topo)
    close(model(x[order], *moved), output[order], atol=1e-5, rtol=1e-5)
    close(model(x[:, [2, 0, 1]], edges, adj, topo), output[:, [2, 0, 1]], atol=1e-5, rtol=1e-5)
    for k in (1, 20, 64, 1000):
        with torch.no_grad():
            close(model(x[:, :1].repeat(1, k), edges, adj, topo), output[:, :1].expand(-1, k), atol=1e-5, rtol=1e-5)
    second = [(0, 1), (1, 2)]
    g2 = graph(4, second, device)
    gb = graph(11, pairs + [(i + 7, j + 7) for i, j in second], device)
    x2 = 1 - x[:4]
    batched, separate = copy.deepcopy(model), copy.deepcopy(model)
    yb = batched(torch.cat((x, x2)), *gb)
    ys = torch.cat((separate(x, edges, adj, topo), separate(x2, *g2)))
    close(yb, ys, atol=1e-5, rtol=1e-5)
    for m, y in ((batched, yb), (separate, ys)):
        m.zero_grad()
        y.square().mean().backward()
    for p, q in zip(batched.parameters(), separate.parameters()):
        close(p.grad, q.grad, atol=1e-5, rtol=1e-5)
    if device.type == "cuda":
        model.zero_grad()
        with torch.autocast("cuda", dtype=torch.float16):
            y = model(x.half(), edges, adj.half(), topo)
            _, d = model.adapter(x.half(), topo, return_details=True)
        assert y.dtype == torch.float16 and d["counts"].dtype == torch.float32 and torch.isfinite(y).all()
        y.float().square().mean().backward()
        assert all(p.grad is not None and torch.isfinite(p.grad).all() for p in model.parameters())
    return dict(status="passed", device=str(device), params=params, adapter_params=112,
                learned_projection_gradients_after_first_update=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--device", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    result = json.dumps(run(torch.device(args.device)), indent=2)
    args.output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    args.output.write_text(result + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(result)

FILE: train_scripts/legacy/v5_frequency/decide.py

"""Summarize v5 evaluations and apply the preregistered quality and budget gates."""
import argparse
import csv
import json
from pathlib import Path
from statistics import mean, stdev

import numpy as np


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
OUT = ROOT / "outputs/v5_frequency"


def write(path, records):
    if records:
        with path.open("w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
            writer = csv.DictWriter(stream, fieldnames=list(records[0]))
            writer.writeheader()
            writer.writerows(records)


def load(root):
    runs, graphs, latency = [], {}, {}
    for path in sorted(root.glob("eval_*/*/run.json")):
        record = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        if record["status"] != "completed" or record["split"] != "validation":
            continue
        cfg = record["config"]
        key = (record["protocol"], cfg["mixed_precision"], record["post"],
               cfg.get("time_budget_s"), record["method"])
        seed = record["train_seed"]
        with path.with_name("per_graph.csv").open(encoding="utf-8", newline="") as stream:
            measurements = list(csv.DictReader(stream))
        rows = {row["graph_id"]: int(row["final_size"]) for row in measurements}
        if len(rows) != record["samples"] or (key, seed) in graphs:
            raise ValueError(f"Duplicate or incomplete evaluation: {path}")
        graphs[key, seed] = rows
        latency.setdefault(key, []).extend(float(row["solve_time_s"]) for row in measurements)
        runs.append(dict(protocol=key[0], precision=key[1], post=key[2], budget_s=key[3],
                         method=key[4], seed=seed, graphs=len(rows), mean_size=record["mean_size"],
                         mean_solve_s=record["mean_solve_time_s"], p95_s=record["p95_time_s"],
                         feasible_rate=record["feasible_rate"], params=record["params"],
                         peak_memory_mib=record["peak_memory_mib"], mean_steps=record["mean_search_steps"],
                         mean_post_s=record["mean_post_time_s"], deadline_overruns=record["deadline_overruns"],
                         max_overrun_s=record["max_deadline_overrun_s"]))
    return runs, graphs, latency


def compare(graphs, context, candidate, control):
    seeds = [seed for seed in range(3) if (context + (candidate,), seed) in graphs and
             (context + (control,), seed) in graphs]
    if not seeds:
        return None
    columns = []
    for seed in seeds:
        a, b = (graphs[context + (method,), seed] for method in (candidate, control))
        if a.keys() != b.keys():
            raise ValueError(f"Graph sets differ for {candidate}/{control}/seed{seed}")
        columns.append([a[gid]-b[gid] for gid in sorted(a)])
    delta = np.asarray(columns).T
    by_graph = delta.mean(1)
    rng = np.random.default_rng(20261109)
    draws = rng.choice(by_graph, size=(4000, len(by_graph)), replace=True).mean(1)
    return dict(protocol=context[0], precision=context[1], post=context[2], budget_s=context[3],
                candidate=candidate, control=control, seed_count=len(seeds), graph_count=len(by_graph),
                mean_delta=float(delta.mean()), ci_low=float(np.quantile(draws, .025)), ci_high=float(np.quantile(draws, .975)),
                positive_seeds=int((delta.mean(0) > 0).sum()), seed_deltas=json.dumps(dict(zip(seeds, delta.mean(0).tolist()))),
                wins=int((delta > 0).sum()), ties=int((delta == 0).sum()), losses=int((delta < 0).sum()))


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--root", type=Path, default=OUT)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    root = args.root
    runs, graphs, latency = load(root)
    out = root / "analysis"
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    cohorts = {}
    for run in runs:
        key = tuple(run[k] for k in ("protocol", "precision", "post", "budget_s", "method"))
        reference = graphs.get((key[:4] + ("baseline",), run["seed"]))
        run["delta_baseline"] = (run["mean_size"] - mean(reference.values())) if reference else None
        cohorts.setdefault(key, []).append(run)
    summary = []
    for key, group in cohorts.items():
        sizes = [row["mean_size"] for row in group]
        deltas = [row["delta_baseline"] for row in group if row["delta_baseline"] is not None]
        summary.append(dict(zip(("protocol", "precision", "post", "budget_s", "method"), key),
                            seed_count=len(group), mean_size=mean(sizes), size_seed_sd=stdev(sizes) if len(sizes) > 1 else None,
                            delta_baseline=mean(deltas) if deltas else None,
                            **{name: mean(row[name] for row in group) for name in
                               ("mean_solve_s", "feasible_rate", "params", "mean_steps", "mean_post_s")},
                            p95_s=float(np.quantile(latency[key], .95)),
                            peak_memory_mib=max(row["peak_memory_mib"] for row in group),
                            deadline_overruns=sum(row["deadline_overruns"] for row in group),
                            max_overrun_s=max(row["max_overrun_s"] for row in group)))
    pairs = []
    for context in sorted({key[:4] for key in cohorts}, key=str):
        for candidate in ("v5a", "v5a_conflict"):
            for control in ("baseline", "none", "analytic", "v5a_mlp", "v5a_message", "baseline_extended",
                            "baseline_rule23", "v5a_mlp_conflict", "v5a_message_conflict"):
                effect = compare(graphs, context, candidate, control)
                if effect:
                    pairs.append(effect)
    quality = [compare(graphs, ("fixed_work", "no", "none", None), "v5a", control)
               for control in ("baseline", "v5a_mlp", "v5a_message")]
    if any(e is None or e["seed_count"] != 3 or e["graph_count"] != 100 for e in quality):
        raise ValueError("The primary gate requires all three seeds and 100 paired graphs")
    quality_pass = all(e["mean_delta"] > 0 and e["positive_seeds"] >= 2 and e["ci_low"] > 0 for e in quality)
    budget = [compare(graphs, ("fixed_time", "fp16", "pave", .5), "v5a", control)
              for control in ("baseline", "v5a_mlp")]
    expected_budget = {(limit, method, "rule23" if method == "baseline_rule23" else "pave", seed)
                       for limit in (.5, 1.0) for seed in range(3)
                       for method in ("baseline", "baseline_extended", "baseline_rule23", "v5a_mlp", "v5a_message", "v5a")}
    measured_budget = {(r["budget_s"], r["method"], r["post"], r["seed"]) for r in runs
                       if r["protocol"] == "fixed_time" and r["precision"] == "fp16" and r["graphs"] == 100}
    budget_complete = expected_budget <= measured_budget
    budget_pass = budget_complete and all(e["mean_delta"] >= 0 for e in budget)
    fallback = [compare(graphs, ("fixed_work", "no", "none", None), "v5a_conflict", control)
                for control in ("v5a_mlp_conflict", "v5a_message_conflict")]
    legal = all(row["feasible_rate"] == 1 for row in runs)
    result = dict(decision=("go_to_s2b" if quality_pass and budget_pass and legal else "no_go")
                  if budget_complete else "fixed_work_complete", quality_pass=quality_pass,
                  budget_complete=budget_complete, budget_pass=budget_pass, all_feasible=legal,
                  quality=quality, budget=budget, fallback_seed0=fallback, runs=len(runs))
    write(out / "per_seed.csv", runs)
    write(out / "summary.csv", summary)
    write(out / "paired_effects.csv", pairs)
    (out / "decision.json").write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.dumps(result), flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

  --train_seed "$seed" --seed 1017 --split "${SPLIT:-validation}" --test_samples "${SAMPLES:-100}" \
  --mixed_precision "$precision" --post none pave --horizon 1 --num_k 20 --num_t 100 \
  --num_d 5 --num_l 5 --num_h 128 --method RLNN --problem mis --beta 1.02 --num_workers 0 "${analytic[@]}" "$@"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
source "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/common.sh"
while [[ ! -f "$OUT/queue/fixed.done.txt" ]]; do sleep 10; done

quality="$("$PYTHON" -c 'import json,sys; print(int(json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))["quality_pass"]))' "$OUT/analysis/decision.json")"
(
diagnostics=()
for seed in 0 1 2; do
  (
    CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 SEED="$seed" bash train_scripts/legacy/v5_frequency/diagnose.sh --utility
    CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 SEED="$seed" SPLIT=validation SAMPLES=100 bash train_scripts/legacy/v5_frequency/diagnose.sh
  ) > "$OUT/queue/diagnose_seed$seed.log" 2>&1 &
  diagnostics+=("$!")
done
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 SPLIT=validation SAMPLES=20 PRECISION=fp16 \
  bash train_scripts/legacy/v5_frequency/diagnose.sh --repeat-graphs 20 > "$OUT/queue/diagnose_fp16.log" 2>&1 &
diagnostics+=("$!")
for pid in "${diagnostics[@]}"; do wait "$pid"; done
if [[ "$quality" == 0 ]]; then
  pids=()
  for arm in v5a_conflict v5a_mlp_conflict v5a_message_conflict; do
    CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 SEED=0 bash train_scripts/legacy/v5_frequency/train.sh "$arm" > "$OUT/queue/${arm}_seed0.log" 2>&1 &
    pids+=("$!")
  done
  for pid in "${pids[@]}"; do wait "$pid"; done
fi
date -Is > "$OUT/queue/diagnostic.done.txt"
) &
diagnostic=$!

while [[ ! -f "$OUT/queue/budget.done.txt" ]]; do sleep 10; done
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 bash train_scripts/legacy/v5_frequency/profile.sh > "$OUT/queue/profile.log" 2>&1
date -Is > "$OUT/queue/profile.done.txt"
wait "$diagnostic"
if [[ "$quality" == 0 ]]; then
  for arm in v5a_conflict v5a_mlp_conflict v5a_message_conflict; do
    CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 SEED=0 bash train_scripts/legacy/v5_frequency/eval.sh "$arm" --post none \
      > "$OUT/queue/eval_fixed_${arm}_seed0_no.log" 2>&1
  done
  "$PYTHON" train_scripts/legacy/v5_frequency/decide.py
fi
"$PYTHON" - <<'PY'
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

manifest = json.loads(Path("outputs/v4_frequency/followup/manifest.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
frozen = [row for row in manifest["checkpoints"] if row["model"] == "PAVE"]
assert len(frozen) == 3
for row in frozen:
    assert hashlib.sha256(Path(row["path"]).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == row["sha256"], row["path"]
Path("outputs/v5_frequency/preflight/pave_unchanged.json").write_text(
    json.dumps({"status": "passed", "checkpoints": frozen}, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
PY
date -Is > "$OUT/queue/followup.done.txt"

# v5 DAFR-Lite

DAFR-Lite 在 RLNN 的最终翻转 logits 上添加 112 参数的标量适配器。先将当前二值状态、邻居计数、度数、占用比例和精确局部能量差编码为两路标量并门控，再用同一次稀疏传播得到惰性低通与互补高通。MLP 对照只计算邻居计数，MSG 对照使用相同投影调用并保留局部项。原 RLNN 参数为 165,505，三种适配器共 165,617 参数。

从仓库根目录执行，`PYTHON` 指向服务器的 RLNN 环境。

| 入口 | 用途 |
|---|---|
| `smoke.sh` | CPU/CUDA 自检及 8 图训练冒烟 |
| `screen.sh` | 两卡各 6 个单卡任务，四臂 × 三种子，原冻结教师和原 erdoes |
| `train.sh ARM` | 单臂训练，`SEED` 指定种子 |
| `eval.sh ARM` | 默认验证集 100 图，FP32 固定步数，`PRECISION=fp16` 可改精度 |
| `eval_budget.sh ARM` | `BUDGET=0.5/1.0`，按种子使用冻结 PAVE 或 `POST=rule23` |
| `diagnose.sh` | 共享随机数回放，`--initial` 选择零启动，`--utility` 选择训练图 R8 收益探针 |
| `profile.sh` | 空闲单卡上测 20 图 × 5 次，分别保存真实总时间和组件微基准 |
| `validate.sh` | 等待训练和预诊断完成，两卡各一条评测序列 |
| `followup.sh` | GPU 1 运行诊断和触发的冲突掩码训练，GPU 0 在预算评测后做剖析和固定步数验收 |

解析对照使用 `eval.sh baseline --calibrate-analytic`。每个种子在首 20 张训练图上比较 0、0.0625、0.125、0.25 四个系数，Size 相同取更小系数。生成的 `calibration_seedN/run.json` 供 `eval.sh analytic` 使用。

短筛用同种子 v2 骨干热启动，训练 1000 图、验证 100 图，每轮 2000 次更新。适配器第 1 轮冻结骨干，第 2–3 轮以 2e-5 解冻。原骨干微调对照第 1 轮训练骨干。各臂共享冻结教师状态生成协议和同种子随机流。

`python train_scripts/legacy/v5_frequency/decide.py` 生成 `outputs/v5_frequency/analysis/` 的汇总、图级配对与准入判断。FP32 固定 K20/T100 的无后处理 Size 为主质量口径，FP16 和 0.5/1.0 秒分别统计。验证集用于权重选择。大体积检查点和原始诊断明细保留在服务器。

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
source "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/common.sh"
mkdir -p "$OUT/queue"
pids=()
i=0
for arm in none v5a_mlp v5a_message v5a; do
  for seed in 0 1 2; do
    gpu=$((i % 2))
    cpu=$((gpu * 24 + i / 2 * 4))
    run="${arm}_seed${seed}"
    (
      code=0
      CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="$gpu" SEED="$seed" taskset -c "$cpu-$((cpu+3))" bash train_scripts/legacy/v5_frequency/train.sh "$arm" || code=$?
      printf '%s\n' "$code" > "$OUT/queue/$run.exit_code.txt"
      exit "$code"
    ) > "$OUT/queue/$run.log" 2>&1 &
    pids+=("$!")
    i=$((i+1))
  done
done
code=0
for pid in "${pids[@]}"; do wait "$pid" || code=1; done
if (( code == 0 )); then date -Is > "$OUT/queue/screen.done.txt"; fi
exit "$code"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
source "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/common.sh"
export PYTORCH_ALLOC_CONF=backend:cudaMallocAsync
arm="${1:?pass none or a v5 frequency arm}"
shift
seed="${SEED:-0}"
schedule=()
if [[ "$arm" != none ]]; then schedule+=(--freeze_backbone_epochs 1); fi
export PYTHONPATH="$ROOT/models${PYTHONPATH:+:$PYTHONPATH}"
exec "$PYTHON" -u "$ROOT/models/archived_frequency/train_v5_frequency.py" \
  --result_dir "$OUT/${RUN_NAME:-train_${arm}_seed${seed}}" \
  --frequency "$arm" --seed "$seed" --epochs "${EPOCHS:-3}" \
  --warm_start "$(base_checkpoint "$seed")/best.pt" --state_source teacher \
  --finetune_lr 0.00002 "${schedule[@]}" --graph_batch_size 8 --batch_size 64 \
  --lr 0.0001 --validation_seed 1017 --method RLNN --loss erdoes --problem mis \
  --train_path "$DATA/MIS_tensors/RB_small_train" --train_samples 1000 \
  --valid_path "$DATA/MIS_tensors/RB_small_val" --valid_samples 100 \
  --test_path "$DATA/MIS_tensors/RB_small_author_test" --num_workers 2 \
  --num_k 20 --num_t 100 --num_tp 50 --num_d 5 --num_l 5 --num_h 128 \
  --mixed_precision no --beta 1.02 --lambd 0.5 "$@"

FILE: train_scripts/legacy/v5_frequency/validate.sh

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
source "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/common.sh"
cd "$ROOT"
while [[ ! -f "$OUT/queue/screen.done.txt" || ! -f "$OUT/queue/preliminary.done.txt" ]]; do sleep 10; done

fixed_lane() {
  local gpu="$1" precision="$2" index=0 arm seed name
  local posts=(none)
  if [[ "$precision" == fp16 ]]; then posts+=(pave); fi
  for arm in baseline none v5a_mlp v5a_message v5a analytic; do
    for seed in 0 1 2; do
      if (( index % 2 == gpu )); then
        name="eval_fixed_${arm}_seed${seed}_$precision"
        CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="$gpu" SEED="$seed" PRECISION="$precision" bash train_scripts/legacy/v5_frequency/eval.sh "$arm" \
          --post "${posts[@]}" > "$OUT/queue/$name.log" 2>&1
      fi
      index=$((index+1))
    done
  done
}

budget_lane() {
  local gpu="$1" index=0 budget method arm seed post name
  for budget in 0.5 1.0; do
    for method in baseline baseline_extended baseline_rule23 v5a_mlp v5a_message v5a; do
      for seed in 0 1 2; do
        if (( index % 2 == gpu )); then
          arm="$method"; post=pave
          local extension=()
          if [[ "$method" == baseline_* ]]; then arm=baseline; extension=(--extended-search); fi
          if [[ "$method" == baseline_rule23 ]]; then post=rule23; fi
          name="eval_budget_${budget}_${method}_seed${seed}"
          CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="$gpu" SEED="$seed" BUDGET="$budget" POST="$post" LABEL="$method" RUN_NAME="$name" \
            bash train_scripts/legacy/v5_frequency/eval_budget.sh "$arm" "${extension[@]}" > "$OUT/queue/$name.log" 2>&1
        fi
        index=$((index+1))
      done
    done
  done
}

join() {
  local status=0
  for pid in "$@"; do wait "$pid" || status=1; done
  return "$status"
}

for precision in no fp16; do
  fixed_lane 0 "$precision" & first=$!
  fixed_lane 1 "$precision" & second=$!
  join "$first" "$second"
  "$PYTHON" train_scripts/legacy/v5_frequency/decide.py
done
date -Is > "$OUT/queue/fixed.done.txt"
budget_lane 0 & first=$!
budget_lane 1 & second=$!
join "$first" "$second"
"$PYTHON" train_scripts/legacy/v5_frequency/decide.py
date -Is > "$OUT/queue/budget.done.txt"

#!/usr/bin/env bash

q="$OUT/queue"
for ref in 0 1 2; do
  pilot="$OUT/pilot_full_ref$ref"
  until [[ -f "$pilot/training.csv" ]]; do
    pid="$(cat "$q/pilot_full_ref$ref.pid")"
    if ! ps -p "$pid" -o stat= | grep -q '^[^Z ]'; then
      echo "Pilot $ref exited before completing training" >&2
      exit 1
    fi
    sleep 5
  done
  export REF_SEED="$ref"
  RUN_NAME="pilot_fixed_baseline_ref$ref" bash "$ROOT/train_scripts/legacy/v6/eval.sh" baseline --cuda-graph
  CHECKPOINT_DIR="$pilot/checkpoints" RUN_NAME="pilot_fixed_full_ref$ref" \
    bash "$ROOT/train_scripts/legacy/v6/eval.sh" v6_full --cuda-graph
done
for precision in fp16 no; do
  "$PYTHON" -u "$ROOT/models/archived_frequency/profile_v6_frequency.py" --precision "$precision" --cuda-graph \
    --checkpoint "$OUT/pilot_full_ref0/checkpoints" --output "$OUT/profile_pilot_${precision}" "$@"

# v6 SC-RLNN

[模型和验证协议](../../../docs/已归档的想法和文件/RLNN_v6_SC_RLNN.md)

运行前准备与 v5 相同的 RB 张量缓存、三份 B 权重和三份冻结 PAVE Stats H1 权重。环境变量 `REF_SEED=0/1/2` 对应 v6 训练种子 42/123/999。每个任务只使用 `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES` 指定的一张卡。

```bash
export PYTHON=/home/hzeng/envs/rlnn/bin/python
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 REF_SEED=0 EPOCHS=1 RUN_NAME=pilot_full_ref0 \
  bash train_scripts/legacy/v6/train.sh v6_full

CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 REF_SEED=0 CHECKPOINT_DIR=outputs/v6/pilot_full_ref0/checkpoints \
  RUN_NAME=pilot_fixed_full_ref0 bash train_scripts/legacy/v6/eval.sh v6_full --cuda-graph

CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 "$PYTHON" models/archived_frequency/profile_v6_frequency.py \
  --precision fp16 --cuda-graph --checkpoint outputs/v6/pilot_full_ref0/checkpoints \
  --output outputs/v6/profile_pilot_fp16
```

`eval.sh baseline` 使用 B，`eval.sh v5_control` 使用 DAFR-Lite。`--split test` 指定作者测试集。`--post pave --time-budget-s 0.5` 或 `1.0` 启用对应的连续搜索预算。报告固定预算时，同卡顺序运行不同方法并使用相同执行模式。

`train.sh` 接受 `v6_lowonly`、`v6_noscatter`、`v6_noanti`、`v6_full`，也可单独检查 `v6_highonly` 和 `v6_nogate`。用 `diagnose.sh` 记录分支能量。完整首轮结果同步回来后，`python train_scripts/legacy/v6/summarize.py` 生成逐图配对汇总和准入判断。

FILE: train_scripts/legacy/v6/summarize.py

"""Aggregate the matched v6 pilot, speed probes and branch diagnostics."""

import csv
import json
from pathlib import Path
from statistics import mean, stdev


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
OUT = ROOT / "outputs/v6"
SEEDS = (42, 123, 999)


def run(name):
    return json.loads((OUT / name / "run.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


def sizes(name):
    with (OUT / name / "per_graph.csv").open(encoding="utf-8", newline="") as stream:
        return {row["graph_id"]: int(row["final_size"]) for row in csv.DictReader(stream)}


def main():
    per_seed, pairs, summary = [], [], []
    for post in ("none", "pave"):
        grouped = {"baseline": [], "full": []}
        for ref, seed in enumerate(SEEDS):
            base = f"pilot_fixed_baseline_ref{ref}/{post}"
            full = f"pilot_fixed_full_ref{ref}/{post}"
            b_size, f_size = sizes(base), sizes(full)
            if len(b_size) != 100 or b_size.keys() != f_size.keys():
                raise ValueError(f"Inconsistent graph pairs for {post}, seed {seed}")
            diff = [f_size[graph] - b_size[graph] for graph in b_size]
            pairs.append(dict(post=post, seed=seed, graphs=len(diff), delta_size=mean(diff),
                              wins=sum(x > 0 for x in diff), ties=diff.count(0), losses=sum(x < 0 for x in diff)))
            for arm, name in (("baseline", base), ("full", full)):
                data = run(name)
                row = dict(arm=arm, post=post, seed=seed, reference_seed=ref, graphs=data["samples"],
                           mean_size=data["mean_size"], graph_sd=data["sd_graph_size"],
                           delta_size=mean(diff) if arm == "full" else 0.0,
                           mean_solve_s=data["mean_solve_time_s"], feasible_rate=data["feasible_rate"],
                           params=data["params"], peak_memory_mib=data["peak_memory_mib"], source=name)
                grouped[arm].append(row)
                per_seed.append(row)
        for arm, rows in grouped.items():
            means = [row["mean_size"] for row in rows]
            summary.append(dict(arm=arm, post=post, seeds=len(rows), graphs=100, mean_size=mean(means),
                                size_seed_sd=stdev(means), delta_size=mean(row["delta_size"] for row in rows),
                                mean_solve_s=mean(row["mean_solve_s"] for row in rows),
                                feasible_rate=mean(row["feasible_rate"] for row in rows),
                                params=rows[0]["params"],
                                peak_memory_mib=max(row["peak_memory_mib"] for row in rows)))

    profiles = []
    for method in ("eager", "captured", "fused", "pilot"):
        for precision in ("fp16", "no"):
            name = f"profile_{method}_{precision}"
            data = run(name)
            profiles.append(dict(method=method, precision="fp32" if precision == "no" else precision,
                                 graphs=data["samples"], repeats=data["repeats"], b_s=data["mean_search_s"]["B"],
                                 full_s=data["mean_search_s"]["SC-RLNN"], ratio=data["ratio"], speed_pass=data["pass_speed"],
                                 components=data.get("components"), source=name))

    health = []
    for ref, seed in enumerate(SEEDS):
        for arm in ("baseline", "full"):
            name = f"diagnose_{arm}_ref{ref}"
            data = run(name)
            health.append(dict(arm=arm, seed=seed, graphs=data["samples"], **data["summary"], source=name))

    train = [run(f"pilot_full_ref{ref}") for ref in range(3)]
    full_pave = [row for row in per_seed if row["arm"] == "full" and row["post"] == "pave"]
    full_bare = next(row for row in summary if row["arm"] == "full" and row["post"] == "none")
    full_health = [row for row in health if row["arm"] == "full"]
    checks = dict(
        speed=all(row["speed_pass"] for row in profiles if row["method"] == "pilot"),
        bare_size=full_bare["mean_size"] > 19.62,
        pave_all_seeds=all(row["mean_size"] > 19.69 and row["delta_size"] > 0 for row in full_pave),
        high_energy=all(row["high_logit_energy"] > 0.01 for row in full_health),
        deep_dirichlet=all(row["layer5_dirichlet_ratio"] > 0.25 for row in full_health),
    )
    destination = OUT / "analysis"
    destination.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    record = dict(status="pilot_pass" if all(checks.values()) else "no_go", gates=checks,
                  summary=summary, per_seed=per_seed, paired=pairs, profiles=profiles, health=health,
                  train=[{key: row[key] for key in ("seed", "completed_epochs", "updates", "best_validation_size",
                                                   "peak_memory_mib", "train_wall_s")} for row in train])
    (destination / "pilot.json").write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.dumps(dict(status=record["status"], gates=checks, summary=summary,
                          train=record["train"]), indent=2))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# Mamba / 静态先验线（冻结）

本目录是已归档研究线的脚本，保留可复现性，不再迭代。归档总结（三版结论、证据链、失败原因、可复用资产）见 [docs/已归档的想法和文件/mamba/README.md](../../docs/已归档的想法和文件/mamba/README.md)。

| 目录 | 内容 |
| --- | --- |
| `v0/` | PC-OSM-RLNN 预检（正确性、独占计时、跨图代理、重编号诊断）与 P0 脚本 |
| `v1/` | 静态先验 v1（双常量 + 中心化节点项）训练与四协议评测 |
| `v2/` | P0 接口普查（26 臂）、oracle 方向训练、权重与纯监督判决实验、闭包脚本 |

入口仍需 `PYTHON`、`RLNN_SOURCE_SHA` 与 `models/data/MIS_tensors` 缓存；v2 的 `common.sh` 会 `source` v0 的 `common.sh`，因此不能在缺少该链的情况下单独运行。

判定：**No-go，瓶颈在输入信息**（8 维静态标量的可预测上限 AUC ≈0.64 → T100 ΔSize ≈+0.003，低于 0.17 门槛）。后续的"结构补偿"研究点也已在 v2 之后归档，见 [train_scripts/structure/](../structure/README.md)。


========================================================================
FILE: train_scripts/mamba/v0/analyze_static_pilot.py

"""Reanalyze P0 and summarize graph-paired static-prior MIS results."""

import argparse
import csv
import json
from collections import defaultdict
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3] / "outputs/v7_context"
ARMS = ("baseline", "mlp", "message")
PROTOCOLS = (("fixed", "none"), ("fixed", "pave"), ("budget05", "pave"), ("budget10", "pave"))


def load(folder):
    return json.loads((folder / "run.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


def rows(path):
    with path.open(newline="", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
        return list(csv.DictReader(stream))


def index(records, *keys):
    pairs = {tuple(row[k] for k in keys): row for row in records}
    if len(pairs) != len(records):
        raise ValueError(f"Duplicate key for {keys}")
    return pairs


def effect(delta):
    delta = np.asarray(delta, dtype=float)
    draws = np.random.default_rng(7323).integers(len(delta), size=(10000, len(delta)))
    loo = (delta.sum() - delta) / (len(delta) - 1)
    return dict(mean=float(delta.mean()), median=float(np.median(delta)),
                ci95=np.quantile(delta[draws].mean(axis=1), [.025, .975]).tolist(),
                wins=int((delta > 0).sum()), ties=int((delta == 0).sum()), losses=int((delta < 0).sum()),
                worst=float(delta.min()), best=float(delta.max()), loo_range=[float(loo.min()), float(loo.max())])


def pairs(candidate, reference, metric, multiplier=1):
    if candidate.keys() != reference.keys():
        raise ValueError(f"Graph pairs differ for {metric}")
    return np.array([(float(candidate[g][metric]) - float(reference[g][metric])) * multiplier for g in reference])


def preflight(stage):
    profiles = {}
    for folder in sorted(stage.glob("profile_*")):
        data = rows(folder / "per_graph.csv")
        grouped = {arm: index([r for r in data if r["arm"] == arm], "graph_id", "repeat")
                   for arm in ("baseline", "mamba")}
        by_graph = defaultdict(list)
        for graph, repeat in grouped["baseline"]:
            by_graph[graph].append(repeat)
        if any(len(repeats) != 5 for repeats in by_graph.values()) or len(by_graph) != 20:
            raise ValueError(f"Unexpected timing sample in {folder}")
        fields = ("bare_s", "prepare_capture_s", "rollout_s", "a3_s", "pave_s", "full_s")
        a, b = grouped["mamba"], grouped["baseline"]
        graph_rows = []
        for graph, repeats in by_graph.items():
            keys = [(graph, rep) for rep in repeats]
            row = {field: 1000 * float(np.mean([float(a[k][field])-float(b[k][field]) for k in keys]))
                   for field in fields}
            means = {name: float(np.mean([float(records[k]["bare_s"]) for k in keys]))
                     for name, records in grouped.items()}
            row.update(graph_id=graph, ratio=means["mamba"]/means["baseline"],
                       static_ms=1000*float(np.mean([float(a[k]["static_features_s"]) for k in keys])),
                       encode_ms=1000*float(np.mean([float(a[k]["context_s"]) for k in keys])))
            graph_rows.append(row)
        profiles[folder.name] = dict(
            ratio=load(folder)["ratio"], graph_count=len(graph_rows), repeats=5,
            components_ms={field: effect([r[field] for r in graph_rows]) for field in fields},
            graph_ratio_p95=float(np.quantile([r["ratio"] for r in graph_rows], .95)),
            graphs_over_gate=sum(r["ratio"] > 1.08 for r in graph_rows),
            matched_100step_size=sum(a[k]["base_size"] == b[k]["base_size"] for k in b),
            per_graph=graph_rows)
    data = rows(stage / "information_probe/per_graph.csv")
    by_arm = {arm: index([r for r in data if r["arm"] == arm], "graph_id")
              for arm in ("local_mlp", "full_mlp", "message", "mamba")}
    proxy = {}
    for arm, control in (("full_mlp", "local_mlp"), ("message", "local_mlp"), ("message", "full_mlp"),
                         ("mamba", "local_mlp"), ("mamba", "full_mlp"), ("mamba", "message")):
        proxy[f"{arm}_vs_{control}"] = {
            metric: effect(pairs(by_arm[arm], by_arm[control], metric))
            for metric in ("auc", "spearman", "brier")
        }
    data = rows(stage / "budget_16_optimized_no/per_graph.csv")
    steps = {}
    for budget in ("0.5", "1.0"):
        a, b = (index([r for r in data if r["budget"] == budget and r["arm"] == arm], "graph_id")
                for arm in ("mamba", "baseline"))
        steps[budget] = effect(pairs(a, b, "search_steps"))
    return dict(profiles=profiles, proxy=proxy, p0_budget_step_difference=steps)


def pilot(path):
    summary, paired, transitions, training = [], [], [], []
    reference_keys = None
    repeated = (path / "repeat_completed.txt").is_file()
    protocols = PROTOCOLS + (("repeat05", "pave"), ("repeat10", "pave")) if repeated else PROTOCOLS
    budget_rows = {}
    for protocol, post in protocols:
        methods, metadata = {}, {}
        for arm in ARMS:
            directory = path / f"{protocol}_{arm}" / post
            methods[arm] = index(rows(directory / "per_graph.csv"), "graph_id", "search_seed")
            metadata[arm] = load(directory)
            if reference_keys is None:
                reference_keys = methods[arm].keys()
            if methods[arm].keys() != reference_keys or len(reference_keys) != 50:
                raise ValueError(f"Different graph cohort or seed at {directory}")
            for key in ("backbone_weight_sha256", "pave_sha256", "cuda_graph", "split", "gpu"):
                if metadata[arm][key] != metadata["baseline"][key]:
                    raise ValueError(f"{key} mismatch for {directory}")
            record = metadata[arm]
            data = list(methods[arm].values())
            base = np.array([int(r["base_size"]) for r in data])
            final = np.array([int(r["final_size"]) for r in data])
            search = np.array([float(r["search_time_s"]) for r in data])
            summary.append(dict(
                protocol=protocol, post=post, arm=arm, graphs=len(final),
                mean_size=float(final.mean()), graph_sd=float(final.std(ddof=1)),
                mean_base_size=float(base.mean()), mean_pave_gain=float((final-base).mean()),
                pave_improved=int((final>base).sum()), mean_solve_s=record["mean_solve_time_s"],
                p95_solve_s=record["p95_solve_s"], mean_search_s=float(search.mean()),
                mean_post_s=record["mean_post_time_s"], mean_steps=record["mean_search_steps"],
                feasible=record["feasible_rate"], params=record["params"],
                peak_mib=record["peak_memory_mib"], overruns=record["deadline_overruns"],
                fallbacks=record["fallback_count"], gpu=record["gpu"]))
        if protocol != "fixed":
            budget_rows[protocol] = methods
        for candidate, control in (("mlp", "baseline"), ("message", "baseline"), ("message", "mlp")):
            a, b = methods[candidate], methods[control]
            delta = pairs(a, b, "final_size")
            pre = pairs(a, b, "base_size")
            paired.append(dict(protocol=protocol, post=post, arm=candidate, control=control,
                               size=effect(delta), base_size=effect(pre), pave_gain=effect(delta-pre),
                               solve_ms=effect(pairs(a, b, "solve_time_s", 1000)),
                               search_ms=effect(pairs(a, b, "search_time_s", 1000)),
                               steps=effect(pairs(a, b, "search_steps"))))
            if post == "pave":
                transitions.append(dict(protocol=protocol, arm=candidate, control=control,
                                        pre_win_lost=int(((pre>0)&(delta<=0)).sum()),
                                        pre_loss_recovered=int(((pre<0)&(delta>=0)).sum()),
                                        pre_tie_became_win=int(((pre==0)&(delta>0)).sum()),
                                        pre_tie_became_loss=int(((pre==0)&(delta<0)).sum())))
    for arm in ARMS[1:]:
        folder = path / f"train_{arm}"
        data = load(folder)
        history = rows(folder / "training.csv")[-1]
        training.append(dict(arm=arm, updates=data["updates"], wall_s=data["train_wall_s"],
                             peak_mib=data["peak_memory_mib"], alpha=float(history["alpha"]),
                             delta_logit_rms=float(history["delta_logit_rms"]),
                             delta_prob_mean_abs=float(history["delta_prob_mean_abs"]),
                             train_flips=float(history["train_flips"])))
    budget_replication = []
    if repeated:
        for suffix in ("05", "10"):
            first, second = (budget_rows[f"{prefix}{suffix}"] for prefix in ("budget", "repeat"))
            for arm in ARMS:
                base = pairs(second[arm], first[arm], "final_size")
                base_steps = pairs(second[arm], first[arm], "search_steps")
                entry = dict(budget="0.5" if suffix == "05" else "1.0", arm=arm,
                             repeat_minus_first_size=effect(base), repeat_minus_first_steps=effect(base_steps))
                if arm != "baseline":
                    first_size = pairs(first[arm], first["baseline"], "final_size")
                    second_size = pairs(second[arm], second["baseline"], "final_size")
                    first_steps = pairs(first[arm], first["baseline"], "search_steps")
                    second_steps = pairs(second[arm], second["baseline"], "search_steps")
                    entry.update(pooled_size_vs_b=effect((first_size+second_size)/2),
                                 pooled_steps_vs_b=effect((first_steps+second_steps)/2),
                                 won_both_runs=int(((first_size>0)&(second_size>0)).sum()),
                                 lost_both_runs=int(((first_size<0)&(second_size<0)).sum()))
                budget_replication.append(entry)
    return dict(summary=summary, paired=paired, transitions=transitions, training=training,
                budget_replication=budget_replication)


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--root", type=Path, default=ROOT)
    parser.add_argument("--p0-only", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    destination = args.root / "analysis/static_prior_pilot"
    destination.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    data = {"p0_reanalysis": preflight(args.root / "preflight")}
    if not args.p0_only:
        data["pilot"] = pilot(args.root / "static_prior_pilot")
    for name, record in data.items():
        (destination / f"{name}.json").write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()


========================================================================
FILE: train_scripts/mamba/v0/check.py
========================================================================
"""Verify v7 warm start, graph isolation, gradients, and one-shot capture."""

import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3] / "models"))

import numpy as np
import torch

from eval_v2 import ROOT, TRAIN, dataset_at, search, write_run
from mis_v1 import adjacency
from mis_v3_search import SearchGraph
from torch_geometric.data import Data
from utils import build_batch
from v7_runs import preflight_policy, provenance
from v7_structure import structure


def graph_of(n, pairs, device, dtype):
    edges = [pair for a, b in pairs for pair in ((a, b), (b, a))]
    edge = torch.tensor(edges, device=device, dtype=torch.long).reshape(-1, 2).t().contiguous()
    return Data(num_nodes=n, edge_index=edge, edge_weight=torch.full((edge.size(1),), .5, dtype=dtype, device=device),
                x=torch.ones(n, 1, dtype=dtype, device=device), b=-torch.ones(n, 1, dtype=dtype, device=device),
                idx=0)


def check(args):
    mode = "v7_mamba" if args.device == "cuda" else "v7_mlp"
    base = preflight_policy("none", args.precision, cuda_graph=args.device == "cuda")
    solver = preflight_policy(mode, args.precision, cuda_graph=args.device == "cuda")
    device = solver.accelerator.device
    assert device.type == args.device
    model = solver.accelerator.unwrap_model(solver.model)
    original = base.accelerator.unwrap_model(base.model)
    for name, weight in original.state_dict().items():
        torch.testing.assert_close(model.state_dict()[name], weight, rtol=0, atol=0)
    context = model.adapter
    g = graph_of(6, [(0, 1), (0, 2), (1, 2), (2, 3)], device, solver.dtype)
    other = graph_of(3, [(0, 1), (1, 2)], device, solver.dtype)
    nodes = torch.tensor([[0, 1], [1, 0], [0, 1], [0, 0], [1, 0], [0, 1]],
                         device=device, dtype=solver.dtype)
    topo = solver.policy_topology(g, adjacency(g))
    with torch.no_grad():
        logits = solver.flip_logits(nodes, g, adjacency(g), topo)
        base_logits = base.flip_logits(nodes, g, adjacency(g), base.policy_topology(g, adjacency(g)))
        torch.testing.assert_close(logits, base_logits, atol=0, rtol=0)
        batch = build_batch([g, other])
        both = solver.policy_topology(batch, adjacency(batch))
        separate = torch.cat((context.precompute(topo),
                              context.precompute(solver.policy_topology(other, adjacency(other)))))
        torch.testing.assert_close(context.precompute(both), separate, atol=2e-6, rtol=1e-5)
        for n in (0, 1, 3):
            isolated = graph_of(n, [], device, solver.dtype)
            t = solver.policy_topology(isolated, adjacency(isolated))
            assert t.cached_action_bias.shape == (n, 2) and t.cached_action_bias.isfinite().all()
    # Tie randomness transported with the nodes is exactly relabel-consistent.
    edges = g.edge_index.cpu().numpy()
    perm = np.array([3, 5, 0, 2, 1, 4])
    keys = np.random.default_rng(141).random((2, 6))
    x, orders = structure(edges, 6, 0, order="bfs", tie_keys=keys)
    y, relabeled = structure(perm[edges], 6, 0, order="bfs", tie_keys=keys[:, np.argsort(perm)])
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(x, y[perm])
    assert {tuple(perm[row]) for group in orders for row in group} == {
        tuple(row) for group in relabeled for row in group}
    gradients = None
    if args.precision == "no":
        context.requires_grad_(True)
        model.train()
        optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(context.parameters(), lr=.001)
        train_topology = topo._replace(cached_action_bias=None)
        gradients = []
        for _ in range(2):
            optimizer.zero_grad()
            output = model(nodes, g.edge_index, adjacency(g), train_topology)
            output.sum().backward()
            gradients.append([float(context.alpha.grad.abs()), float(context.out_proj.weight.grad.norm())])
            optimizer.step()
        assert gradients[0][0] > 0 and gradients[1][1] > 0 and np.isfinite(gradients).all()
        model.eval()
        context.alpha.data.zero_()
    scan_shapes = []
    if args.device == "cuda":
        hook = context.sequence.register_forward_pre_hook(lambda _, args: scan_shapes.append(tuple(args[0].shape)))
    data = dataset_at(TRAIN, solver.dtype, 1)[0]
    legal = SearchGraph(data.num_nodes, data.edge_index, seed=1017)
    _, component_orders = structure(data.edge_index.numpy(), data.num_nodes, solver.order_seed + data.idx,
                                    order=context.order, views=solver.order_views)
    data = data.to(device)
    with torch.no_grad():
        b, _ = search(base, data, legal, 1017)
        s, steps = search(solver, data, legal, 1017)
    if args.device == "cuda":
        hook.remove()
        expected = [(2 * order.shape[0], order.shape[1], 32) for order in component_orders]
        assert scan_shapes == expected, (scan_shapes, expected)
    assert steps == 100 and legal.feasible(s)
    if args.precision == "no":
        assert s == b
    hashes = [provenance(ref)["pave_sha256"] for ref in range(3)]
    for ref, expected in enumerate(hashes):
        matches = (ROOT / "outputs/v5_frequency").glob(f"eval_budget_*_baseline_extended_seed{ref}/pave/run.json")
        archived = {json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")).get("pave_sha256") for path in matches}
        assert expected in archived, f"Frozen PAVE checkpoint differs for ref {ref}"
    args.output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    write_run(args.output, dict(**provenance(0), status="completed", arm=mode, precision=args.precision,
                                device=str(device), exact_zero_logits=True, capture_scan_shapes=scan_shapes,
                                gradient=gradients, baseline_size=b.bit_count(), v7_size=s.bit_count(),
                                same_solution=s == b, verified_pave_sha256=hashes))
    print(args.output, gradients, scan_shapes, b.bit_count(), s.bit_count(), flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--device", choices=("cpu", "cuda"), required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--precision", choices=("no", "fp16"), default="no")
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    check(parser.parse_args())


========================================================================

"""Trace native selective scan calls around CUDA Graph capture."""

import argparse
from pathlib import Path
import sys
from unittest.mock import patch

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3] / "models"))

import torch
import selective_scan_cuda
from torch.profiler import ProfilerActivity, profile, record_function

from eval_v2 import TRAIN, dataset_at, search, write_run
from mis_v3_search import SearchGraph
from v7_runs import preflight_policy, provenance
from v7_structure import structure


@torch.no_grad()
def check(output):
    solver = preflight_policy("v7_mamba", "no", cuda_graph=True)
    graph = dataset_at(TRAIN, torch.float32, 1)[0]
    legal = SearchGraph(graph.num_nodes, graph.edge_index, seed=1017)
    _, groups = structure(graph.edge_index.numpy(), graph.num_nodes, solver.order_seed + graph.idx, order="bfs")
    graph = graph.to("cuda")
    search(solver, graph, legal, 1017)
    native = selective_scan_cuda.fwd
    calls = []

    def counted(*args, **kwargs):
        calls.append(torch.cuda.is_current_stream_capturing())
        with record_function("v7_native_selective_scan"):
            return native(*args, **kwargs)

    with patch.object(selective_scan_cuda, "fwd", counted), profile(activities=[ProfilerActivity.CPU]) as trace:
        solution, steps = search(solver, graph, legal, 1017)
        torch.cuda.synchronize()
    events = sum(event.name == "v7_native_selective_scan" for event in trace.events())
    assert len(calls) == len(groups) == events and not any(calls)
    assert steps == 100 and legal.feasible(solution)
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    write_run(output, dict(**provenance(0), status="completed", steps=steps, native_scan_calls=events,
                           sequence_batches=[list(group.shape) for group in groups],
                           native_calls_during_capture=sum(calls), scan_calls_in_replay=0))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    check(parser.parse_args().output)

"""Apply the P0 gate and graph-paired validation gates for SC-context."""

import argparse
import csv
import json
from pathlib import Path
from statistics import mean, stdev

import numpy as np


ARMS = ("baseline", "v7_mlp", "v7_message", "v7_mamba", "v7_shuffle_mamba")


def read(path):
    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


def p0(root, width):
    stage = root / "preflight"
    correctness = all(read(stage / name / "run.json")["status"] == "completed"
                      for name in ("cpu", "cuda_no", "cuda_fp16", "permutation", "cuda_graph_trace"))
    speed, repeats = {}, False
    for precision in ("no", "fp16"):
        first = stage / f"profile_{width}_{precision}"
        second = stage / f"profile_{width}_{precision}_repeat"
        results = [read(first / "run.json")]
        if (second / "run.json").exists():
            repeats = True
            results.append(read(second / "run.json"))
        bare = {arm: mean(run["timings"][arm]["bare_s"] for run in results) for arm in ("baseline", "mamba")}
        speed[precision] = bare["mamba"] / bare["baseline"]
    info = read(stage / "information_probe" / "run.json")
    ratios = max(speed.values())
    repeat = not repeats and 1.08 < ratios <= 1.12
    deltas = info["paired_delta_auc"]
    stable_direction = all(deltas[arm]["ci95"][0] > 0 for arm in ("local_mlp", "full_mlp")) and deltas["message"]["delta_auc"] > 0
    reliability = info["mean_label_split_spearman"]
    if not correctness:
        status = "fix_correctness"
    elif repeat:
        status = "remeasure"
    elif ratios > 1.08:
        status = "profile_width16" if width != 16 else "no_go_speed"
    elif stable_direction:
        status = "go_training"
    elif reliability < .25:
        status = "small_pilot_only"
    else:
        status = "no_go_information"
    return dict(status=status, correctness=correctness, width=width, speed_ratios=speed,
                proxy_auc=info["mean_metrics"], proxy_deltas=deltas, information_direction=stable_direction,
                proxy_reliability=reliability, weak_proxy_threshold=.25)


def evaluate(root):
    def collect(protocol, arm, post):
        pairs, runs = [], []
        for ref in range(3):
            folder = root / f"{protocol}_{arm}_ref{ref}" / post
            metadata = read(folder / "run.json")
            if metadata["split"] != "validation" or metadata["samples"] != 100:
                raise ValueError(f"Expected the 100 validation graphs in {folder}")
            with (folder / "per_graph.csv").open(newline="", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
                pairs.append({r["graph_id"]: int(r["final_size"]) for r in csv.DictReader(stream)})
            runs.append(metadata)
        return pairs, runs

    protocols = (("fixed", "none"), ("fixed", "pave"), ("budget05", "pave"), ("budget10", "pave"))
    data = {(protocol, post, arm): collect(protocol, arm, post)
            for protocol, post in protocols for arm in ARMS}
    reports, effects = [], []
    random = np.random.default_rng(7307)
    intervals = random.integers(0, 100, (10000, 100))

    def paired(protocol, post, arm, control):
        a, _ = data[protocol, post, arm]
        b, _ = data[protocol, post, control]
        gids = list(a[0])
        if any(set(gids) != values.keys() for values in a+b):
            raise ValueError("Graph IDs differ between seeds or methods")
        delta = np.asarray([[f[gid]-g[gid] for gid in gids] for f, g in zip(a, b)])
        by_graph = delta.mean(axis=0)
        ci = np.quantile(by_graph[intervals].mean(axis=1), [.025, .975])
        return dict(protocol=protocol, post=post, arm=arm, control=control, delta=float(delta.mean()),
                    seed_deltas=delta.mean(axis=1).tolist(), ci95=ci.tolist(),
                    wins=int((delta>0).sum()), ties=int((delta==0).sum()), losses=int((delta<0).sum()))

    for protocol, post in protocols:
        for arm in ARMS:
            _, runs = data[protocol, post, arm]
            sizes = [r["mean_size"] for r in runs]
            effect = paired(protocol, post, arm, "baseline")
            reports.append(dict(protocol=protocol, post=post, arm=arm, mean_size=mean(sizes), sd=stdev(sizes),
                                delta_size=effect["delta"], feasible_rate=mean(r["feasible_rate"] for r in runs),
                                mean_solve_s=mean(r["mean_solve_time_s"] for r in runs),
                                mean_search_steps=mean(r["mean_search_steps"] for r in runs),
                                params=runs[0]["params"], peak_memory_mib=max(r["peak_memory_mib"] for r in runs)))
            if arm != "baseline":
                effects.append(effect)
    mamba = "v7_mamba"
    def scores(protocol, post, arm, metric="mean_size"):
        return [r[metric] for r in data[protocol, post, arm][1]]
    def passes(protocol, post, arm, minimum, *, each=False):
        a, b = scores(protocol, post, arm), scores(protocol, post, "baseline")
        return all(x > max(minimum, y) for x, y in zip(a, b)) if each else mean(a) > max(minimum, mean(b))
    main_effect = [paired("fixed", "pave", mamba, control) for control in ("v7_mlp", "v7_message")]
    speed = [read(root / f"trained_profile_ref0_{p}" / "run.json")["ratio"] for p in ("no", "fp16")]
    stability = read(root / "trained_permutation_ref0" / "run.json")["summary"]
    gates = dict(
        feasibility=all(r["feasible_rate"] == 1 for r in reports),
        bare=passes("fixed", "none", mamba, 19.62),
        pave=passes("fixed", "pave", mamba, 19.69, each=True),
        budget05=passes("budget05", "pave", mamba, 19.70),
        budget10=passes("budget10", "pave", mamba, 19.85),
        steps10=mean(scores("budget10", "pave", mamba, "mean_search_steps")) >= 250,
        mamba_specific=all(min(row["seed_deltas"]) > 0 and row["ci95"][0] > 0 for row in main_effect),
        speed=max(speed) <= 1.08,
        stability=all(row["context_delta_pave"] >= row["baseline_delta_pave"] - .05 for row in stability.values()),
    )
    controls = [arm for arm in ("v7_mlp", "v7_message") if all(
        passes(protocol, "pave", arm, threshold) for protocol, threshold in (("budget05", 19.70), ("budget10", 19.85)))]
    status = "go_a" if all(gates.values()) else "go_b" if controls and not gates["mamba_specific"] else "no_go"
    return dict(status=status, gates=gates, controls=controls, summary=reports, paired=effects+main_effect)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--root", type=Path, default=Path("outputs/v7_context"))
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--stage", choices=("p0", "validation"), required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--width", type=int, default=32)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    result = p0(args.root, args.width) if args.stage == "p0" else evaluate(args.root)
    args.output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    args.output.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.dumps(result if args.stage == "p0" else dict(status=result["status"], gates=result["gates"]), indent=2))

"""Separate graph-wide add/drop offsets and node variation on matched B states."""

import argparse
from pathlib import Path
from statistics import mean
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3] / "models"))

import torch

from eval_v2 import VALID, dataset_at, write_run
from mis_v1 import adjacency
from v7_runs import preflight_policy


def top5_overlap(a, b):
    a = a.topk(5, dim=0).indices.T
    b = b.topk(5, dim=0).indices.T
    return (a[:, :, None] == b[:, None, :]).any(dim=-1).float().mean()


@torch.no_grad()
def diagnose(pilot, samples):
    baseline = preflight_policy("none", "no")
    device = baseline.accelerator.device
    methods = {arm: preflight_policy(f"v7_{arm}", "no", checkpoint=pilot / f"train_{arm}/checkpoints")
               for arm in ("mlp", "message")}
    data = dataset_at(VALID, baseline.dtype, samples)
    rows = {arm: [] for arm in methods}
    for i, graph in enumerate(data):
        graph = graph.to(device)
        adj = adjacency(graph)
        normalized = baseline.policy_topology(graph, adj)
        rng = torch.Generator(device=device).manual_seed(1017 + i)
        biases = {arm: policy.policy_topology(graph, adj).cached_action_bias for arm, policy in methods.items()}
        accum = {arm: [] for arm in methods}
        for step, state in enumerate(baseline.sample_states(graph, adj, generator=rng, normalized=normalized)):
            if step not in (25, 50, 75, 100):
                continue
            base = baseline.flip_logits(state, graph, adj, normalized)
            p = base.sigmoid()
            for arm, bias in biases.items():
                average = bias.mean(dim=0)
                full = base + torch.where(state.bool(), bias[:, 1:2], bias[:, 0:1])
                constant = base + torch.where(state.bool(), average[1], average[0])
                full_p = full.sigmoid()
                accum[arm].append(dict(
                    mean_abs_probability_shift=float((full_p-p).abs().mean()),
                    mean_abs_node_specific_probability_shift=float((full_p-constant.sigmoid()).abs().mean()),
                    delta_expected_flips=float((full_p-p).sum(dim=0).mean()),
                    top5_overlap=float(top5_overlap(base, full)),
                    top5_overlap_after_mean_control=float(top5_overlap(constant, full))))
        for arm, bias in biases.items():
            rows[arm].append(dict(
                graph_id=Path(data.files[i]).stem,
                mean_add_logit=float(bias[:, 0].mean()), mean_drop_logit=float(bias[:, 1].mean()),
                node_centered_energy_fraction=float((bias-bias.mean(dim=0)).square().sum() / bias.square().sum()),
                **{key: mean(item[key] for item in accum[arm]) for key in accum[arm][0]}))
    summary = {arm: {key: mean(row[key] for row in records) for key in records[0] if key != "graph_id"}
               for arm, records in rows.items()}
    output = pilot / "bias_diagnostics"
    output.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    write_run(output, dict(samples=len(data), states=[25, 50, 75, 100], summary=summary, per_graph=rows))
    print(summary, flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--pilot", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--samples", default=20, type=int)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    diagnose(args.pilot, args.samples)

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
source "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/common.sh"
action="${1:?pass correctness, timing or information}"
shift
case "$action" in
  correctness)
    ACCELERATE_USE_CPU=true "$PYTHON" -u "$SCRIPTS/check.py" --device cpu --output "$OUT/preflight/cpu"
    for precision in no fp16; do
      "$PYTHON" -u "$SCRIPTS/check.py" --device cuda --precision "$precision" --output "$OUT/preflight/cuda_$precision"
    done
    "$PYTHON" -u "$SCRIPTS/check_scan.py" --output "$OUT/preflight/cuda_graph_trace" ;;
  timing)
    width="${WIDTH:-32}"
    for precision in no fp16; do
      "$PYTHON" -u models/profile_v7_context.py --precision "$precision" --width "$width" \
        --output "$OUT/preflight/profile_${width}_${precision}${TIMING_TAG:-}" "$@"
    done ;;
  information)
    exec "$PYTHON" -u models/probe_v7_context.py --output "$OUT/preflight/information_probe" "$@" ;;
  *) exit 2 ;;
esac

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
source "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/common.sh"
export REF_SEED=0 WIDTH=32 SAMPLES=50
pilot="$OUT/static_prior_pilot"
stage="${1:-full}"
export EPOCHS=1

train() {
  local arm="$1" gpu="$2"
  CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="$gpu" RUN_NAME="static_prior_pilot/train_$arm" \
    bash "$SCRIPTS/train.sh" "v7_$arm" --train_samples 256 --valid_samples "$SAMPLES"
}

if [[ "$stage" == full ]]; then
  mkdir "$pilot"
  train mlp 0 >"$pilot/train_mlp.log" 2>&1 & mlp_pid=$!
  train message 1 >"$pilot/train_message.log" 2>&1 & msg_pid=$!
  wait "$mlp_pid"
  wait "$msg_pid"

  "$PYTHON" - "$pilot" "$OUT/../v2/none_seed0/checkpoints/best.pt" <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import torch

pilot, source = map(Path, sys.argv[1:])
backbone = torch.load(source, map_location="cpu", weights_only=True)
matched = []
for arm in ("mlp", "message"):
    folder = pilot / f"train_{arm}"
    data = json.loads((folder / "run.json").read_text())
    assert data["status"] == "completed" and data["updates"] == 512
    matched.append(data["teacher_state_sha256"])
    weights = torch.load(folder / "checkpoints/best.pt", map_location="cpu", weights_only=True)
    assert all(torch.equal(weights[name], value) for name, value in backbone.items()), arm
assert len(matched[0]) == 20 and matched[0] == matched[1]
print("512 updates per arm, 20 paired teacher traces and identical frozen backbones", flush=True)
PY
elif [[ "$stage" != repeat-budgets || ! -f "$pilot/completed.txt" ]]; then
  echo "Pass full or repeat-budgets after the pilot finishes" >&2
  exit 2
fi

measure() {
  local protocol="$1" arm="$2" gpu="$3" budget="${4:-}"
  local mode="$arm" checkpoint="$OUT/../v2/none_seed0/checkpoints" script=eval.sh
  if [[ "$arm" != baseline ]]; then
    mode="v7_$arm"
    checkpoint="$pilot/train_$arm/checkpoints"
  fi
  if [[ -n "$budget" ]]; then script=eval_budget.sh; fi
  CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="$gpu" RUN_NAME="static_prior_pilot/${protocol}_$arm" \
    CHECKPOINT_DIR="$checkpoint" BUDGET="$budget" bash "$SCRIPTS/$script" "$mode" --cuda-graph \
    >"$pilot/${protocol}_$arm.log" 2>&1
}

first_lane() {
  if [[ "$stage" == full ]]; then
    for arm in baseline mlp message; do measure fixed "$arm" 0; done
    for arm in message baseline mlp; do measure budget05 "$arm" 0 0.5; done
  else
    for arm in mlp baseline message; do measure repeat05 "$arm" 0 0.5; done
  fi
}

second_lane() {
  if [[ "$stage" == full ]]; then
    for arm in mlp message baseline; do measure budget10 "$arm" 1 1.0; done
  else
    for arm in baseline message mlp; do measure repeat10 "$arm" 1 1.0; done
  fi
}

first_lane & first=$!
second_lane & second=$!
wait "$first"
wait "$second"
if [[ "$stage" == full ]]; then
  date -Is >"$pilot/completed.txt"
else
  date -Is >"$pilot/repeat_completed.txt"
fi


========================================================================

# Mamba v0 · PC-OSM-RLNN

Mamba 研究线的第一版，对应 [v7 方案](../../../docs/已归档的想法和文件/mamba/RLNN_v7_OneShot_Mamba_Research_and_Implementation_Plan.md)。模型使用冻结的 B 和 PAVE H1。一次性编码在求解开始时完成，节点动作偏置在 20 条粒子和所有采样步间共享。训练每次更新重新计算带梯度的编码。[P0 结果](../../../docs/已归档的想法和文件/mamba/RLNN_Mamba_v0_P0_Results.md)

```bash
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 bash train_scripts/mamba/v0/setup_env.sh
export RLNN_SOURCE_SHA="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 bash train_scripts/mamba/v0/p0.sh correctness
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 bash train_scripts/mamba/v0/p0.sh timing
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 bash train_scripts/mamba/v0/p0.sh information
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 bash train_scripts/mamba/v0/diagnose.sh
python train_scripts/mamba/v0/decide.py --stage p0 --output outputs/v7_context/analysis/p0.json
```

源代码通过 SFTP 同步且服务器目录没有 Git 元数据时，`RLNN_SOURCE_SHA` 使用同步版本的提交号。RTX 5090 的安装脚本为 SM120 构建官方 Mamba-1 CUDA 扩展，复用 RLNN 基础环境并隔离新增依赖。

通过 P0 后，按种子分别训练四个核心组。环境变量 `REF_SEED=0/1/2` 分别对应 42/123/999，`WIDTH` 默认 32。每个进程用一张卡。正式测速在各卡独占运行。

```bash
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 REF_SEED=0 bash train_scripts/mamba/v0/train.sh v7_mamba
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 REF_SEED=0 bash train_scripts/mamba/v0/eval.sh v7_mamba --cuda-graph
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 REF_SEED=0 BUDGET=0.5 bash train_scripts/mamba/v0/eval_budget.sh v7_mamba --cuda-graph
```

核心对照为 `baseline`、`v7_mlp`、`v7_message`、`v7_shuffle_mamba`。线性、度排序、单向和 logit 门控可由 `--context_mode` 切换，`--v7_order_views` 设为 1、2 或 4。固定工作量和两档时间预算的逐图结果均写入 `outputs/v7_context`。

冻结 B 和 PAVE 的静态先验小试使用 `pilot_static.sh`。首轮完成后用 `pilot_static.sh repeat-budgets` 复测两档预算，再运行 `python train_scripts/mamba/v0/analyze_static_pilot.py` 汇总逐图差值。[小试与 v1 方案](../../../docs/已归档的想法和文件/mamba/RLNN_Static_Prior_v1_Analysis_and_Plan.md)

"""Verify frozen weights and the same-checkpoint node-term intervention."""

import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3] / "models"))

import torch

from eval_v2 import VALID, dataset_at
from mis_static_prior import cheap_features
from mis_v1 import adjacency
from utils import build_batch
from v7_runs import backbone, pave, digest, preflight_policy
from v7_structure import structure


@torch.no_grad()
def check(root, ref):
    original = torch.load(backbone(ref), map_location="cpu", weights_only=True)
    manifests, cohorts = [], []
    for arm in ("constants", "centered"):
        run = root / f"train_{arm}_ref{ref}"
        data = json.loads((run / "run.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        state = torch.load(run / "checkpoints/best.pt", map_location="cpu", weights_only=True)
        assert data["status"] == "completed" and data["updates"] == 512
        assert data["pave_sha256"] == digest(pave(ref))
        assert all(torch.equal(state[key], value) for key, value in original.items())
        manifests.append(data["teacher_state_sha256"])
        cohorts.append(data["validation_graph_ids"])
        assert data["first_gradients"][0]["constants_grad_norm"] > 0
        if arm == "centered":
            assert data["first_gradients"][1]["encoder_grad_norm"] > 0
    assert manifests[0] == manifests[1] and len(manifests[0]) == 20
    dataset = dataset_at(VALID, torch.float32)
    assert cohorts[0] == cohorts[1] == [Path(file).stem for file in dataset.files[50:100]]
    solver = preflight_policy("static_centered", "no", ref=ref,
                              checkpoint=root / f"train_centered_ref{ref}/checkpoints")
    device = solver.accelerator.device
    adapter = solver.accelerator.unwrap_model(solver.model).adapter
    graphs = [dataset[50], dataset[51]]
    for graph in graphs:
        features, _ = structure(graph.edge_index.numpy(), graph.num_nodes, 0)
        raw = cheap_features(adjacency(graph), (0, graph.num_nodes))
        torch.testing.assert_close(raw, torch.from_numpy(features[:, [0, 1, 2, 6, 7]]), atol=2e-3, rtol=1e-4)
    graphs = [graph.to(device) for graph in graphs]
    singles = [solver.policy_topology(graph, adjacency(graph)).cached_action_bias for graph in graphs]
    batch = build_batch(graphs)
    both = solver.policy_topology(batch, adjacency(batch)).cached_action_bias
    torch.testing.assert_close(both, torch.cat(singles), atol=2e-5, rtol=1e-5)
    adapter.centered = False
    masked = solver.policy_topology(batch, adjacency(batch))
    assert masked.features is None and masked.cached_action_bias.shape == (1, 2)
    for bias in singles:
        torch.testing.assert_close(bias.mean(dim=0, keepdim=True), masked.cached_action_bias, atol=1e-7, rtol=1e-5)
        assert (bias.abs() <= .5).all()
    print("Frozen weights, matched teachers, feature parity, graph centering and masked action bias verified", flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--root", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--ref", type=int, default=0)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    check(args.root, args.ref)

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
source "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/common.sh"

for arm in constants centered; do
  checkpoint="$OUT/train_${arm}_ref${REF_SEED}/training.csv"
  until [[ -f "$checkpoint" ]]; do
    pid="$(cat "$OUT/train_$arm.pid")"
    ps -p "$pid" -o stat= | grep -q '^[^Z ]' || { tail -n 20 "$OUT/train_$arm.log"; exit 1; }
    sleep 3
  done
done
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 "$PYTHON" -u "$SCRIPTS/check.py" --root "$OUT" --ref "$REF_SEED"

pair() {
  CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 bash "$SCRIPTS/eval.sh" "$1" >"$OUT/$1.log" 2>&1 & first=$!
  CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 bash "$SCRIPTS/eval.sh" "$2" >"$OUT/$2.log" 2>&1 & second=$!
  wait "$first"
  wait "$second"
}

pair t100 t1000
date -Is >"$OUT/fixed_completed.txt"
pair budget05 budget10
date -Is >"$OUT/completed.txt"
