#!/usr/bin/env bash
# t21 / P0.5：0.2 s 档三臂对撞（前导解码 × PAVE），三 seed × 1000 图，全部写新目录。
#
#   臂 C（现况参照） 前导解码 on  + PAVE on  = outputs/v11/t7/a02_s${seed}_1000/（t7 产物，只读复用）
#   臂 A             前导解码 off + PAVE on  = outputs/v11/t7/v13_noprelude_02s_s${seed}/
#   臂 B             前导解码 off + PAVE off = outputs/v11/t7/v13_nopave_02s_s${seed}/
#
# A vs B 给出「PAVE 的 ~29 ms 换成搜索时间值多少分」的兑换率（同一预算/seed/图集）。
# 开关都是 additive（models/eval_v8_padded.py --skip_incumbent / --no_pave），默认行为不变；
# run.json 记 leading_decode=on|off 与 pave=true|false，v11_rows.csv 同名列，便于事后分表。
# 已有 CSV 即 SKIP（绝不覆盖）。用法：bash train_scripts/v11/v14_ab.sh [GPU]

PY=/home/hzeng/envs/rlnn/bin/python

mkdir -p "$OUT" tmp

COMMON=(--test_path models/data/MIS_tensors/RB_small_author_test --test_samples 1000
        --shards 1 --shard 0 --reference_seed 0
        --save_dir outputs/v2/none_seed0/checkpoints --num_k 200 --decoders captured
        --decode_every 1000 --decode_top 4 --dense --mixed_precision fp16 --repeats 1
        --budgets 0.2)

run_cell () {
  local name=$1; shift
  local dir=/home/hzeng/project/ZH/RLNN_lab/$OUT/$name
  if [ -e "$dir/padded/padded_ref0.csv" ]; then
    echo "=== $name SKIP (artifact exists, never overwrite) ==="
    return 0
  fi
  echo "=== [$(date +%H:%M:%S)] $name ==="
  mkdir -p "$dir"
  CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=$GPU $PY -u models/eval_v8_padded.py "${COMMON[@]}" "$@" \
    --result_dir "$dir" --v11_csv "$dir/v11_rows.csv" > tmp/v14_$name.log 2>&1
  local rc=$?
  echo "--- $name exit=$rc ($(date +%H:%M:%S)) ---"
  tail -2 tmp/v14_$name.log
  return $rc
}

# 臂 C 只核对存在性（read-only，不重跑）
for seed in 1017 1019 1021; do
  if [ -e "$OUT/a02_s${seed}_1000/padded/padded_ref0.csv" ]; then

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# t21 收尾：1 s 档的三条 deadline 臂（captain 2026-11-18 指令）。
#
#   L1 = 1 s deadline + 前导解码关 + PAVE on
#   L2 = 1 s deadline + 前导解码关 + PAVE off
#   L3 = 1 s deadline + 前导解码关 + PAVE off + torch.compile 融合（PAVE 按 L1/L2 胜者）
#
# 全部 deadline 口径（不用 --fixed_steps），因此报的是实际步数；A0 的 810 步不在本脚本里改。
# 每个 cell 都是新目录，已有 CSV 即 SKIP（绝不覆盖）。
# 用法：bash train_scripts/v11/v14_l1l2.sh [GPU] [seeds...]
set -uo pipefail
cd /home/hzeng/project/ZH/RLNN_lab || exit 1
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1
GPU=${1:-1}; shift || true
SEEDS=("${@:-}")
if [ -z "${SEEDS[0]:-}" ]; then SEEDS=(1017 1019 1021); fi
PY=/home/hzeng/envs/rlnn/bin/python
OUT=outputs/v11/t7
mkdir -p "$OUT" tmp

COMMON=(--test_path models/data/MIS_tensors/RB_small_author_test --test_samples 1000
        --shards 1 --shard 0 --reference_seed 0
        --save_dir outputs/v2/none_seed0/checkpoints --num_k 200 --decoders captured
        --decode_every 1000 --decode_top 4 --dense --mixed_precision fp16 --repeats 1
        --budgets 1.0 --skip_incumbent)

run_cell () {
  local name=$1; shift
  local dir=/home/hzeng/project/ZH/RLNN_lab/$OUT/$name
  if [ -e "$dir/padded/padded_ref0.csv" ]; then
    echo "=== $name SKIP (artifact exists, never overwrite) ==="
    return 0
  fi
  echo "=== [$(date +%H:%M:%S)] $name ==="
  mkdir -p "$dir"
  CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=$GPU $PY -u models/eval_v8_padded.py "${COMMON[@]}" "$@" \
    --result_dir "$dir" --v11_csv "$dir/v11_rows.csv" > tmp/v14_$name.log 2>&1
  local rc=$?
  echo "--- $name exit=$rc ($(date +%H:%M:%S)) ---"
  tail -1 tmp/v14_$name.log
  return $rc
}

for seed in "${SEEDS[@]}"; do
  run_cell "v13_L1_1s_s${seed}"  --seeds "$seed"
  run_cell "v13_L2_1s_s${seed}"  --seeds "$seed" --no_pave --reserve_ms 15
  run_cell "v13_L3_1s_s${seed}"  --seeds "$seed" --no_pave --reserve_ms 15 --compile_model

echo "=== [$(date +%H:%M:%S)] 1 s 三臂完成（seeds: ${SEEDS[*]}）==="

========================================================================
FILE: train_scripts/v11/validation/export_validation_data.py
========================================================================
#!/usr/bin/env python
"""Export the smallest possible slice of the real RB test set for the MATLAB probes.

The MATLAB scripts in this directory must run with base MATLAB only, so every
number they cannot compute themselves (frozen policy solutions, PAVE solutions,
closure gaps, policy trajectories) is exported here as plain text.

What is exported (``--out``, default ``data/``):

``graphs.csv``          graph id, n, m, edge file name
``edges/g######.csv``   one undirected edge per line, ``u,v``, 1-based
``solutions.csv``       graph, kind, level, size, node list (1-based, space separated)
``ladder.csv``          per graph per input level: steps, search size, PAVE(0.1 s)
                        size/gain, unbudgeted platform closure size/gap, density
``trace_best.csv``      best-so-far size every ``--decode_every`` blocks, K=200 and K=20
``trace_pevents.csv``   per-particle size improvements (block, steps, size)
``trace_pcensor.csv``   per-particle observation window (censoring) and final size
``protocol_1000.csv``   the real 1000-graph per-graph sizes of the deployed 1 s table
                        (copied from ``outputs/v8_macro/author_test``), for the power probe

Everything else (destroy/rebuild, exact k-move search, two-phase budget DP,
survival fits) is done in MATLAB on these files.

Run on the training host (CUDA required)::

    cd /home/hzeng/project/ZH/RLNN_lab
    CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 \
        /home/hzeng/envs/rlnn/bin/python train_scripts/v11/validation/export_validation_data.py \
        --graphs 36 --out train_scripts/v11/validation/data
"""

import argparse
import csv
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from time import perf_counter

import numpy as np
import torch

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "models"))

from eval_v2 import dataset_at, load_policy, sync                      # noqa: E402
from eval_v7_budget import run_pave                                   # noqa: E402
from eval_v8_padded import build_parser, decode_top_best              # noqa: E402
from mis_v1 import adjacency                                          # noqa: E402
from mis_baselines import minimum_degree                              # noqa: E402
from mis_v3_search import SearchGraph                                 # noqa: E402
from mis_v3_value import PAVEV3                                       # noqa: E402
from mis_v8_pad import PaddedSearch                                   # noqa: E402
from v7_runs import pave                                              # noqa: E402

TEST_SET = "models/data/MIS_tensors/RB_small_author_test"
PROTOCOL_CSV = "outputs/v8_macro/author_test/capture_budget/capture_budget_ref0.csv"


def eval_args(extra):
    """The deployed v9 configuration, parsed by the very same parser as the eval."""
    parser = build_parser()
    argv = [
        "--test_path", TEST_SET, "--test_samples", "1000", "--split", "test",
        "--save_dir", "outputs/v2/none_seed0/checkpoints", "--num_k", "200",
        "--reference_seed", "0", "--seeds", "1017", "--dense",
        "--decoders", "captured", "--budgets", "1.0",
        "--outer_rounds", "8", "--exchange_rounds", "3", "--horizon", "1",
        "--candidate_cap", "32", "--improving_cap", "48", "--repair_rounds", "4",
        "--result_dir", "/tmp/v11_export_unused",
    ]
    return parser.parse_args(argv + list(extra))


def node_list(mask, n):
    return [i + 1 for i in range(n) if (mask >> i) & 1]


def column_sizes(problem, states, adj, bias, cols, nodes):
    subset = states[: int(nodes), cols].contiguous()
    solutions = problem.decode_gradient_flip(subset, adj, bias, return_solutions=True)
    return [int(v) for v in solutions.sum(dim=0).cpu().numpy().tolist()]


def pick_indices(dataset, count, seed=7):
    """``count`` graphs spread over the n-quantiles of the split (different sizes)."""
    sizes = []
    for index in range(len(dataset)):
        graph = torch.load(dataset.files[index], map_location="cpu", weights_only=False)
        sizes.append(int(graph["num_nodes"]))
    order = sorted(range(len(dataset)), key=lambda i: (sizes[i], i))
    picks = sorted({order[int(round((k + 0.5) / count * (len(order) - 1)))]
                    for k in range(count)})
    return picks, sizes


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--graphs", type=int, default=36)
    parser.add_argument("--budgets", type=float, nargs="+", default=[0.05, 0.1, 0.2, 0.5, 1.0])
    parser.add_argument("--pave_budget", type=float, default=0.1,
                        help="PAVE clock used for the G-vs-C ladder (paper: 0.1 s)")
    parser.add_argument("--post_reserve", type=float, default=0.05)
    parser.add_argument("--reserve_frac", type=float, default=0.2)
    parser.add_argument("--trace_blocks_k200", type=int, default=140)
    parser.add_argument("--trace_blocks_k20", type=int, default=300)
    parser.add_argument("--decode_every", type=int, default=5)
    parser.add_argument("--particles", type=int, default=20)
    parser.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=1017)
    parser.add_argument("--out", default=str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "data"))
    parser.add_argument("--skip_protocol", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    out = Path(args.out)
    (out / "edges").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    ev = eval_args([])
    ev.seeds = [args.seed]

    solver = load_policy(ev)
    solver.model.requires_grad_(False)
    solver.num_t = 20000  # the A.3 decode fixed point, as in eval_v8_padded
    checkpoint = torch.load(pave(ev.reference_seed), map_location="cpu", weights_only=False)
    ranker = PAVEV3(checkpoint["mode"], checkpoint.get("stats_dim", 24))
    ranker.load_state_dict(checkpoint["model_state"])
    ranker = ranker.cpu().eval()
    device = solver.accelerator.device
    dataset = dataset_at(ev.test_path, solver.dtype, 1000, official=True)
    picks, sizes = pick_indices(dataset, args.graphs)
    n_max, capacity = max(sizes), 105
    print(f"picked {len(picks)} graphs, n in [{min(sizes)} , {max(sizes)}]", flush=True)

    engine = PaddedSearch(solver, n_max=n_max, capacity=capacity, chunk=10,
                          device=device, decode_chunk=4, dense=True)
    engine.load(dataset[0].to(device), dataset[0].edge_index, args.seed)
    engine.run(perf_counter() + 0.05, lambda states: None)
    sync(device)
    solver.num_k = 20
    engine20 = PaddedSearch(solver, n_max=n_max, capacity=capacity, chunk=10,
                            device=device, decode_chunk=4, dense=True)
    engine20.load(dataset[0].to(device), dataset[0].edge_index, args.seed)
    engine20.run(perf_counter() + 0.05, lambda states: None)
    sync(device)
    solver.num_k = 200

    meta_rows, sol_rows, ladder_rows = [], [], []
    best_rows, event_rows, censor_rows = [], [], []

    for position, index in enumerate(picks):
        graph_cpu = dataset[index]
        graph = graph_cpu.to(device)
        n = int(graph.num_nodes)
        edges = graph_cpu.edge_index
        adj = adjacency(graph)
        bias = graph.b
        topology = SearchGraph(n, edges, seed=args.seed)
        neighbours = topology.neighbors
        name = Path(dataset.files[index]).stem
        uid = index

        source = edges.cpu().numpy()
        pairs = sorted({(int(min(a, b)), int(max(a, b)))
                        for a, b in zip(source[0].tolist(), source[1].tolist()) if a != b})
        edge_file = f"edges/e{uid:06d}.csv"
        with (out / edge_file).open("w", newline="") as handle:
            writer = csv.writer(handle)
            for u, v in pairs:
                writer.writerow([u + 1, v + 1])
        meta_rows.append(dict(id=uid, name=name, n=n, m=len(pairs), edges=edge_file))

        levels = {}
        for budget in args.budgets:
            tick = perf_counter()
            reserve = min(args.post_reserve, args.reserve_frac * budget)
            cutoff = tick + budget - reserve
            box = []

            def decode(best, box=box):
                candidate = decode_top_best(solver.problem, best, engine.best_energy, adj,
                                            bias, n, 4)
                box.append(candidate)

            engine.load(graph, edges, args.seed)
            decode(engine.best_states)
            steps, _, blocks = engine.run(cutoff, decode, decode_every=1000)
            sync(device)
            seconds = perf_counter() - tick
            selected = max(box, key=int.bit_count)
            levels[f"{budget:g}"] = dict(size=selected.bit_count(), steps=steps,
                                         seconds=seconds, mask=selected, budget=budget,
                                         reserve=reserve)
            sol_rows.append(dict(id=uid, kind="search", level=f"{budget:g}",
                                 size=selected.bit_count(),
                                 nodes=" ".join(map(str, node_list(selected, n)))))

        # The bottom of the quality ladder: the same min-degree greedy that
        # ``eval_pave_external --source min_degree`` uses (``mis_baselines.py:12``).
        greedy = minimum_degree(graph_cpu).to(torch.uint8).cpu().numpy()
        greedy_mask = 0
        for node in range(n):
            if greedy[node]:
                greedy_mask |= 1 << node
        levels["greedy"] = dict(size=greedy_mask.bit_count(), steps=0, seconds=0.0,
                                mask=greedy_mask, budget=0.0, reserve=0.0)
        sol_rows.append(dict(id=uid, kind="search", level="greedy",
                             size=greedy_mask.bit_count(),
                             nodes=" ".join(map(str, node_list(greedy_mask, n)))))

        for level, info in levels.items():
            selected = info["mask"]
            mark = perf_counter()
            pave_small = run_pave(topology, selected, ranker, ev, mark + args.pave_budget)
            sync(device)
            closed = run_pave(topology, selected, ranker, ev, mark + 3600.0)
            sync(device)
            gain = pave_small.bit_count() - selected.bit_count()
            gap = closed.bit_count() - selected.bit_count()
            ladder_rows.append(dict(
                id=uid, n=n, m=len(pairs), level=level, budget=info["budget"],
                steps=info["steps"], seconds=round(info["seconds"], 4),
                search_size=selected.bit_count(), rho=round(selected.bit_count() / n, 6),
                pave01_size=pave_small.bit_count(), pave01_gain=gain,
                c_inf_size=closed.bit_count(), c_inf_gap=gap))
            sol_rows.append(dict(id=uid, kind="pave01", level=level,
                                 size=pave_small.bit_count(),
                                 nodes=" ".join(map(str, node_list(pave_small, n)))))
            sol_rows.append(dict(id=uid, kind="c_inf", level=level,
                                 size=closed.bit_count(),
                                 nodes=" ".join(map(str, node_list(closed, n)))))
            if level == "1":
                mark2 = perf_counter()
                deployed = run_pave(topology, selected, ranker, ev, mark2 + args.post_reserve)
                sync(device)
                sol_rows.append(dict(id=uid, kind="pave_deployed", level="1.0",
                                     size=deployed.bit_count(),
                                     nodes=" ".join(map(str, node_list(deployed, n)))))
            print(f"  [{position + 1}/{len(picks)}] {name} n={n} m={len(pairs)} "
                  f"level={level} steps={info['steps']} size={selected.bit_count()} "
                  f"gain={gain:+d} gap={gap:+d}", flush=True)

        for tag, eng, blocks in (("K200", engine, args.trace_blocks_k200),
                                 ("K20", engine20, args.trace_blocks_k20)):
            columns = torch.arange(min(args.particles, eng.num_k), device=device)
            events = []
            records = []
            start = perf_counter()
            last = {}

            def on_block(count, eng=eng, columns=columns, start=start, events=events,
                         records=records, last=last):
                if count % args.decode_every:
                    return
                sizes_now = column_sizes(solver.problem, eng.best_states, adj, bias,
                                         columns, n)
                now = perf_counter() - start
                records.append((count, count * eng.chunk, round(now, 4),
                                max(sizes_now)))
                for column, value in enumerate(sizes_now):
                    if value > last.get(column, -1):
                        last[column] = value
                        events.append((column, count, count * eng.chunk, value))

            eng.load(graph, edges, args.seed)
            eng.run(start + 60.0, lambda states: None, max_blocks=blocks,
                    decode_every=10 ** 7, on_block=on_block)
            sync(device)
            whole = perf_counter() - start
            for count, steps, now, best in records:
                best_rows.append(dict(id=uid, K=tag, rec=count, steps=steps, t=now,
                                      best=best))
            for column, count, steps, value in events:
                event_rows.append(dict(id=uid, K=tag, particle=column + 1, block=count,
                                       steps=steps, size=value))
            for column in range(len(columns)):
                final = last.get(column, 0)
                censor_rows.append(dict(id=uid, K=tag, particle=column + 1,
                                        last_block=blocks, last_steps=blocks * eng.chunk,
                                        last_t=round(whole, 4), final_size=final))
            print(f"  [{position + 1}/{len(picks)}] {name} trace {tag} "
                  f"{blocks} blocks in {whole:.2f}s records={len(records)} "
                  f"events={len(events)}", flush=True)

        if (position + 1) % 5 == 0:
            write_csv(out, meta_rows, sol_rows, ladder_rows, best_rows, event_rows,
                      censor_rows)

    write_csv(out, meta_rows, sol_rows, ladder_rows, best_rows, event_rows, censor_rows)

    if not args.skip_protocol:
        source = Path(ROOT / PROTOCOL_CSV)
        sizes_by_id = {Path(dataset.files[i]).stem: sizes[i] for i in range(len(dataset))}
        rows = 0
        with source.open() as handle, (out / "protocol_1000.csv").open("w", newline="") as sink:
            reader = csv.DictReader(handle)
            writer = csv.writer(sink)
            writer.writerow(["graph_id", "n", "budget", "cell", "seed", "final_size"])
            for row in reader:
                if abs(float(row["budget"]) - 1.0) > 1e-9:
                    continue
                stem = f"graph_{int(row['graph_id'].split('_')[-1]):06d}"
                writer.writerow([row["graph_id"].split("_")[-1], sizes_by_id.get(stem, 0),
                                 row["budget"], row["cell"], row["search_seed"],
                                 row["final_size"]])
                rows += 1
        print(f"protocol_1000.csv: {rows} rows", flush=True)

    summary = dict(graphs=len(picks), budgets=args.budgets, seed=args.seed,
                   n_max=n_max, capacity=capacity,
                   pave_budget=args.pave_budget, post_reserve=args.post_reserve,
                   trace_blocks=dict(K200=args.trace_blocks_k200,
                                     K20=args.trace_blocks_k20),
                   decode_every=args.decode_every, particles=args.particles)
    (out / "export_meta.json").write_text(json.dumps(summary, indent=2))
    print("done", flush=True)


def write_csv(out, meta_rows, sol_rows, ladder_rows, best_rows, event_rows, censor_rows):
    def dump(name, rows):
        if not rows:
            return
        with (out / name).open("w", newline="") as handle:
            writer = csv.DictWriter(handle, fieldnames=list(rows[0]))
            writer.writeheader()
            writer.writerows(rows)

    dump("graphs.csv", meta_rows)
    dump("solutions.csv", sol_rows)
    dump("ladder.csv", ladder_rows)
    dump("trace_best.csv", best_rows)
    dump("trace_pevents.csv", event_rows)
    dump("trace_pcensor.csv", censor_rows)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()


========================================================================
FILE: train_scripts/v11/validation/k_sweep_steps.py
========================================================================
"""M6 步数匹配对照：固定步数（而不是固定时钟），比较 num_k。

部署 arm 在 1.0 s 里实际走 ~808 步；K 变小 → 每步更便宜 → 1 s 内步数更多。
于是「K 小更好」可能只是「步数更多」。这里两条臂都**恰好跑 S 步**
（S = 808 或部署臂实测步数），只留 num_k 一个变量，比较端点 SIZE。

与 eval_v8_padded.main 的差别只有三处，其余（padded/captured、dense、fp16、
warm start、A.3 解码、top-4 选取）逐项相同：
  1. ``engine.run(float("inf"), ..., max_blocks=ceil(S / chunk))`` —— 用步数而非时钟收尾；
  2. 不做末端 PAVE（PAVE 是固定后处理，两条臂一样；这里比较 search_size 更干净）；
  3. 每图多记 ``archive_best``（不解码，直接用 20/200 列档案的最大能量对应 size）。

用法：
  python train_scripts/v11/validation/k_sweep_steps.py --num_k 20 --fixed_steps 808 \
      --test_samples 200 --dense --decode_top 4 \
      --save_dir outputs/v2/none_seed0/checkpoints --result_dir outputs/v11_validation/steps808_k20
"""

import argparse
import csv
import math
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from time import perf_counter

import numpy as np
import torch

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "models"))

from eval_v2 import dataset_at, load_policy, sync  # noqa: E402
from eval_v8_padded import build_parser, decode_top_best, shape_of  # noqa: E402
from mis_v1 import adjacency  # noqa: E402
from mis_v8_pad import PaddedSearch  # noqa: E402


def main():
    parser = build_parser()
    parser.add_argument("--fixed_steps", type=int, required=True,
                        help="两条臂都恰好跑这么多步（chunk 向上取整）")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if not args.dense:
        raise SystemExit("M6 步数匹配对照必须在部署口径下跑：请加 --dense")
    args.arms = ["padded"]
    args.decoders = ["captured"]
    args.temperatures = [1.0]
    args.anneal = 0
    args.repeats = 1
    args.budgets = [0.0]

    solver = load_policy(args)
    device = solver.accelerator.device
    dataset = dataset_at(args.test_path, solver.dtype, args.test_samples,
                         official=args.split == "test")
    n_max, capacity = shape_of(dataset, args.padded_shapes)
    blocks_target = int(math.ceil(args.fixed_steps / args.chunk))
    print(f"padded shape: nodes {n_max}, capacity {capacity}; "
          f"num_k={args.num_k} fixed_steps={args.fixed_steps} "
          f"-> max_blocks={blocks_target} ({blocks_target * args.chunk} 步上限)", flush=True)

    engine = PaddedSearch(solver, n_max=n_max, capacity=capacity, chunk=args.chunk,
                          device=device, decode_chunk=args.decode_chunk, dense=args.dense)
    engine.load(dataset[0].to(device), dataset[0].edge_index, args.seeds[0])
    engine.run(perf_counter() + 0.05, lambda states: None)
    sync(device)

    extended = 20000
    solver.num_t = extended
    rows = []
    for index in range(len(dataset)):
        graph = dataset[index]
        graph_id = f"idx_{index}" if args.split == "test" else Path(dataset.files[index]).stem
        edges = graph.edge_index
        n = int(graph.num_nodes)
        graph = graph.to(device)
        adj = adjacency(graph)
        seed = args.seeds[0]
        sync(device)
        tick = perf_counter()
        incumbent = 0
        box = []

        def decode(best):
            nonlocal incumbent
            candidate = decode_top_best(solver.problem, best, engine.best_energy, adj,
                                        graph.b, n, args.decode_top)
            if candidate.bit_count() > incumbent:
                incumbent = candidate.bit_count()
                box.append(candidate)

        loaded = engine.load(graph, edges, seed)
        decode(engine.best_states)
        prelude = perf_counter() - tick
        steps, decode_seconds, blocks = engine.run(
            float("inf"), decode, max_blocks=blocks_target, decode_every=10 ** 9)
        sync(device)
        total = perf_counter() - tick
        best_bits = engine.decode_best(engine.best_states)
        rows.append(dict(
            graph_id=graph_id, num_k=args.num_k, fixed_steps=args.fixed_steps,
            steps=steps, blocks=blocks, nodes=n,
            search_size=incumbent, archive_best=best_bits.bit_count(),
            total_s=round(total, 4), prelude_s=round(prelude, 4),
            ms_per_step=round(1000.0 * (total - prelude) / max(steps, 1), 4),
        ))
        if (index + 1) % 25 == 0:
            mean_size = sum(r["search_size"] for r in rows) / len(rows)
            print(f"  [{index + 1}/{len(dataset)}] mean SIZE {mean_size:.4f} "
                  f"steps {steps} ms/step {rows[-1]['ms_per_step']:.3f}", flush=True)

    out = Path(args.result_dir)
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path = out / f"steps{args.fixed_steps}_k{args.num_k}.csv"
    with path.open("w", newline="") as handle:
        writer = csv.DictWriter(handle, fieldnames=list(rows[0]))
        writer.writeheader()
        writer.writerows(rows)
    mean_size = sum(r["search_size"] for r in rows) / len(rows)
    mean_arch = sum(r["archive_best"] for r in rows) / len(rows)
    mean_ms = sum(r["ms_per_step"] for r in rows) / len(rows)
    print(f"done: {len(rows)} graphs, mean search_size {mean_size:.4f}, "
          f"archive_best {mean_arch:.4f}, steps {rows[-1]['steps']}, "
          f"ms/step {mean_ms:.3f} -> {path}", flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# M6 K 扫描（部署口径）：只改 num_k，其余逐项相同。
#   部署口径 = padded/captured + dense + fp16 + 1.0 s deadline + seed 1017
#             + warm start outputs/v2/none_seed0/checkpoints/best.pt
#             + --decode_every 1000 --decode_top 4（末端解码 + top4，即 808 步 / 1.179 ms 那套）
# 图集：官方 manifest 顺序的 idx 0..199（--test_samples 200，规则固定可复现）
# 用法：bash train_scripts/v11/validation/k_sweep_v11.sh <gpu>
set -uo pipefail
cd /home/hzeng/project/ZH/RLNN_lab || exit 1
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1
GPU=${1:-1}
PY=/home/hzeng/envs/rlnn/bin/python
OUT=outputs/v11_validation

for K in 20 50 100 200; do
  NAME=k${K}_n200_1s
  echo "=== [$(date +%H:%M:%S)] $NAME ==="
  CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=$GPU $PY -u models/eval_v8_padded.py \
    --test_path models/data/MIS_tensors/RB_small_author_test --test_samples 200 \
    --shards 1 --shard 0 --budgets 1.0 --seeds 1017 --reference_seed 0 \
    --save_dir outputs/v2/none_seed0/checkpoints --num_k $K --decoders captured \
    --decode_every 1000 --decode_top 4 --dense \
    --result_dir /home/hzeng/project/ZH/RLNN_lab/$OUT/$NAME \
    > tmp/$NAME.log 2>&1
  echo "--- $NAME exit=$? ---"
  tail -3 tmp/$NAME.log
done

# 步数匹配对照：固定 808 步（与部署 1 s 实际步数一致），K ∈ {20,200}
for K in 20 200; do
  NAME=steps808_k${K}_n200
  echo "=== [$(date +%H:%M:%S)] $NAME ==="
  CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=$GPU $PY -u train_scripts/v11/validation/k_sweep_steps.py \
    --num_k $K --fixed_steps 808 --test_samples 200 --seeds 1017 \
    --save_dir outputs/v2/none_seed0/checkpoints --dense --decode_top 4 \
    --result_dir /home/hzeng/project/ZH/RLNN_lab/$OUT/$NAME \
    > tmp/$NAME.log 2>&1
  echo "--- $NAME exit=$? ---"
  tail -3 tmp/$NAME.log
done
echo "ALL DONE $(date +%H:%M:%S)"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

ROOT="$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd)"
cd "$ROOT"
export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="${CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES:-0}"
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1
export PYTORCH_ALLOC_CONF=backend:cudaMallocAsync
export RLNN_SOURCE_SHA="${RLNN_SOURCE_SHA:-$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)-unversioned}"
export RLNN_SOURCE_BRANCH="${RLNN_SOURCE_BRANCH:-v7-tccr}"

PYTHON="${PYTHON:-/home/hzeng/envs/rlnn/bin/python}"
SCRIPTS="$ROOT/train_scripts/v7"
OUT="${OUT_V7:-$ROOT/outputs/v7_tccr}"
DATA="$ROOT/models/data/MIS_tensors"
REFERENCE_SEED="${REFERENCE_SEED:-0}"
SAMPLES="${SAMPLES:-100}"
SEEDS="${SEEDS:-1017 1019 1021}"

backbone_dir() {
  echo "$ROOT/outputs/v2/none_seed${REFERENCE_SEED}/checkpoints"
}

v7_args() {
  EXTRA=()
  while (($#)); do
    if [[ "$1" == --gpu ]]; then
      export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="${2:?pass one GPU index}"
      shift 2
    else
      EXTRA+=("$1")
      shift
    fi
  done
}

FILE: train_scripts/v7/README.md
========================================================================
# v7 · TCCR 普查

研究点：**利用轨迹信息定位传统邻域触达不到的联合改进**（TCCR：Trajectory-guided Conflict-Certified Reoptimization）。本目录只放第一阶段的**不训练普查**：先确认这两类联合动作在 RB200–300 上到底还有多少可拿的量，再决定要不要做模型。

方案与门槛：预注册见 [docs/temporary/RLNN_v7_TCCR_Prereg.md](../../docs/temporary/RLNN_v7_TCCR_Prereg.md)。本目录的脚本只跑普查，不训练、不改 PAVE、不写回搜索。

| 文件 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `common.sh` | 路径、Python、`OUT_V7`、`SEEDS`、`backbone_dir`、`--gpu` 解析 |
| `check.sh` | 算子单测（`models/check_v7.py`）＋ 捕获一致性（自己的 T100 捕获 vs `eval_v2.search`） |
| `probe.sh` | 单参考种子普查，`recombine` / `conflict` / `both` 三选一 |
| `probe_pipeline.sh` | 端到端固定工作量：A.3 / 重组 / 冻结 PAVE / 重组+PAVE 四个解的大小 |
| `probe_budget.sh` | 截止时间两臂（同预算、重组从搜索里扣时间）＋ B1–B5 判决 |
| `probe_all.sh` | 多参考种子循环 + 汇总判决 |
| `summarize.py` | 图级配对统计、bootstrap CI、G1–G5 门槛与 `decision.json` |
| `summarize_budget.py` | ABBA 重复平均、图级配对 Δ、B1–B5 门槛与 `decision_budget.json` |

## 运行

```bash
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 bash train_scripts/v7/check.sh
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 bash train_scripts/v7/probe.sh both
REFERENCE_SEED=0 bash train_scripts/v7/probe_pipeline.sh
BUDGETS="0.5 1.0" bash train_scripts/v7/probe_budget.sh
REFERENCE_SEED=1 bash train_scripts/v7/probe.sh both --gpu 1
REFS="0 1 2" bash train_scripts/v7/probe_all.sh both
```

`SAMPLES=100`、`SEEDS="1017 1019 1021"` 为默认；`CUDA_GRAPH=1` 可切到 CUDA Graph 捕获路径（与 `eval_structure` 同口径）。`REFERENCE_SEED=0/1/2` 对应骨干与 PAVE 的种子 0/1/2。

## 产物

| 路径 | 内容 |
| --- | --- |
| `outputs/v7_tccr/census/recombine_ref{r}.csv` | 每（图, 搜索种子）一行：去重数、两两 Hamming/Jaccard、190 对 Oracle、四个固定预算选对策略、每次重组耗时 |
| `outputs/v7_tccr/census/conflict_ref{r}.csv` | 每（图, 搜索种子, 层）一行：`a3` / `pave` 两层的区域数、改善区域数、`k=2/3/4` 的最大增益、窗口大小、普查耗时 |
| `outputs/v7_tccr/pipeline/pipeline_ref{r}.csv` | 每（图, 搜索种子）一行：A.3／重组／PAVE／重组+PAVE 四个解的大小与分段耗时 |
| `outputs/v7_tccr/pipeline/run_ref{r}.json` | 端到端运行的配置、均值与 SHA |
| `outputs/v7_tccr/budget/budget_ref{r}.csv` | 每（图, 种子, 预算, 臂, 重复）一行：解大小、搜索步数、段耗时、是否超时 |
| `outputs/v7_tccr/analysis/summary_budget_ref{r}.json` | 两档预算的配对 Δ、CI 与 B1–B5 判决 |
| `outputs/v7_tccr/census/run_ref{r}.json` | 配置、种子、耗时、骨干与 PAVE 的 SHA、数据清单 SHA |
| `outputs/v7_tccr/checks/run.json` | 捕获一致性逐图记录（`match=1` 表示与 `eval_v2.search` 逐位相同） |
| `outputs/v7_tccr/analysis/decision.json` | G1–G5 与最终判决（`advance` / `recombine_only` / `conflict_only` / `stop`） |

## 口径

- K20 / T100 / A.3 / 冻结 PAVE-Stats H1，验证集前 100 图，非测试集。
- 图级值先在搜索种子内平均，再按图 bootstrap；不把 (图, 种子) 当独立样本。
- 所有合法解都用两套独立实现交叉校验：`SearchGraph.feasible`（搜索侧）与 `mis_v7_recombine.is_independent`（bitset 侧）。
- 局部 MIS 精确解上限 60 节点，超限退化为贪心并在 `exact_k=0` 记录；普查中出现 `exact_k=0` 时结论只看有精确解的行。

## 停止规则

G1–G5 任一组合不满足时按预注册判决表处理，不调门槛、不换图子集、不换种子救回。`stop` 时下一步是诊断 KaMIS 那 0.44 的差距落在哪类图/哪类结构上，而不是继续堆模块。

## 本轮结论

三个参考种子一致：重组在**冻结 PAVE 之上**还有 +0.088（69/231/0），区域通道只有 +0.043（8–15/100 图）。但预算门（0.5 秒／1.0 秒）给出 −0.028／+0.010，20 ms 的搜索时间值 +0.060 > 重组增益 +0.033，按预注册是 `budget_fail`：这条线到此为止。完整读数、机制与下一步见 [docs/temporary/RLNN_v7_TCCR_Results.md](../../docs/temporary/RLNN_v7_TCCR_Results.md)。


========================================================================
FILE: train_scripts/v7/summarize.py
========================================================================
"""Summarize the v7 TCCR census and apply the pre-registered gates.

Reads the per-graph CSVs written by ``models/diagnose_v7_census.py`` and applies
the thresholds fixed in ``docs/temporary/RLNN_v7_TCCR_Prereg.md``:

    python train_scripts/v7/summarize.py --root outputs/v7_tccr --refs 0 1 2

Graph-level values are averaged over search seeds first, so a graph never counts
twice.  Intervals are graph-level bootstrap with a fixed RNG seed.
"""
import argparse
import csv
import json
from pathlib import Path
from statistics import mean

import numpy as np

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "outputs/v7_tccr"
DRAWS = 2000
RNG_SEED = 20261111
GATE = dict(gain=0.10, graphs=20, pair_us=2000.0, arm_fraction=0.5,
            census_ms=2000.0, census_p95=4000.0, joint_graphs=10)


def load(folder, pattern):
    rows = []
    for path in sorted(Path(folder).glob(pattern)):
        with path.open(encoding="utf-8", newline="") as stream:
            rows.extend(csv.DictReader(stream))
    return rows


def draws(count):
    return np.random.default_rng(RNG_SEED).integers(0, count, size=(DRAWS, count))


def effect(values):
    array = np.asarray(values, dtype=float)
    if array.size == 0:
        return dict(count=0, mean=0.0, ci95=[0.0, 0.0], wins=0, ties=0, losses=0)
    sample = draws(array.size)
    return dict(count=int(array.size), mean=float(array.mean()),
                ci95=np.quantile(array[sample].mean(axis=1), [.025, .975]).tolist(),
                wins=int((array > 0).sum()), ties=int((array == 0).sum()),
                losses=int((array < 0).sum()))


def per_graph(rows, key):
    buckets = {}
    for row in rows:
        buckets.setdefault(row["graph_id"], []).append(float(row[key]))
    return {graph: float(np.mean(values)) for graph, values in buckets.items()}


def per_graph_best(rows, sizes):
    buckets = {}
    for row in rows:
        value = max(float(row[f"gain_{size}"]) for size in sizes)
        buckets.setdefault(row["graph_id"], []).append(value)
    return {graph: float(np.mean(values)) for graph, values in buckets.items()}


def percentile(values, share):
    array = np.sort(np.asarray(values, dtype=float))
    if array.size == 0:
        return 0.0
    index = min(array.size - 1, int(round(share * (array.size - 1))))
    return float(array[index])


def recombine_block(folder, ref, sizes):
    rows = load(folder, f"recombine_ref{ref}*.csv")
    if not rows:
        return None
    gains = per_graph(rows, "oracle_gain")
    oracle = effect(list(gains.values()))
    distinct = per_graph(rows, "distinct")
    union = per_graph(rows, "union_size")
    best = per_graph(rows, "best_size")
    jaccard = per_graph(rows, "jaccard_mean")
    arms = {name: effect(list(per_graph(rows, f"arm_{name}").values()))
            for name in ("random", "hamming", "top_size", "matching_cost")}
    cost_us = mean(float(row["oracle_us_per_pair"]) for row in rows)
    follow = arms["hamming"]["mean"]
    return dict(graphs=len(gains), oracle=oracle,
                improved_graphs=sum(value > 0 for value in gains.values()),
                mean_distinct=mean(distinct.values()), mean_union=mean(union.values()),
                mean_best_size=mean(best.values()), mean_jaccard=mean(jaccard.values()),
                arms=arms, us_per_pair=cost_us,
                hamming_fraction=(follow / oracle["mean"]) if oracle["mean"] else None,
                improving_pairs=mean(float(row["improving_pairs"]) for row in rows),
                useful_pairs=mean(float(row.get("useful_pairs", 0)) for row in rows),
                pairwise_gain_max=mean(float(row.get("pairwise_gain_max", 0)) for row in rows),
                pair_count=mean(float(row["pair_count"]) for row in rows),
                full_oracle_ms=mean(float(row["pair_count"]) for row in rows) * cost_us / 1000)


def conflict_block(folder, ref, sizes, layer, subset=None):
    rows = [row for row in load(folder, f"conflict_ref{ref}*.csv") if row["layer"] == layer]
    if subset is not None:
        rows = [row for row in rows if int(row["stalled"]) == subset]
    if not rows:
        return None
    best = effect(list(per_graph_best(rows, sizes).values()))
    per_size = {}
    for size in sizes:
        gains = per_graph(rows, f"gain_{size}")
        per_size[size] = dict(gain=effect(list(gains.values())),
                              improved_graphs=sum(value > 0 for value in gains.values()),
                              regions=mean(float(row[f"regions_{size}"]) for row in rows),
                              improving=mean(float(row[f"improving_{size}"]) for row in rows))
    census = [float(row["census_ms"]) for row in rows]
    return dict(graphs=len(per_graph(rows, "final_size")), best=best, per_size=per_size,
                census_ms=mean(census), census_p95=percentile(census, .95),
                mean_final_size=mean(float(row["final_size"]) for row in rows),
                mean_pave_gain=mean(float(row["pave_gain"]) for row in rows))


def pipeline_block(root, ref):
    rows = load(Path(root) / "pipeline", f"pipeline_ref{ref}*.csv")
    if not rows:
        return None
    a3 = per_graph(rows, "a3_size")
    merged = per_graph(rows, "recombine_size")
    pave = per_graph(rows, "pave_size")
    both = per_graph(rows, "recombine_pave_size")
    pairs = {graph: merged[graph] - a3[graph] for graph in a3}
    marginal = {graph: both[graph] - pave[graph] for graph in a3}
    pave_gain = {graph: pave[graph] - a3[graph] for graph in a3}
    return dict(graphs=len(a3),
                mean_a3=mean(a3.values()), mean_recombine=mean(merged.values()),
                mean_pave=mean(pave.values()), mean_recombine_pave=mean(both.values()),
                recombine_effect=effect(list(pairs.values())),
                pave_effect=effect(list(pave_gain.values())),
                marginal_over_pave=effect(list(marginal.values())),
                recombine_ms=mean(float(row["recombine_ms"]) for row in rows),
                pave_ms=mean(float(row["pave_ms"]) for row in rows),
                pairs=mean(float(row["pairs"]) for row in rows))


def decision(recombine, conflict, joint_graphs):
    gates = {}
    if recombine is not None:
        gates["G1"] = dict(passed=recombine["oracle"]["mean"] >= GATE["gain"]
                           and recombine["oracle"]["ci95"][0] > 0
                           and recombine["improved_graphs"] >= GATE["graphs"],
                           mean_gain=recombine["oracle"]["mean"],
                           ci95=recombine["oracle"]["ci95"],
                           improved_graphs=recombine["improved_graphs"])
        gates["G2"] = dict(passed=recombine["us_per_pair"] <= GATE["pair_us"]
                           and (recombine["hamming_fraction"] or 0) >= GATE["arm_fraction"],
                           us_per_pair=recombine["us_per_pair"],
                           hamming_fraction=recombine["hamming_fraction"])
    if conflict is not None:
        gates["G3"] = dict(passed=conflict["best"]["mean"] >= GATE["gain"]
                           and conflict["best"]["ci95"][0] > 0
                           and conflict["best"]["wins"] >= GATE["graphs"],
                           mean_gain=conflict["best"]["mean"],
                           ci95=conflict["best"]["ci95"],
                           improved_graphs=conflict["best"]["wins"])
        gates["G4"] = dict(passed=conflict["census_ms"] <= GATE["census_ms"]
                           and conflict["census_p95"] <= GATE["census_p95"],
                           census_ms=conflict["census_ms"], census_p95=conflict["census_p95"])
        gates["G5"] = dict(passed=joint_graphs >= GATE["joint_graphs"],
                           graphs_with_three_to_four=joint_graphs)
    recombine_ok = bool(gates.get("G1", {}).get("passed")) and bool(gates.get("G2", {}).get("passed"))
    conflict_ok = (bool(gates.get("G3", {}).get("passed")) and bool(gates.get("G4", {}).get("passed"))
                   and bool(gates.get("G5", {}).get("passed")))
    if recombine_ok and conflict_ok:
        status = "advance"
    elif recombine_ok:
        status = "recombine_only"
    elif conflict_ok:
        status = "conflict_only"
    else:
        status = "stop"
    return dict(status=status, gates=gates, thresholds=GATE,
                recombine_passed=bool(recombine_ok), conflict_passed=bool(conflict_ok))


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--root", type=Path, default=ROOT)
    parser.add_argument("--refs", type=int, nargs="+", default=[0])
    parser.add_argument("--sizes", type=int, nargs="+", default=[2, 3, 4])
    args = parser.parse_args()
    folder = args.root / "census"
    analysis = args.root / "analysis"
    analysis.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    pooled = []
    for ref in args.refs:
        recombine = recombine_block(folder, ref, args.sizes)
        conflict = conflict_block(folder, ref, args.sizes, "pave")
        stalled = conflict_block(folder, ref, args.sizes, "pave", subset=1)
        a3 = conflict_block(folder, ref, args.sizes, "a3")
        joint = 0
        if conflict is not None:
            rows = [row for row in load(folder, f"conflict_ref{ref}*.csv") if row["layer"] == "pave"]
            joint = len({row["graph_id"] for row in rows if float(row["gain_3"]) >= 1})
        verdict = decision(recombine, conflict, joint) if recombine or conflict else None
        summary = dict(version="v7_tccr", ref=ref, sizes=args.sizes,
                       recombine=recombine, conflict_pave=conflict, conflict_a3=a3,
                       conflict_stalled=stalled, verdict=verdict)
        summary["pipeline"] = pipeline_block(args.root, ref)
        (analysis / f"summary_ref{ref}.json").write_text(
            json.dumps(summary, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
        if verdict is not None:
            (analysis / f"decision_ref{ref}.json").write_text(
                json.dumps(verdict, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
        pooled.append(dict(ref=ref, status=verdict["status"] if verdict else "missing"))
        print(f"ref{ref}: " + (verdict["status"] if verdict else "no data"))
    (analysis / "decision.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(dict(version="v7_tccr", mode="census", refs=args.refs, results=pooled,
                        thresholds=GATE), indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()


========================================================================
FILE: train_scripts/v7/summarize_budget.py
========================================================================
"""Summarize the v7 budget (deadline) evaluation against its pre-registered gates.

Reads ``outputs/v7_tccr/budget/budget_ref{r}.csv``, averages the two ABBA repeats
per (graph, seed, budget, arm), forms the paired difference
``recombine - baseline`` per pair and then per graph, and applies B1-B5 from
``docs/temporary/RLNN_v7_TCCR_Prereg_Budget.md``.

    python train_scripts/v7/summarize_budget.py --root outputs/v7_tccr --refs 0
"""
import argparse
import csv
import json
from pathlib import Path
from statistics import mean

import numpy as np

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "outputs/v7_tccr"
DRAWS = 2000
RNG_SEED = 20261111
GATE = dict(mean_delta=0.05, loss_share=0.10, recombine_ms=25.0)


def load(path):
    with Path(path).open(encoding="utf-8", newline="") as stream:
        return list(csv.DictReader(stream))


def effect(values):
    array = np.asarray(values, dtype=float)
    if array.size == 0:
        return dict(count=0, mean=0.0, ci95=[0.0, 0.0], wins=0, ties=0, losses=0)
    rng = np.random.default_rng(RNG_SEED)
    draws = rng.integers(0, array.size, size=(DRAWS, array.size))
    return dict(count=int(array.size), mean=float(array.mean()),
                ci95=np.quantile(array[draws].mean(axis=1), [.025, .975]).tolist(),
                wins=int((array > 0).sum()), ties=int((array == 0).sum()),
                losses=int((array < 0).sum()))


def arm_means(rows, budget):
    """Mean final size per (graph, seed, arm) over the ABBA repeats."""
    buckets = {}
    for row in rows:
        if float(row["budget"]) != budget:
            continue
        key = (row["graph_id"], row["search_seed"], row["arm"])
        buckets.setdefault(key, []).append(float(row["final_size"]))
    return {key: float(np.mean(values)) for key, values in buckets.items()}


def budget_block(rows, budget):
    means = arm_means(rows, budget)
    graphs = sorted({key[0] for key in means})
    seeds = sorted({key[1] for key in means})
    per_seed = []
    for graph in graphs:
        for seed in seeds:
            base = means.get((graph, seed, "baseline"))
            rec = means.get((graph, seed, "recombine"))
            if base is not None and rec is not None:
                per_seed.append(rec - base)
    per_graph = {}
    for graph in graphs:
        deltas = [means[(graph, seed, "recombine")] - means[(graph, seed, "baseline")]
                  for seed in seeds
                  if (graph, seed, "baseline") in means and (graph, seed, "recombine") in means]
        if deltas:
            per_graph[graph] = float(np.mean(deltas))
    sizes = {arm: mean(value for key, value in means.items() if key[2] == arm) for arm in ("baseline", "recombine")}
    recombine_ms = max(float(row["recombine_time_s"]) for row in rows
                       if float(row["budget"]) == budget and row["arm"] == "recombine")
    sub = [row for row in rows if float(row["budget"]) == budget]
    return dict(budget=budget, pairs=len(per_seed), graphs=len(per_graph),
                mean_baseline=sizes["baseline"], mean_recombine=sizes["recombine"],
                delta=effect(list(per_graph.values())),
                pair_level=effect(per_seed),
                overruns=sum(int(row["deadline_overrun"]) for row in sub),
                recombine_ms_max=1e3 * recombine_ms,
                steps_baseline=mean(float(row["steps"]) for row in sub if row["arm"] == "baseline"),
                steps_recombine=mean(float(row["steps"]) for row in sub if row["arm"] == "recombine"),
                ms_per_step=mean(float(row["ms_per_step"]) for row in sub))


def gates(blocks):
    out = {}
    for block in blocks:
        tag = f"{block['budget']:g}s"
        delta = block["delta"]
        loss_share = block["delta"]["losses"] / max(block["delta"]["count"], 1)
        out[tag] = dict(
            ci_positive=delta["ci95"][0] > 0,
            mean_ok=delta["mean"] >= GATE["mean_delta"],
            loss_ok=loss_share <= GATE["loss_share"],
            overrun_ok=block["overruns"] == 0 and block["recombine_ms_max"] <= GATE["recombine_ms"],
            mean=delta["mean"], ci95=delta["ci95"], loss_share=loss_share,
            overruns=block["overruns"], recombine_ms=block["recombine_ms_max"])
    statuses = [row["ci_positive"] and row["overrun_ok"] for row in out.values()]
    means_ok = all(row["mean_ok"] for row in out.values())
    loss_ok = all(row["loss_ok"] for row in out.values())
    if all(statuses) and means_ok and loss_ok:
        status = "budget_pass"
    elif any(statuses):
        status = "budget_partial"
    else:
        status = "budget_fail"
    return dict(status=status, thresholds=GATE, budgets=out)


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--root", type=Path, default=ROOT)
    parser.add_argument("--refs", type=int, nargs="+", default=[0])
    args = parser.parse_args()
    folder = Path(args.root) / "budget"
    analysis = Path(args.root) / "analysis"
    analysis.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    pooled = []
    for ref in args.refs:
        path = folder / f"budget_ref{ref}.csv"
        if not path.is_file():
            print(f"ref{ref}: no budget csv")
            pooled.append(dict(ref=ref, status="missing"))
            continue
        rows = load(path)
        budgets = sorted({float(row["budget"]) for row in rows})
        blocks = [budget_block(rows, budget) for budget in budgets]
        verdict = gates(blocks)
        summary = dict(version="v7_tccr", mode="budget", ref=ref, budgets=budgets,
                       blocks=blocks, verdict=verdict)
        (analysis / f"summary_budget_ref{ref}.json").write_text(
            json.dumps(summary, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
        (analysis / f"decision_budget_ref{ref}.json").write_text(
            json.dumps(verdict, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
        pooled.append(dict(ref=ref, status=verdict["status"]))
        for block in blocks:
            print(f"ref{ref} {block['budget']:g}s: baseline {block['mean_baseline']:.4f} "
                  f"recombine {block['mean_recombine']:.4f} "
                  f"delta {block['delta']['mean']:+.4f} "
                  f"ci {[round(x, 4) for x in block['delta']['ci95']]} "
                  f"{block['delta']['wins']}/{block['delta']['ties']}/{block['delta']['losses']}")
        print(f"ref{ref}: {verdict['status']}")
    (analysis / "decision_budget.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(dict(version="v7_tccr", mode="budget", refs=args.refs, results=pooled,
                        thresholds=GATE), indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

FILE: train_scripts/v8_macro/author_kamis.sh

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Same-card KaMIS re-measurement on the 1000-graph author test split.
# Short clocks: 1000 graphs (the claim's 0.5-1 s regime).  Long clocks: 100 graphs
# (RLNN reports 98 s / 1.64 min, KLSA 35 s -- we need the same wall-clock points).
# KaMIS is single-threaded and the box has 96 cores, so both grids are sharded.
set -euo pipefail
cd "${RLNN_ROOT:-/home/hzeng/project/ZH/RLNN_lab}" || exit 1
source train_scripts/v8_macro/common.sh

KAMIS=${KAMIS:-$ROOT/tmp/kamis_build/redumis}
TEST=$ROOT/models/data/MIS_tensors/RB_small_author_test
SHORT_SHARDS=${SHORT_SHARDS:-6}
LONG_SHARDS=${LONG_SHARDS:-5}
mkdir -p "$OUT/queue"

for shard in $(seq 0 $((SHORT_SHARDS - 1))); do
  nohup env CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="" "$PYTHON" -u models/eval_kamis_anytime.py \
    --kamis "$KAMIS" --split test --test_path "$TEST" --test_samples 1000 \
    --budgets 0.5 1.0 --seeds 1017 \
    --shards "$SHORT_SHARDS" --shard "$shard" \
    --reference_dir "$OUT/kamis_author/none" --result_dir "$OUT/kamis_author" \
    > "$OUT/queue/kamis_author_short_shard${shard}.log" 2>&1 &
  echo "short shard $shard pid $!"
done

for shard in $(seq 0 $((LONG_SHARDS - 1))); do
  nohup env CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="" "$PYTHON" -u models/eval_kamis_anytime.py \
    --kamis "$KAMIS" --split test --test_path "$TEST" --test_samples 100 \
    --budgets 5.0 35.0 98.0 --seeds 1017 \
    --shards "$LONG_SHARDS" --shard "$shard" \
    --reference_dir "$OUT/kamis_author_long/none" --result_dir "$OUT/kamis_author_long" \
    > "$OUT/queue/kamis_author_long_shard${shard}.log" 2>&1 &
  echo "long shard $shard pid $!"
done

# Equal-per-graph-clock curve at the clocks the paper's baselines actually run at.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# The headline grid: the 1000 author test graphs, three search seeds, the eager
# engine and the captured engine at the same clock. This is the table that has
# to hold up against KLSA 19.97 @35 s and RLNN 19.52 @98 s.
#
# The GPU loop is not saturated by one process (each one needs ~1.5 GiB and the
# python side is serial), so the graph list is split across SHARDS processes.
# Every shard writes ``capture_budget_ref<r>_shard<i>.csv``; merge with
# ``python models/merge_v8_shards.py``.
set -euo pipefail
cd "${RLNN_ROOT:-/home/hzeng/project/ZH/RLNN_lab}" || exit 1
source train_scripts/v8_macro/common.sh
# GPU0 is shared with a long-running job from another user; the v8 grids
# default to the idle card.  Override with V8_GPU=0 when GPU1 is busy.
export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="${V8_GPU:-1}"

mkdir -p "$OUT/queue"
SHARDS=${SHARDS:-4}
for shard in $(seq 0 $((SHARDS - 1))); do
  nohup env CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="$CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES" "$PYTHON" -u models/eval_v8_capture_budget.py \
    --reference_seed "$REFERENCE_SEED" --save_dir "$BACKBONE" --split test \
    --test_path "$ROOT/models/data/MIS_tensors/RB_small_author_test" \
    --test_samples "${GRAPHS:-1000}" --budgets ${BUDGETS:-0.5 1.0} \
    --arms ${ARMS:-eager captured} --decoders ${DECODERS:-eager cached} \
    --seeds ${SEEDS_LIST:-1017 1019 1021} --repeats "${REPEATS:-1}" \
    --shards "$SHARDS" --shard "$shard" \
    --result_dir "${RESULT_DIR:-$OUT/author_test}" \
    > "$OUT/queue/author_test_shard${shard}.log" 2>&1 &
  echo "shard $shard pid $!"
done


========================================================================
FILE: train_scripts/v8_macro/capture_budget.sh

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Equal-budget comparison of the eager step against the captured block replay.
# ARMS selects which engines run; BUDGETS is a space-separated list of seconds.
set -euo pipefail
source "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/common.sh"

mkdir -p "$OUT/queue"
"$PYTHON" -u models/eval_v8_capture_budget.py \
  --reference_seed "$REFERENCE_SEED" --save_dir "$BACKBONE" --split validation \
  --test_samples "${GRAPHS:-100}" --budgets ${BUDGETS:-0.5 1.0} \
  --arms ${ARMS:-eager captured} \

FILE: train_scripts/v8_macro/common.sh

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Shared defaults for the v8 launchers.
#
# Launchers are normally run from disk (``bash train_scripts/v8_macro/x.sh``), but
# tmp/remote.py pipes them into ``bash -s``, where BASH_SOURCE is unset.  In that
# case the current directory is the repository root, which is all we need.
if [ -n "${BASH_SOURCE[0]:-}" ] && [ -f "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" ]; then
  ROOT="$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd)"
else
  ROOT="$PWD"
fi

cd "$ROOT"
export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="${CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES:-0}"
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1
export RLNN_SOURCE_SHA="${RLNN_SOURCE_SHA:-$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)-unversioned}"
export RLNN_SOURCE_BRANCH="${RLNN_SOURCE_BRANCH:-v8-macro}"
PYTHON="${PYTHON:-/home/hzeng/envs/rlnn/bin/python}"
OUT="${OUT_V8:-$ROOT/outputs/v8_macro}"
REFERENCE_SEED="${REFERENCE_SEED:-0}"
SEEDS="${SEEDS:-1017 1019 1021}"
HORIZON="${HORIZON:-2}"
BACKBONE="$ROOT/outputs/v2/none_seed${REFERENCE_SEED}/checkpoints"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Does the captured A.3 decode survive the swap?  Four cells, paired per graph:

  --reference_seed "$REFERENCE_SEED" --save_dir "$BACKBONE" --split validation \
  --test_samples "${GRAPHS:-100}" --budgets ${BUDGETS:-0.5 1.0} \

  --decode_chunk "${DECODE_CHUNK:-4}" \
  --seeds ${SEEDS_LIST:-1017} --repeats "${REPEATS:-2}" \

  2>&1 | tee -a "$OUT/queue/decode_budget.log"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ER-[700-800] at the density that reproduces the pooled-table scale:
# KaMIS 1 s = 44.00, RLNN 43.34, KLSA 44.10, KaMIS 52 min = 44.87 (paper).
# n~750 graphs are ~4x the training size, so the grid is sharded.
set -euo pipefail
cd "${RLNN_ROOT:-/home/hzeng/project/ZH/RLNN_lab}" || exit 1
source train_scripts/v8_macro/common.sh
# GPU0 is shared with a long-running job from another user; the v8 grids
# default to the idle card.  Override with V8_GPU=0 when GPU1 is busy.
export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="${V8_GPU:-1}"

GRAPHS=${GRAPHS:-128}
SEEDS_LIST=${SEEDS_LIST:-1017 1019 1021}
BUDGETS=${BUDGETS:-0.5 1.0}
SHARDS=${SHARDS:-2}

if [ ! -d "$ROOT/models/data/MIS_tensors/ER_700_800" ]; then
  "$PYTHON" models/data/er_generator.py --min-n 700 --max-n 800 --p 0.15 \
      --num-graphs "$GRAPHS" --processes 8 --seed 0 \
      --output-dir "$ROOT/models/data/raw_regime/ER_700_800"
  "$PYTHON" models/data/prepare_mis_tensors.py --source "$ROOT/models/data/raw_regime/ER_700_800" \
      --destination "$ROOT/models/data/MIS_tensors/ER_700_800"
fi

mkdir -p "$OUT/queue"
for shard in $(seq 0 $((SHARDS - 1))); do
  nohup env CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="$CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES" "$PYTHON" -u models/eval_v8_capture_budget.py \
    --reference_seed "$REFERENCE_SEED" --save_dir "$BACKBONE" \
    --split validation --test_path "$ROOT/models/data/MIS_tensors/ER_700_800" \
    --test_samples "$GRAPHS" --budgets $BUDGETS \
    --arms eager captured --decoders eager cached \
    --seeds $SEEDS_LIST --repeats 1 \
    --shards "$SHARDS" --shard "$shard" \
    --result_dir "$OUT/er700_800" \
    > "$OUT/queue/er700_800_shard${shard}.log" 2>&1 &
  echo "er shard $shard pid $!"
done

========================================================================
FILE: train_scripts/v8_macro/global_train.sh
========================================================================
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Train the flip policy with a pooled graph token (``--arch global``).
#
# The frozen backbone is a five layer GCN; on a 231 node RB graph a node sees a
# small part of the instance, and the plateau study showed the policy settles at
# a local optimum whose one-flip and two-swap neighbourhoods are both empty.
# This arm adds mean/max pooled context to every node and keeps everything else
# identical (same loss, same step budget, same data), so the only variable is
# global context.
#
#   EPOCHS=50 RUN_NAME=global_tp50 bash train_scripts/v8_macro/global_train.sh
set -uo pipefail
cd "${RLNN_ROOT:-/home/hzeng/project/ZH/RLNN_lab}" || exit 1
source train_scripts/v8_macro/common.sh

export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="${V8_GPU:-1}"
mkdir -p "$OUT/queue"

RUN_NAME="${RUN_NAME:-global_tp50}"
EPOCHS="${EPOCHS:-50}"
GRAPHS="${GRAPHS:-1000}"
NUM_TP="${NUM_TP:-50}"
LR="${LR:-1e-4}"
BATCH="${BATCH:-64}"
GRAPH_BATCH="${GRAPH_BATCH:-8}"
NUM_K="${NUM_K:-20}"
NUM_H="${NUM_H:-128}"
NUM_L="${NUM_L:-5}"
LAMBD="${LAMBD:-0.5}"
ARCH="${ARCH:-global}"
WARM_START="${WARM_START:-}"
FINETUNE_LR="${FINETUNE_LR:-2e-5}"

EXTRA=()
if [ -n "$WARM_START" ]; then EXTRA+=(--warm_start "$WARM_START" --finetune_lr "$FINETUNE_LR"); fi

"$PYTHON" -u "$ROOT/tools/run_rlnn.py" train --version v2 --run "$RUN_NAME" --arch "$ARCH" \
  --frequency none --seed 0 --epochs "$EPOCHS" \
  --graph_batch_size "$GRAPH_BATCH" --batch_size "$BATCH" --lr "$LR" \
  --validation_seed 1017 \
  --train_path "$ROOT/models/data/MIS_tensors/RB_small_train" --train_samples "$GRAPHS" \
  --valid_path "$ROOT/models/data/MIS_tensors/RB_small_val" --valid_samples 100 \
  --test_path "$ROOT/models/data/author_rld4co/MIS/RB_small_test" \
  --num_workers "${WORKERS:-4}" \
  --num_k "$NUM_K" --num_t 100 --num_tp "$NUM_TP" --num_d 5 --num_l "$NUM_L" --num_h "$NUM_H" \
  --mixed_precision no --beta 1.02 --lambd "$LAMBD" \
  ${EXTRA[@]+"${EXTRA[@]}"} \
  "$@" 2>&1 | tee "$OUT/queue/global_${RUN_NAME}.log"

========================================================================
FILE: train_scripts/v8_macro/README.md
========================================================================
# v8 宏步（ACMD）启动器

`models/` 侧对应文件：`mis_v8_macro.py`、`v8_collect.py`、`v8_train.py`、`v8_eval.py`、`check_v8.py`、`diagnose_v8_prior.py`。方案与判读标准见 [RLNN_lab_v8_review_and_research.md](../../docs/temporary/RLNN_lab_v8_review_and_research.md)，实测结果与"停止主线"的决定见 [RLNN_v8_P0_Results.md](../../docs/temporary/RLNN_v8_P0_Results.md)。

**现状：P0 闸门已判定停止，训练与评测脚本保留但未产出结论。** 下面的顺序是完整路径，重启时按序执行即可；第 2 步是已知的止损点。

## 顺序

| 步 | 命令 | 作用 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | `bash check.sh` | 内核自检：M=1 读出等值、联合似然退化、块记录语义（CPU，无检查点） |
| 1 | `bash collect.sh` | 冻结教师切块，写 `outputs/v8_macro/data/blocks_{train,validation}_ref0.pt` |
| 2 | `bash prior.sh` | P0-B 相关性打乱 + P0-C 端点档案漏失（约 2.5 分钟 / 60 图） |
| 3 | `bash train_all.sh` | A2 / A3 / A5 三臂小训练（先读结果文档里的损失标定问题） |
| 4 | `bash eval.sh A3 budget` | 固定预算评测，两臂同图同种子，冻结 PAVE `horizon=1` |

## 定位与步数（现行方向）

宏步线停在 P0 之后，这条目录改用来跑「等预算定位 + 步数杠杆」，结论见
[RLNN_v8_Positioning_Results.md](../../docs/temporary/RLNN_v8_Positioning_Results.md)，汇总表在
`outputs/v8_macro/positioning/summary/positioning_ref0.md`。

| 步 | 命令 | 作用 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| P0 | `bash probe_step.sh` | 每步成本分解（eager / captured / forward / energy / decode），约 2 分钟 |
| P1 | `bash check_capture.sh` | 捕获闸门：同种子 20 步必须逐位一致，然后才报速度（2 图，约 1 分钟） |
| P2 | `bash kamis.sh` | KaMIS anytime 曲线，4 档 `--time_limit` × 2 种子（纯 CPU，约 42 分钟） |
| P3 | `bash capture_budget.sh` | eager vs captured 等时钟对照，0.5/1.0 秒（GPU，约 11 分钟） |
| P4 | `BUDGETS="2.5 5.0" ARMS=captured RESULT_DIR=outputs/v8_macro/positioning_wall bash capture_budget.sh` | 等钟高预算档（约 45 分钟） |
| P5 | `python models/summarize_v8_positioning.py` | 汇总 KaMIS 与两份 CSV 成一张定位表 |
| P6 | `bash decode_cost.sh` | 解码成本分解：A.3 迭代数、单迭代、稀疏 mm、捕获重放（约 2 分钟） |
| P7 | `bash check_decode.sh` | 解码闸门：捕获解码必须与 `solution_masks` 逐位一致，再报 chunk 扫描（约 2 分钟） |
| P8 | `DECODERS="eager captured cached" bash decode_budget.sh` | 五格等钟对照：两种引擎 × 三种解码（0.5/1.0 秒，约 30 分钟） |
| P9 | `python models/summarize_v8_positioning.py` | 重跑汇总，多出「解码消融」一节 |
| P10 | `SOURCE=kamis bash pave_external.sh` | PAVE 外接判决：KaMIS 解上增益（约 8 分钟，CPU） |
| P11 | `SOURCE=min_degree bash pave_external.sh` | 正对照：贪心起点上 PAVE 的增益（约 1 分钟） |
| P12 | `bash regime.sh` | 跨族/跨规模迁移判决：生成 ER/BA/RB-large → 转 tensor → 四族各 40 图、1.0 秒三臂对照（约 18 分钟，含数据生成） |
| P13 | `FAMILIES="RB_large" PAVE_LIMIT=1.0 RESULT_DIR=outputs/v8_macro/regime_repair bash regime.sh` | 修复时钟消融：把 PAVE 的时钟从 0.1 秒提到 1.0 秒，区分「机制不工作」与「预算不够」（约 9 分钟） |
| P14 | `SHARDS=4 bash author_test.sh` | **论文主张的主表**：1000 张作者测试图 × 3 搜索种子 × 0.5/1.0 秒 × 三格（`eager/eager`、`captured/eager`、`captured/cached`），四个分片并行（约 2 小时） |
| P15 | `bash author_kamis.sh` | 同卡 KaMIS 对照：1000 图 0.5/1.0 秒（6 分片，约 15 分钟）+ 100 图 5/35/98 秒（5 分片，约 50 分钟） |
| P16 | `SHARDS=2 bash er_grid.sh` | ER-[700–800]：p=0.15 生成 128 图 → 转 tensor → 同三格网格（约 1 小时） |
| P17 | `python models/merge_v8_shards.py --pattern '<dir>/capture_budget_ref0_shard*.csv' --out <dir>/capture_budget_ref0.csv` | 把分片 CSV 合成单文件（`graph_id` 用全局下标，不会因分片错位） |
| P18 | `python models/summarize_v8_claim.py --csv <merged.csv>` | 主张分解表：`search_size`（无平台）vs `final_size`（+平台）+ 图级配对 CI |
| P19 | `GRAPHS=4 STEPS=60 bash check_padded.sh` | 摊薄闸门：捕获 vs padded eager 逐位相等，另报与未 padded 的 `drifted_nodes` 与解大小 |
| P20 | `SHARDS=1 BUDGETS="0.05 0.1 0.2" DECODERS=cached RESULT_DIR=outputs/v8_macro/padded_short bash padded.sh` | 摊薄评测（短时钟，约 5 分钟）：整个数据集只捕获一次，prelude 从 93 ms 掉到 6 ms |
| P21 | `GRAPHS=100 BUDGETS="0.2 1.0" TEMPERATURES="1 2 4 8" bash temperature.sh` | 温度闸门：固定温度与退火（`ANNEAL=1`）对照，产物 `$OUT/temperature*/padded/`，汇总用 `models/summarize_v8_temperature.py` |

`models/` 侧对应文件：`mis_v8_capture.py`、`mis_v8_decode.py`、`mis_v8_pad.py`、`check_capture_budget.py`、
`check_decode_capture.py`、`check_padded_capture.py`、`probe_decode_cost.py`、`profile_budget_step.py`、
`eval_kamis_anytime.py`、`eval_v8_capture_budget.py`、`eval_v8_padded.py`、`summarize_v8_positioning.py`、
`eval_pave_external.py`、`eval_regime.py`、`summarize_v8_claim.py`、`merge_v8_shards.py`。

## 环境变量

`common.sh` 里统一设置，全部可覆盖：

| 变量 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `PYTHON` | `/home/hzeng/envs/rlnn/bin/python` | 服务器解释器（本地无 `torch_scatter`，不能在 Windows 上跑） |
| `OUT_V8` | `outputs/v8_macro` | 产物根目录 |
| `REFERENCE_SEED` | `0` | 骨干与 PAVE 的参考种子，必须成对 |
| `SEEDS` | `1017 1019 1021` | 搜索种子；`diag*`/`collect` 只用第一个 |
| `HORIZON` | `2` | 块的宏步长度；PAVE 侧固定 1 |
| `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES` | `0` | 两张 5090 长期被占用，换卡前先看 `nvidia-smi` |
| `EPOCHS` | `3` | 单臂训练轮数 |
| `GRAPHS` | `100` | 定位实验用的验证图数 |
| `BUDGETS` | `0.5 1.0` | 预算档（秒），空格分隔 |
| `ARMS` | `eager captured` | 引擎臂；只跑捕获臂时写 `ARMS=captured`，此时不出配对行 |
| `DECODERS` | `eager captured cached` | 解码臂：`eager` 是 `solution_masks`，`captured` 是捕获分块，`cached` 再加「档案没动就跳过解码」（只能配捕获引擎） |
| `DECODE_CHUNK` | `4` | 捕获解码每次重放的 A.3 迭代数，闸门扫描过 2/4/8/16，4 最快 |
| `REPEATS` | `2` | 每格的重复次数，两臂顺序交替 |
| `RESULT_DIR` | `$OUT_V8/positioning` | 定位产物根目录，高预算档写 `$OUT_V8/positioning_wall` |
| `SEEDS_LIST` | `1017` | 定位实验的搜索种子（与 `SEEDS` 分开，避免误用三个种子把时长乘三） |
| `KAMIS` | `$ROOT/tmp/kamis_build/redumis` | ReduMIS 二进制；缺失时 `kamis.sh` 直接报错 |
| `FAMILIES` | `RB_small_val ER_200_300 BA_200_300 RB_large` | `regime.sh` 要跑的图族；单族复跑时只写一个 |
| `PROCESSES` | `8` | 生成图与转 tensor 的并行进程数 |
| `PAVE_LIMIT` | 空 | `regime.sh` 透传给 `--pave_limit`；空则用脚本默认 0.1 秒（n≈1000 时不够，要写 1.0） |
| `SOURCE` | `kamis` | PAVE 外接实验的起点：`kamis`（KaMIS 解）或 `min_degree`（贪心，作正对照）；同时决定产物目录 |
| `TEMPERATURES` | `1 2 4 8` | P21 的温度扫描列表；`1` 是部署策略，导出成 `padded/cached` 以便与旧 CSV 对齐 |
| `ANNEAL` | `0` | `1` 时每个温度按剩余时间线性降到 1（cell 名加后缀 `a`） |
| `SHARDS` | `4`（`author_test.sh`）/`2`（`er_grid.sh`） | 图列表分给几个进程；每个进程约 1.5 GiB 显存，单进程吃不满 GPU（python 侧是串行的） |
| `SHORT_SHARDS` / `LONG_SHARDS` | `6` / `5` | `author_kamis.sh` 的 CPU 分片数（KaMIS 单线程，96 核随便分） |
| `V8_GPU` | `1` | `author_test.sh`、`er_grid.sh` 用的卡；GPU0 长期被别人占满 |

## 注意

- `HORIZON=2` 是**宏步长度**，与 PAVE 的 `horizon` 不是一回事。评测器里 PAVE 一律 `horizon=1`，改错会让结论与 v5/v7 基线不可比（v5 归档的 `fixed_time` 运行全是 1，v7 普查曾误用 2，已记录为偏差）。
- 训练必须把 `edge2adj` 的归一化邻接喂给 kernel，不是 0/1 邻接；这是 v8 首轮训练浪费掉一轮的直接原因。
- `prior.sh` 只用冻结模型，不训练、不写检查点，可以随时重跑；它是这条线的止损闸门，先跑它再谈训练。
- 定位实验一律在 `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1` 上跑：GPU0 长期被其他项目占满，争用会让 `ms_per_step` 和 `deadline_overrun` 失真。
- `kamis.sh` 是纯 CPU 任务（`CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=""`），只传 `--time_limit`，但 ReduMIS 每次调用的墙钟地板是 1.87 s/图，
  所以「0.1 秒档」在墙钟上并不存在；表里必须同时报解和实测墙钟，不能只报 `--time_limit`。
- `capture_budget.sh` 的 `BUDGETS`/`ARMS` 是**不加强引号**展开的（空格分隔列表）；加引号会被当成单个参数，报
  `argument --budgets: invalid float value: '0.5 1.0'`。
- `regime.sh` 的数据生成是幂等的：`MIS_tensors/<family>` 已存在就跳过，所以要重新生成必须先删掉那个目录。
- `regime.sh` 里 KaMIS 拿的是**完整的 `--time_limit` 算法时间**，我们的 `rl` 臂把这同一段墙钟分给捕获、解码、PAVE 和写盘，
  两边口径不同且对基线有利；引用时不能只说「1 秒对 1 秒」，必须同时报 KaMIS 的实测墙钟（n≈1010 时是 12.8 s）。
- 贪心臂的 PAVE 时钟由 `PAVE_LIMIT` 控制（默认 0.1 秒）。在 n≈1000 上 0.1 秒会得到「修复 +0.000」的假象，要看机制必须给到 1.0 秒。


========================================================================
FILE: train_scripts/v8_macro/recombine.sh
========================================================================
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Can the exact recombination of the K particle solutions close the 0.037 gap to
# KLSA?  Three arms at the same clock: ``captured`` (current best), ``recombine``
# (search stops ``RESERVE`` seconds early, then decode + Koenig recombine + PAVE)
# and ``oracle`` (recombine after the clock, bounds what the operator could buy).
#
# Split across SHARDS processes for the same reason as author_test.sh; each shard
# writes ``recombine_ref<r>_shard<i>.csv`` for ``models/merge_v8_shards.py``.
set -euo pipefail
cd "${RLNN_ROOT:-/home/hzeng/project/ZH/RLNN_lab}" || exit 1
source train_scripts/v8_macro/common.sh
export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="${V8_GPU:-1}"

mkdir -p "$OUT/queue" "$OUT/recombine"
SHARDS=${SHARDS:-4}
for shard in $(seq 0 $((SHARDS - 1))); do
  nohup env CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="$CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES" "$PYTHON" -u models/eval_v8_recombine.py \
    --reference_seed "$REFERENCE_SEED" --save_dir "$BACKBONE" --split test \
    --test_path "$ROOT/models/data/MIS_tensors/RB_small_author_test" \
    --test_samples "${GRAPHS:-1000}" --budgets ${BUDGETS:-0.5 1.0} \
    --arms ${ARMS:-captured recombine oracle} \
    --reserve "${RESERVE:-0.05}" --decode_chunk "${DECODE_CHUNK:-4}" \
    --seeds ${SEEDS_LIST:-1017 1019 1021} \
    --shards "$SHARDS" --shard "$shard" \
    --result_dir "${RESULT_DIR:-$OUT/recombine}" \
    > "$OUT/queue/recombine_shard${shard}.log" 2>&1 &
  echo "shard $shard pid $!"
done


========================================================================
FILE: train_scripts/v8_macro/regime.sh
========================================================================
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Cross-family regime probe: generate ER / BA / large-RB graphs, convert them to the
# tensor cache, then run the three-arm comparison at a fixed clock.
set -euo pipefail
source "$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)/common.sh"

TENSORS="$ROOT/models/data/MIS_tensors"
RAW="$ROOT/models/data/raw_regime"
GRAPHS="${GRAPHS:-40}"
BUDGETS="${BUDGETS:-1.0}"
FAMILIES="${FAMILIES:-RB_small_val ER_200_300 BA_200_300 RB_large}"
PROCESSES="${PROCESSES:-8}"
PAVE_LIMIT="${PAVE_LIMIT:-}"
KAMIS="${KAMIS:-$ROOT/tmp/kamis_build/redumis}"
RESULT_DIR="${RESULT_DIR:-$OUT/regime}"
mkdir -p "$RESULT_DIR/queue"

cd "$ROOT"
if [ ! -d "$TENSORS/ER_200_300" ]; then
  echo "[regime] generating ER 200-300 (p=0.1)" | tee -a "$RESULT_DIR/queue/regime_gen.log"
  "$PYTHON" models/data/er_generator.py --min-n 200 --max-n 300 --p 0.1 \
    --num-graphs "$GRAPHS" --output-dir "$RAW/ER_200_300" --processes "$PROCESSES" \
    >> "$RESULT_DIR/queue/regime_gen.log" 2>&1
fi
if [ ! -d "$TENSORS/BA_200_300" ]; then
  echo "[regime] generating BA 200-300 (m=4)" | tee -a "$RESULT_DIR/queue/regime_gen.log"
  "$PYTHON" models/data/ba_generator.py --min-n 200 --max-n 300 --m 4 \
    --num-graphs "$GRAPHS" --save-dir "$RAW/BA_200_300" --seed 0 --processes "$PROCESSES" \
    >> "$RESULT_DIR/queue/regime_gen.log" 2>&1
fi
if [ ! -d "$TENSORS/RB_large" ]; then
  echo "[regime] generating RB large (n 800-1400)" | tee -a "$RESULT_DIR/queue/regime_gen.log"
  "$PYTHON" models/data/rb_generator.py --num-graphs "$GRAPHS" --min-n 800 --max-n 1400 \
    --size large --seed 0 --save-dir "$RAW/RB_large" --processes "$PROCESSES" \
    >> "$RESULT_DIR/queue/regime_gen.log" 2>&1
fi

for family in ER_200_300 BA_200_300 RB_large; do
  if [ ! -f "$TENSORS/$family/tensor_manifest.json" ]; then
    echo "[regime] converting $family to tensors" | tee -a "$RESULT_DIR/queue/regime_gen.log"
    "$PYTHON" models/data/prepare_mis_tensors.py --source "$RAW/$family" \
      --destination "$TENSORS/$family" --workers "$PROCESSES" \
      >> "$RESULT_DIR/queue/regime_gen.log" 2>&1
  fi
done

# shellcheck disable=SC2086
PAVE_ARGS=""
if [ -n "$PAVE_LIMIT" ]; then
  PAVE_ARGS="--pave_limit $PAVE_LIMIT"
fi
# shellcheck disable=SC2086
"$PYTHON" -u models/eval_regime.py --families $FAMILIES --graphs "$GRAPHS" \
  --budgets $BUDGETS --seeds ${SEEDS_LIST:-1017} --reference_seed "$REFERENCE_SEED" \
  --kamis "$KAMIS" --result_dir "$RESULT_DIR" $PAVE_ARGS 2>&1 | tee "$RESULT_DIR/queue/regime.log"


========================================================================
FILE: train_scripts/v8_macro/retrain.sh
========================================================================
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Retrain (or fine-tune) the flip policy so that it converges inside the budget
# we actually deploy: 100-400 steps instead of 3000.
#
# The frozen v2 backbone was fine-tuned with ``--num_tp 50``: every training state
# came from the first 50 steps of the policy's own rollout.  Deployment runs to
# thousands of steps, i.e. almost entirely off that distribution.  This launcher
# sweeps the rollout length (``NUM_TP``) and the training budget.
#
#   NUM_TP=300 EPOCHS=5 RUN_NAME=ft_tp300 bash train_scripts/v8_macro/retrain.sh
#
# ``WARM_START=0`` trains from scratch (then give it a real number of epochs).
set -uo pipefail
cd "${RLNN_ROOT:-/home/hzeng/project/ZH/RLNN_lab}" || exit 1
source train_scripts/v8_macro/common.sh

export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="${V8_GPU:-1}"
mkdir -p "$OUT/queue"

RUN_NAME="${RUN_NAME:-ft_tp${NUM_TP:-300}}"
NUM_TP="${NUM_TP:-300}"
EPOCHS="${EPOCHS:-5}"
GRAPHS="${GRAPHS:-1000}"
LR="${LR:-1e-4}"
FINETUNE_LR="${FINETUNE_LR:-2e-5}"
BATCH="${BATCH:-64}"
GRAPH_BATCH="${GRAPH_BATCH:-8}"
NUM_K="${NUM_K:-20}"
NUM_H="${NUM_H:-128}"
NUM_L="${NUM_L:-5}"
LAMBD="${LAMBD:-0.5}"
WARM_START="${WARM_START:-1}"

schedule=()
if [ "$WARM_START" = 1 ]; then
  schedule=(--warm_start "$ROOT/outputs/v2/none_seed0/checkpoints/best.pt" --finetune_lr "$FINETUNE_LR")
fi

"$PYTHON" -u "$ROOT/tools/run_rlnn.py" train --version v2 --run "$RUN_NAME" \
  --frequency none --seed 0 --epochs "$EPOCHS" \
  --graph_batch_size "$GRAPH_BATCH" --batch_size "$BATCH" --lr "$LR" \
  --validation_seed 1017 \
  --train_path "$ROOT/models/data/MIS_tensors/RB_small_train" --train_samples "$GRAPHS" \
  --valid_path "$ROOT/models/data/MIS_tensors/RB_small_val" --valid_samples 100 \
  --test_path "$ROOT/models/data/author_rld4co/MIS/RB_small_test" \
  --num_workers "${WORKERS:-4}" \
  --num_k "$NUM_K" --num_t 100 --num_tp "$NUM_TP" --num_d 5 --num_l "$NUM_L" --num_h "$NUM_H" \
  --mixed_precision no --beta 1.02 --lambd "$LAMBD" \
  "${schedule[@]}" "$@" 2>&1 | tee "$OUT/queue/retrain_${RUN_NAME}.log"

FILE: train_scripts/v8_macro/temperature.sh

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Temperature gate for the annealed-policy line: sweep T on the amortised engine.
#
#   ANNEAL=1 TEMPERATURES="2 4" bash train_scripts/v8_macro/temperature.sh
#
# One process on purpose: four concurrent shards serialise the kernel launches
# and the step counts stop being comparable (see RLNN_v8_Amortised_Capture.md).
set -uo pipefail
cd "${RLNN_ROOT:-/home/hzeng/project/ZH/RLNN_lab}" || exit 1
source train_scripts/v8_macro/common.sh

export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="${V8_GPU:-1}"
mkdir -p "$OUT/queue"
EXTRA=()
if [ "${ANNEAL:-0}" = "1" ]; then
  EXTRA+=(--anneal)
fi

"$PYTHON" -u models/eval_v8_padded.py \
  --reference_seed "${REFERENCE_SEED:-0}" --save_dir "$BACKBONE" \
  --split test \
  --test_path "$ROOT/models/data/MIS_tensors/RB_small_author_test" \
  --test_samples "${GRAPHS:-100}" \
  --budgets ${BUDGETS:-0.2 1.0} \
  --decoders ${DECODERS:-cached} \
  --temperatures ${TEMPERATURES:-1 2 4 8} \
  --seeds ${SEEDS_LIST:-1017} \
  --repeats "${REPEATS:-1}" \
  --decode_every "${DECODE_EVERY:-1}" \
  "${EXTRA[@]}" \
  --result_dir "${RESULT_DIR:-$OUT/temperature}" \
  --shards 1 --shard 0 \
  2>&1 | tee "$OUT/queue/temperature.log"

========================================================================
FILE: train_scripts/v9/scale_train.sh
========================================================================
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# v9: train the flip policy with the density-compensated scale-space operator.
#
# The frozen backbone is a five layer GCN whose aggregation is a degree
# normalised *mean* (``models/models.py:46``).  On the author RB graphs the mean
# degree is ~80 (``capacity = 105`` at ``nodes=264``), so each further hop shrinks
# the node-to-node contrast by ~1/9, ~1/80, ~1/700; beyond one hop the network is
# averaging noise, which is why every diversity patch measured zero.  ``--arch
# scale`` (``models/mis_v9_scale.py``) reads the hops as explicit counts and
# rescales each one by its expected size, so three hops stay readable.
#
# Everything else is held fixed so the only variable is the operator: same loss,
# same 50 step rollouts, same data, same seed, same learning rate.  ``ARCH=gcn``
# with an identical command line is the control arm.
#
#   ARCH=scale RUN_NAME=v9_scale_tp50 bash train_scripts/v9/scale_train.sh
#   ARCH=gcn   RUN_NAME=v9_gcn_tp50   bash train_scripts/v9/scale_train.sh
set -uo pipefail
cd "${RLNN_ROOT:-/home/hzeng/project/ZH/RLNN_lab}" || exit 1
source train_scripts/v8_macro/common.sh

export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="${V8_GPU:-1}"
mkdir -p "$OUT/queue"

ARCH="${ARCH:-scale}"
RUN_NAME="${RUN_NAME:-v9_${ARCH}_tp50}"
EPOCHS="${EPOCHS:-50}"
GRAPHS="${GRAPHS:-1000}"
NUM_TP="${NUM_TP:-50}"
LR="${LR:-1e-4}"
BATCH="${BATCH:-64}"
GRAPH_BATCH="${GRAPH_BATCH:-8}"
NUM_K="${NUM_K:-20}"
NUM_H="${NUM_H:-128}"
NUM_L="${NUM_L:-5}"
LAMBD="${LAMBD:-0.5}"
SS_HOPS="${SS_HOPS:-3}"
SS_TAU="${SS_TAU:-2.0}"

"$PYTHON" -u "$ROOT/tools/run_rlnn.py" train --version v2 --run "$RUN_NAME" --arch "$ARCH" \
  --ss_hops "$SS_HOPS" --ss_tau "$SS_TAU" \
  --frequency none --seed 0 --epochs "$EPOCHS" \
  --graph_batch_size "$GRAPH_BATCH" --batch_size "$BATCH" --lr "$LR" \
  --validation_seed 1017 \
  --train_path "$ROOT/models/data/MIS_tensors/RB_small_train" --train_samples "$GRAPHS" \
  --valid_path "$ROOT/models/data/MIS_tensors/RB_small_val" --valid_samples 100 \
  --test_path "$ROOT/models/data/author_rld4co/MIS/RB_small_test" \
  --num_workers "${WORKERS:-4}" \
  --num_k "$NUM_K" --num_t 100 --num_tp "$NUM_TP" --num_d 5 --num_l "$NUM_L" --num_h "$NUM_H" \
  --mixed_precision no --beta 1.02 --lambd "$LAMBD" \
  "$@" 2>&1 | tee "$OUT/queue/v9_${ARCH}_${RUN_NAME}.log"

类别	范围	指标	数值或说明	来源
统计口径	均值与标准差	聚合单位	状态/粒子先在图内平均，再对图平均；SD为训练种子均值的样本标准差	tools/summarize_frequency_followup.py
统计口径	数据划分	解释边界	train用于机制探索；validation已参与选权重，不能作为独立测试证明	
统计口径	P2配对	置信区间	以图ID为bootstrap单位，同一图的不同种子共同保留；差值为当前方法−Full	
统计口径	P3收益	标签	同状态、同候选、冻结B续跑标签；R2/4/8/16是同一最大R的前缀，不是独立实验	
统计口径	P3采样	分母	Uniform与Stratified分开；release_high可与五种状态类别重叠；重复不是独立图	
统计口径	P3配对	后悔值方向	本表改善值及区间均按 MSG−F4 后悔值计算，正值表示 F4 改善	
统计口径	P4计时	边界	组件微基准与实际端到端计时分开；诊断墙钟不进入正式求解时间

臂	不同解数	Jaccard	best	mean	重组 oracle 增益	并集

判决
项	结论
scale	五档恒定 −0.71~−0.78，死于表达力（训练 valid_obj 低 1.64）
norm	差距随预算收窄，但等步数对照（1347 步 19.9115 vs 冻结 1310 步 19.9450）仍低 0.034 → 每步更贵、无单步增益
唯一正结果	DCSS 让 20 粒子的精确重组余量从 +0.05 涨到 +0.75（15×），但质量掉 1.8，补不回
副产物	「20 个粒子必然坍缩到同一盆地」被证伪：三臂都是 20/20 个不同解、Jaccard 0.085

判决
项	结论
移动集	不是约束：`a∪b` 内的全局最优（精确重组）增益恰好 0
修复算子	才是约束：不动点会被修复回来，周期 10 下三档半径全部逐位相同
学习式修复	前置门 0.24% ≪ 1%，且正样本永远只有 +1、74% 轮次为 0 → 无可学信号，关线
机制句	RB[200–300] 上 1 s 内的解已是破坏-修复不动点；要越过去必须换修复算子，而不是换移动集
